From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope order_scope.

Theorem non_interference
    ψ a0 b0 v0 v1
    (h0 : GDefEq nil ψ a0 b0)
    (h1 : Typing nil ψ a0 a_Bool)
    (h2 : Typing nil ψ b0 a_Bool)
    (h3 : Reds a0 v0)
    (h4 : Reds b0 v1)
    (hv0 : Value v0)
    (hv1 : Value v1) :
    v0 = v1.

266	  | a_True => Some h_True
267	  | a_False => Some h_False

627	Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=

629	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
630	     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
631	     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
632	 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
633	     lc_tm a1 ->
634	     lc_tm a2 ->
635	      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
636	      uniq  P  ->
637	     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
638	with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
639	 | Par_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
640	      uniq  P  ->
641	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
642	      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
643	     Par P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
644	 | Par_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
645	      uniq  P  ->
646	     Par P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
647	 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
648	     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
649	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
650	     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
651	 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
652	     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
653	     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
654	     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
655	 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
656	     Par P psi a a' ->
657	     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
658	     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
659	 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
660	     lc_tm A1 ->
661	     lc_tm A2 ->
662	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
663	     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
664	 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
665	      uniq  P  ->
666	     Par P psi a_Refl a_Refl
667	 | Par_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
668	     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
669	     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
670	     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
671	 | Par_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
672	     lc_tm A0 ->
673	     lc_tm A1 ->
674	     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
675	     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
676	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
677	     Par P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
678	 | Par_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
679	     Par P psi a0 a_Refl ->
680	     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
681	     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1
682	 | Par_T : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
683	     Par P psi A B ->
684	     Par P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
685	 | Par_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
686	     CPar P psi psi0 a b ->
687	     Par P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
688	 | Par_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
689	     Par P psi a b ->
690	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
691	     Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
692	 | Par_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
693	     Par P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
694	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
695	     Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) b
696	 | Par_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
697	     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
698	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
699	     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
700	 | Par_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
701	     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
702	     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
703	 | Par_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
704	     Par P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
705	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
706	     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
707	 | Par_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
708	     Par P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
709	     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 b) a2
710	 | Par_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),
711	     CPar P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
712	     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
713	     Par P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
714	 | Par_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
715	     Par P psi A0 A1 ->
716	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
717	     Par P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)
718	 | Par_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
719	      uniq  P  ->
720	     Par P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
721	 | Par_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
722	      uniq  P  ->
723	     Par P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
724	 | Par_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
725	      uniq  P  ->
726	     Par P psi a_Bool a_Bool
727	 | Par_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
728	      uniq  P  ->
729	     Par P psi a_True a_True
730	 | Par_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
731	      uniq  P  ->
732	     Par P psi a_False a_False
733	 | Par_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
734	     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
735	     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
736	     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
737	     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
738	 | Par_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),
739	     Par P psi a0 a_True ->
740	     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
741	     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
742	     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b2
743	 | Par_IfFalse : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b3 b2:tm),
744	     Par P psi a0 a_False ->
745	     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
746	     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
747	     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3.
748	
749	Inductive EPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
750	 | EP_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm) (psi:grade),
751	     Par P psi a b ->
752	     EPar P a b.
753	
754	Inductive EMPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
755	 | EMP_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm),
756	     EPar P a b ->
757	     EMPar P a b
758	 | EMP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (a a' b:tm),
759	     EPar P a b ->
760	     EMPar P b a' ->
761	     EMPar P a a'.
762	
763	Inductive EJoins : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
764	 | EJ_ejoins : forall (P:econtext) (a1 a2 b:tm),
765	     EMPar P a1 b ->
766	     EMPar P a2 b ->
767	     EJoins P a1 a2.
768	
769	Inductive MultiPar : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
770	 | MP_One : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
771	     Par P psi a b ->
772	     MultiPar P psi a b
773	 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
774	     Par P psi a b ->
775	     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
776	     MultiPar P psi a a'.
777	
778	Inductive Joins : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
779	 | join : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
780	     MultiPar P psi a1 b ->
781	     MultiPar P psi a2 b ->
782	     Joins P psi a1 a2.
783	
784	Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
785	 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
786	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
787	     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
788	     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2

790	     lc_tm a1 ->
791	     lc_tm a2 ->
792	      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
793	      uniq  P  ->
794	     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.
795	
796	Inductive CJoins : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=

798	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
799	     Joins P psi a1 a2 ->

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export Qual.grade_sig.

Require Export Qual.sort_sig.

From mathcomp Require Import ssreflect ssrbool.

Local Open Scope order_scope.

Local Close Scope bool_scope.

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition qualityvar : Set := atom.

Inductive tm : Type :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_Pi (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Abs (psi:grade) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Type (s:sort)
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_CEq (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm)
 | a_Refl : tm
 | a_Transp (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_T (psi:grade) (A:tm)
 | a_Box (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Unbox (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_SSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_SPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Proj1 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Proj2 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Bool : tm
 | a_True : tm
 | a_False : tm
 | a_If (a:tm) (b0:tm) (b1:tm).

Definition econtext : Type := list ( atom * grade ).

Inductive headform : Type :=
 | h_Abs : headform
 | h_Pi (psi:grade)
 | h_Type (s:sort)
 | h_CEq (psi:grade) (psi0:grade)
 | h_Refl : headform
 | h_T (psi:grade)
 | h_Box (psi:grade)
 | h_SSigma (psi:grade)
 | h_SPair : headform
 | h_TyUnit : headform
 | h_TmUnit : headform
 | h_Bool : headform
 | h_True : headform
 | h_False : headform.

Definition context : Type := list ( atom * (grade * tm) ).

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b0) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1)
end.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:var) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
       if (lt_dec nat k)
         then a_Var_b nat
         else a_Var_b (S nat)
  | (a_Var_f x) => if (a5 === x) then (a_Var_b k) else (a_Var_f x)
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b0) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1)
end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm a_6 a5 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B))
 | lc_a_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a psi b))
 | lc_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     (lc_tm (a_Type s))
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_CEq : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A))
 | lc_a_Refl :
     (lc_tm a_Refl)
 | lc_a_Transp : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Transp a b))
 | lc_a_T : forall (psi:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_T psi A))
 | lc_a_Box : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Box psi a))
 | lc_a_Unbox : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Unbox psi a))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj1 psi a))
 | lc_a_Proj2 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj2 psi a))
 | lc_a_Bool :
     (lc_tm a_Bool)
 | lc_a_True :
     (lc_tm a_True)
 | lc_a_False :
     (lc_tm a_False)
 | lc_a_If : forall (a b0 b1:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b0) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm (a_If a b0 b1)).

Fixpoint fv_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Type s) => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b) \u (fv_tm A)
  | a_Refl => {}
  | (a_Transp a b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_T psi A) => (fv_tm A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | a_Bool => {}
  | a_True => {}
  | a_False => {}
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b0) \u (fv_tm b1)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b) psi0 (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b0) (subst_tm a5 x5 b1)
end.

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm a x A))).

Definition tm_to_headform (a : tm) : option headform :=
  match a with
  | a_Abs _ _ _ => Some h_Abs
  | a_Pi psi _ _ => Some (h_Pi psi)
  | a_Type s => Some (h_Type s)
  | a_CEq psi _ _ psi0 _ => Some (h_CEq psi psi0)
  | a_Refl => Some h_Refl
  | a_Box psi _ => Some (h_Box psi)
  | a_T psi _ => Some (h_T psi)
  | a_SPair _ _ _ => Some h_SPair
  | a_SSigma psi _ _ => Some (h_SSigma psi)
  | a_TyUnit => Some h_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => Some h_TmUnit
  | a_Bool => Some h_Bool
  | a_True => Some h_True
  | a_False => Some h_False
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition Consistent (a b : tm) : Prop :=
  match tm_to_headform a, tm_to_headform b with
  | Some h1, Some h2 => h1 = h2
  | _, _ => True
  end.

Definition Value (a : tm) : bool :=
  match a with
  | a_SPair _ _ _ => true
  | a_SSigma _ _ _ => true
  | a_Pi _ _ _ => true
  | a_Abs _ _ _ => true
  | a_Type _ => true
  | a_CEq _ _ _ _ _ => true
  | a_Refl => true
  | a_Box psi _ => true
  | a_T psi _ => true
  | a_TyUnit => true
  | a_TmUnit => true
  | a_Bool => true
  | a_True => true
  | a_False => true
  | _ => false
  end.

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive P_meet : econtext -> econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | PM_Empty :
     P_meet  nil   nil   nil
 | PM_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade) (P3:econtext),
     P_meet P1 P2 P3 ->
     P_meet  (  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )  )   (  (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 )  )   (  (  ( x ~  ( psi1  `&`  psi2 )  )  ++ P3 )  ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive GDefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | GE_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | GE_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | GE_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     GDefEq P psi b a
 | GE_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b b0:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b0 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b ->
     GDefEq P psi a b
 | GE_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b0:tm) (psi0:grade) (a0 b1 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App b1 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 b0 A1 b1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A0 b0) (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1)
 | GE_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A0 B0) (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1)
 | GE_AppAbs : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a0 b1 A:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a0) ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_App a psi0 b0)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a0   b1 )
 | GE_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_Refl a_Refl
 | GE_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
 | GE_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
 | GE_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_Refl ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1
 | GE_T : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A B ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
 | GE_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
 | GE_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
 | GE_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) b
 | GE_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
 | GE_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 b) a2
 | GE_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
 | GE_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)
 | GE_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | GE_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | GE_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_Bool a_Bool
 | GE_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_True a_True
 | GE_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_False a_False
 | GE_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
 | GE_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_True ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b2
 | GE_IfFalse : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b3 b2:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_False ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3
with CGDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CGE_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b
 | CGE_NLeq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b.

Inductive DefEq : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | E_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm) (psi:grade),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P a b
 | E_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (a b b0:tm),
     DefEq P a b0 ->
     DefEq P b0 b ->
     DefEq P a b.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s) ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W )  ->
     Ctx  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )
with Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
     Ctx W ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
     Ctx W ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing W psi1  ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W psi0 a A ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     Typing W psi0 B (a_Type s) ->
     DefEq  (labels  W )  A B ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Refl : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (psi2:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi2  (a_CEq psi0 a a psi1 A)  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_Refl  (a_CEq psi0 a a psi1 A)
 | T_CEq : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (s2:sort) (psi2:grade) (s1:sort),
     Typing W psi1 a A ->
     Typing W psi1 b A ->
     Typing W psi2 A (a_Type s1) ->
      rule_eq  s1   s2  ->
      ( psi1  <=  psi0 )  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi  (a_CEq psi0 a b psi1 A)  (a_Type s2)
 | T_Transp : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi:grade) (a b B a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort) (a0:tm) (psi2:grade) (s1:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W )  psi0  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s) )  ->
     Typing W psi a  (a_CEq psi0 a0 a1 psi1 A)  ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a0 )  ->
      Typing W psi2 A (a_Type s1)  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Transp a b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a1 )
 | T_T : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s2 s1:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      rule_t  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Box : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a A ->
     Typing W psi1 (a_T psi0 A) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_T psi0 A)
 | T_Unbox : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_T psi0 A) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) A
 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi1 (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi0 a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W psi0 (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
      rule_unit  s  ->
     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a_TyUnit (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_TmUnit a_TyUnit
 | T_Bool : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
      rule_bool  s  ->
     Typing W psi a_Bool (a_Type s)
 | T_True : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a_Bool (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_True a_Bool
 | T_False : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi0 a_Bool (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a_False a_Bool
 | T_If : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a b0 b1 A:tm),
     Typing W psi a a_Bool ->
     Typing W psi b0 A ->
     Typing W psi b1 A ->
     Typing W psi (a_If a b0 b1) A.

Inductive Red : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | R_App : forall (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a1:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Red a0 a1 ->
     Red (a_App a0 psi0 b) (a_App a1 psi0 b)
 | R_AppAbs : forall (psi0:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Red (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a) )  psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | R_Transp : forall (a b a0:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Red a a0 ->
     Red (a_Transp a b) (a_Transp a0 b)
 | R_TranspRefl : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Red (a_Transp a_Refl a) a
 | R_Unbox : forall (psi0:grade) (a a0:tm),
     Red a a0 ->
     Red (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 a0)
 | R_UnboxBox : forall (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Red (a_Unbox psi0  ( (a_Box psi0 a) ) ) a
 | R_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | R_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | R_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Red (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | R_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Red (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | R_If : forall (a b0 b1 a':tm),
     lc_tm b0 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_If a b0 b1) (a_If a' b0 b1)
 | R_IfTrue : forall (b0 b1:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b0 ->
     Red (a_If a_True b0 b1) b0
 | R_IfFalse : forall (b0 b1:tm),
     lc_tm b0 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     Red (a_If a_False b0 b1) b1.

Inductive Reds : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Rs_Refl : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Reds a a
 | Rs_Step : forall (a0 a1 b:tm),
     Red a0 b ->
     Reds b a1 ->
     Reds a0 a1.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Par P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | Par_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     lc_tm A1 ->
     lc_tm A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_Refl a_Refl
 | Par_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
 | Par_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
 | Par_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a_Refl ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1
 | Par_T : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Par P psi A B ->
     Par P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
 | Par_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a b ->
     Par P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
 | Par_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
 | Par_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) b
 | Par_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
 | Par_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
 | Par_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
 | Par_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
     Par P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->

     Par P psi b0 b1 ->

 | Par_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->

 | Par_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | Par_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->

 | Par_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_True a_True
 | Par_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->

     Par P psi b1 b3 ->

     Par P psi a0 a_True ->
     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b2
 | Par_IfFalse : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b3 b2:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a_False ->
     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3.

Inductive EPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EP_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm) (psi:grade),
     Par P psi a b ->
     EPar P a b.

Inductive EMPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EMP_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm),
     EPar P a b ->
     EMPar P a b
 | EMP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (a a' b:tm),
     EPar P a b ->
     EMPar P b a' ->
     EMPar P a a'.

Inductive EJoins : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EJ_ejoins : forall (P:econtext) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     EMPar P a1 b ->
     EMPar P a2 b ->
     EJoins P a1 a2.

Inductive MultiPar : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | MP_One : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi a b
 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
     MultiPar P psi a a'.

Inductive Joins : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | join : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     MultiPar P psi a1 b ->
     MultiPar P psi a2 b ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2.

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CMP_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Inductive CJoins : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CJ_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2 ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CJ_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2.

OK. The Metalib environment provides uniq/nil/app/binds/dom lemmas. Let me search for relevant ones specifically: uniq_cons, binds_app, dom_app, fresh, notin, etc. Also `Metatheory.EnvImpl` names are accessible via e.g. `Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons`? Let me list.

But before investing in the huge formalization, I want to make a strategic decision. Let me look at this from the perspective of "what's the minimum soundness result needed" again, and see if we can find a clever *semantic* but shallow model.

Required facts:
(K) For X ∈ {a_Type s, a_Pi psi A B, a_TyUnit, a_TmUnit, a_CEq psi a b psi0 A, a_SSigma psi A B, a_T psi A} (values), DefEq nil X a_Bool is impossible. Note: a_Bool is a value with head h_Bool; X heads: h_Type, h_Pi, h_TyUnit, h_TmUnit, h_CEq, h_SSigma, h_T.

Maybe we can prove a general lemma: DefEq nil a b with a, b values ⇒ same headform. Where DefEq = chain of GDefEq. Since GDefEq itself may relate value to non-value (Sym of beta), the chain's intermediates can be non-values, but the *endpoints* are values. Hmm—maybe we can prove a "headform invariant along chains" using a *different* function that is invariant under GDefEq even across beta, and injective on value heads! That is, find an invariant f : tm -> something with:
- GDefEq P ψ a b ⇒ f a = f b (with maybe P/ψ dependence? no, GDefEq at different grades should still preserve f).
- f distinguishes a_Type s from a_Bool, a_Pi from a_Bool, etc. (for closed values).
If such f exists and is easy, we win K without confluence! Does such f exist? GDefEq includes beta: f(App a b) = f(open a0 b1) for related a~Abs a0 and C-related b,b1. If f were, say, the *head constructor after full reduction* ("semantic head"), then values have their own head and beta reduces to the body's head. But without SN/normalization, "fully reduced head" may be undefined for diverging terms; but f could be a *set* of possible heads or a partial value in a flat domain. Specifically, define the "semantic head" as the set of headforms reachable by weak-head reduction? For values, the set is {own head}. For True vs False sets differ ✓. For Type vs Bool differ ✓. For GDefEq-related terms, do the sets coincide? GDefEq's rules include changing arguments arbitrarily at irrelevant grades — weak-head reduction doesn't change them (arguments not evaluated?) — hmm, but Par's/ GDefEq's AppAbs opens the body with b1 related to b0, which changes the argument; weak-head of the redex opens with the *actual* argument b0. If b1 ≠ b0, the resulting terms differ but might have the same head set? At grades where the argument is irrelevant, the body's head should be independent of the argument... unless the body uses the variable at an irrelevant position, where head is unaffected? Now let's examine what we can prove easily:
- `binds_map_3` probably: binds x b (map f E) ↔ ∃a, f a = b ∧ binds x a E. Let's check.
- `dom_map`: dom (map f E) = dom E.
- `uniq_map_2`: uniq E → uniq (map f E). For labels: map (fun '(x,psi) => psi)? labels is `map (fun '(u,s) => u)` where u:atom? Wait labels : context -> econtext := map (fun '(u,s) => u). context entries are (atom, (grade, tm)); econtext entries are (atom, grade). The `map` here is EnvImpl.map with f : (grade*tm) -> grade.   | a_Var_f _ => 1
  | a_TyUnit => 1
  | a_TmUnit => 1
  | a_Type _ => 1
  | a_Refl => 1
  | a_Bool => 1
  | a_True => 1
  | a_False => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => S (tsize A + tsize B)
  | a_Abs _ A B => S (tsize A + tsize B)
  | a_SSigma _ A B => S (tsize A + tsize B)
  | a_App a _ b => S (tsize a + tsize b)
  | a_Transp a b => S (tsize a + tsize b)
  | a_SPair a _ b => S (tsize a + tsize b)
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => S (tsize a + tsize b + tsize A)
  | a_T _ A => S (tsize A)
  | a_Box _ A => S (tsize A)
  | a_Unbox _ A => S (tsize A)
  | a_Proj1 _ A => S (tsize A)
  | a_Proj2 _ A => S (tsize A)
  | a_If a b c => S (tsize a + tsize b + tsize c)

Typing W psi a_False a_Bool
 | T_If : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a b0 b1 A:tm),

Inductive Red : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | R_App : forall (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a1:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Red a0 a1 ->
     Red (a_App a0 psi0 b) (a_App a1 psi0 b)
 | R_AppAbs : forall (psi0:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Red (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a) )  psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | R_Transp : forall (a b a0:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Red a a0 ->
     Red (a_Transp a b) (a_Transp a0 b)
 | R_TranspRefl : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Red (a_Transp a_Refl a) a
 | R_Unbox : forall (psi0:grade) (a a0:tm),
     Red a a0 ->
     Red (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 a0)
 | R_UnboxBox : forall (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Red (a_Unbox psi0  ( (a_Box psi0 a) ) ) a
 | R_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | R_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | R_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Red (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | R_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Red (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | R_If : forall (a b0 b1 a':tm),
     lc_tm b0 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     Red a a' ->
     Red (a_If a b0 b1) (a_If a' b0 b1)
 | R_IfTrue : forall (b0 b1:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b0 ->
     Red (a_If a_True b0 b1) b0
 | R_IfFalse : forall (b0 b1:tm),
     lc_tm b0 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     Red (a_If a_False b0 b1) b1.

Inductive Reds : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Rs_Refl : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Reds a a
 | Rs_Step : forall (a0 a1 b:tm),
     Red a0 b ->
     Reds b a1 ->
     Reds a0 a1.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2

 | Par_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),

      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)

     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     lc_tm A1 ->
     lc_tm A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_Refl a_Refl
 | Par_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
 | Par_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
 | Par_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a_Refl ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1

     Par P psi A B ->
     Par P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
 | Par_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a b ->
     Par P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
 | Par_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
 | Par_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) b
 | Par_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
 | Par_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
 | Par_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
 | Par_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
     Par P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 b) a2
 | Par_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
     Par P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
 | Par_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     Par P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)
 | Par_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Par_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | Par_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_Bool a_Bool
 | Par_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_True a_True
 | Par_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_False a_False
 | Par_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
 | Par_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a_True ->
     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b2
 | Par_IfFalse : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b3 b2:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a_False ->
     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3.

Inductive EPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EP_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm) (psi:grade),
     Par P psi a b ->
     EPar P a b.

Inductive EMPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EMP_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm),
     EPar P a b ->
     EMPar P a b
 | EMP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (a a' b:tm),
     EPar P a b ->
     EMPar P b a' ->
     EMPar P a a'.

Inductive EJoins : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EJ_ejoins : forall (P:econtext) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     EMPar P a1 b ->
     EMPar P a2 b ->
     EJoins P a1 a2.

Inductive MultiPar : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | MP_One : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi a b
 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
     MultiPar P psi a a'.

Inductive Joins : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | join : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     MultiPar P psi a1 b ->
     MultiPar P psi a2 b ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2.

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CMP_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Inductive CJoins : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CJ_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2 ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CJ_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2.

     EPar P a b ->
     EMPar P b a' ->
     EMPar P a a'.

Inductive EJoins : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=

      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->

     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export Qual.grade_sig.

Require Export Qual.sort_sig.

From mathcomp Require Import ssreflect ssrbool.

Local Open Scope order_scope.

Local Close Scope bool_scope.

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition qualityvar : Set := atom.

Inductive tm : Type :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_Pi (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Abs (psi:grade) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Type (s:sort)
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_CEq (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm)
 | a_Refl : tm
 | a_Transp (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_T (psi:grade) (A:tm)
 | a_Box (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Unbox (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_SSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_SPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Proj1 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Proj2 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Bool : tm
 | a_True : tm
 | a_False : tm
 | a_If (a:tm) (b0:tm) (b1:tm).

Definition econtext : Type := list ( atom * grade ).

Inductive headform : Type :=
 | h_Abs : headform
 | h_Pi (psi:grade)
 | h_Type (s:sort)
 | h_CEq (psi:grade) (psi0:grade)
 | h_Refl : headform
 | h_T (psi:grade)
 | h_Box (psi:grade)
 | h_SSigma (psi:grade)
 | h_SPair : headform
 | h_TyUnit : headform
 | h_TmUnit : headform
 | h_Bool : headform
 | h_True : headform
 | h_False : headform.

Definition context : Type := list ( atom * (grade * tm) ).

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm a x A))).

Definition tm_to_headform (a : tm) : option headform :=
  match a with
  | a_Abs _ _ _ => Some h_Abs
  | a_Pi psi _ _ => Some (h_Pi psi)
  | a_Type s => Some (h_Type s)
  | a_CEq psi _ _ psi0 _ => Some (h_CEq psi psi0)
  | a_Refl => Some h_Refl
  | a_Box psi _ => Some (h_Box psi)
  | a_T psi _ => Some (h_T psi)
  | a_SPair _ _ _ => Some h_SPair
  | a_SSigma psi _ _ => Some (h_SSigma psi)
  | a_TyUnit => Some h_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => Some h_TmUnit
  | a_Bool => Some h_Bool
  | a_True => Some h_True
  | a_False => Some h_False
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition Consistent (a b : tm) : Prop :=
  match tm_to_headform a, tm_to_headform b with
  | Some h1, Some h2 => h1 = h2
  | _, _ => True
  end.

Definition Value (a : tm) : bool :=
  match a with
  | a_SPair _ _ _ => true
  | a_SSigma _ _ _ => true
  | a_Pi _ _ _ => true
  | a_Abs _ _ _ => true
  | a_Type _ => true
  | a_CEq _ _ _ _ _ => true
  | a_Refl => true
  | a_Box psi _ => true
  | a_T psi _ => true
  | a_TyUnit => true
  | a_TmUnit => true
  | a_Bool => true
  | a_True => true
  | a_False => true
  | _ => false
  end.

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive P_meet : econtext -> econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | PM_Empty :
     P_meet  nil   nil   nil
 | PM_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade) (P3:econtext),
     P_meet P1 P2 P3 ->
     P_meet  (  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )  )   (  (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 )  )   (  (  ( x ~  ( psi1  `&`  psi2 )  )  ++ P3 )  ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.
Local Hint Constructors GDefEq CGDefEq : core.
Lemma GDefEq_irrel_subst : forall P psi a b, GDefEq P psi a b ->
  forall x g u,
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
    ~ (g <= psi) -> lc_tm u ->
    (GDefEq P psi (subst_tm u x a) a /\ GDefEq P psi (subst_tm u x b) b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  apply (@GDefEq_mutind
    (fun P psi a b _ => forall x g u,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
      ~ (g <= psi) -> lc_tm u ->
      GDefEq P psi (subst_tm u x a) a /\ GDefEq P psi (subst_tm u x b) b)
    (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => forall x g u,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
      ~ (g <= psi) -> lc_tm u ->
      CGDefEq P psi psi0 (subst_tm u x a) a /\ CGDefEq P psi psi0 (subst_tm u x b) b)).
  all: try (intros; simpl in *; eauto).
  - (* Var *)
    destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x x0) as [->|Hne]; simpl.
    + exfalso. have Hg : g = psi1 by exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_unique grade x0 g psi1 P0 H1 b0 H0). subst g. exact (H2 i).
    + split.
      * eapply GE_Var; [exact u|exact i|exact b0].
      * eapply GE_Var; [exact u|exact i|exact b0].
  - (* Sym *) split; [exact (proj2 (H0 x g0 u H1 H2 H3 H4)) | exact (proj1 (H0 x g0 u H1 H2 H3 H4))].
  - (* Trans *) split; [exact (proj1 (H0 x g1 u H2 H3 H4 H5)) | exact (proj2 (H1 x g1 u H2 H3 H4 H5))].
  - (* App *)
    split.
    + eapply GE_App; [exact (proj1 (H0 x g0 u H2 H3 H4 H5)) | exact (proj1 (H1 x g0 u H2 H3 H4 H5))].
    + eapply GE_App; [exact (proj2 (H0 x g0 u H2 H3 H4 H5)) | exact (proj2 (H1 x g0 u H2 H3 H4 H5))].
Show 1.
Show 2.
Show 3.
Show 4.
Show 5.
Show 6.
Abort.

Lemma binds_one_self_gen : forall (A:Type) (P:list (MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom * A)) x a,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x a (P ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, a)).
Proof.
  move=> A P x a. apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_app_iff. right.
  apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_one_iff A x x a a). split; done.
Qed.
Lemma uniq_app_one_l_gen : forall (A:Type) (P:list (MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom*A)) x a,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq (P ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,a)) ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> A P x a H. exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_app_1 A P (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,a)) H).
Qed.
Lemma binds_app_one_neq_gen : forall (A:Type) (P:list (MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom*A)) x a y b,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y b (P ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,a)) -> y <> x ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y b P.
Proof.
  move=> A P x a y b H Hne.
  apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H]; auto.
  apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_one_iff A y x b a) in H. destruct H as [E1 E2].
  exfalso. apply Hne. exact E1.
Qed.
Lemma subst_ctx_cons : forall u x (y:MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom) g B (W:context),
  subst_ctx u x ((y, (g,B)) :: W) =
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (y, (g, subst_tm u x B)) ++ subst_ctx u x W.
Proof.
  move=> u x y g B W. unfold subst_ctx.
  rewrite Metatheory.EnvImpl.map_cons. done.
Qed.
Lemma labels_subst_ctx : forall u x (W:context), labels (subst_ctx u x W) = labels W.
Proof.
  move=> u x W. induction W as [|[y [g B]] W IH].
  - unfold subst_ctx, labels. simpl. done.
  - rewrite subst_ctx_cons. rewrite labels_app. simpl. rewrite IH. done.
Qed.
EOF

282	  | a_Abs _ _ _ => true
283	  | a_Type _ => true

297	 | P_Empty :
298	     P_sub  nil   nil
299	 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
300	      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
301	     P_sub P1 P2 ->
302	      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
303	      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->

307	 | PM_Empty :
308	     P_meet  nil   nil   nil
309	 | PM_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade) (P3:econtext),
310	     P_meet P1 P2 P3 ->
311	     P_meet  (  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )  )   (  (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 )  )   (  (  ( x ~  ( psi1  `&`  psi2 )  )  ++ P3 )  ) .

318	     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
319	      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
320	      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->

323	Inductive GDefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
324	 | GE_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
325	      uniq  P  ->
326	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
327	      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
328	     GDefEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
329	 | GE_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
330	      uniq  P  ->
331	     GDefEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
332	 | GE_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
333	     GDefEq P psi a b ->
334	     GDefEq P psi b a
335	 | GE_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b b0:tm),
336	     GDefEq P psi a b0 ->
337	     GDefEq P psi b0 b ->
338	     GDefEq P psi a b
339	 | GE_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b0:tm) (psi0:grade) (a0 b1 a1:tm),
340	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
341	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
342	     GDefEq P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App b1 psi0 a1)
343	 | GE_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 b0 A1 b1:tm),
344	     lc_tm A0 ->
345	     lc_tm A1 ->
346	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
347	     GDefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A0 b0) (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1)
348	 | GE_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
349	     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
350	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
351	     GDefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A0 B0) (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1)
352	 | GE_AppAbs : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a0 b1 A:tm),
353	     GDefEq P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a0) ->
354	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 b0 b1 ->
355	     GDefEq P psi (a_App a psi0 b0)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a0   b1 )
356	 | GE_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
357	      uniq  P  ->
358	     GDefEq P psi a_Refl a_Refl
359	 | GE_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
360	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
361	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
362	     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
363	 | GE_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
364	     lc_tm A0 ->
365	     lc_tm A1 ->
366	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
367	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
368	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
369	     GDefEq P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
370	 | GE_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
371	     GDefEq P psi a0 a_Refl ->
372	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
373	     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1
374	 | GE_T : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
375	     GDefEq P psi A B ->
376	     GDefEq P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
377	 | GE_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
378	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b ->
379	     GDefEq P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
380	 | GE_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
381	     GDefEq P psi a b ->
382	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
383	     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
384	 | GE_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
385	     GDefEq P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
386	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
387	     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) b
388	 | GE_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
389	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
390	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
391	     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
392	 | GE_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
393	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
394	     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
395	 | GE_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
396	     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
397	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
398	     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
399	 | GE_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
400	     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
401	     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 b) a2
402	 | GE_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),
403	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
404	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
405	     GDefEq P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
406	 | GE_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
407	     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
408	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
409	     GDefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)
410	 | GE_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
411	      uniq  P  ->
412	     GDefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
413	 | GE_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
414	      uniq  P  ->
415	     GDefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
416	 | GE_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
417	      uniq  P  ->
418	     GDefEq P psi a_Bool a_Bool
419	 | GE_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
420	      uniq  P  ->
421	     GDefEq P psi a_True a_True
422	 | GE_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
423	      uniq  P  ->
424	     GDefEq P psi a_False a_False
425	 | GE_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
426	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
427	     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
428	     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
429	     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
430	 | GE_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),
431	     GDefEq P psi a0 a_True ->
432	     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
433	     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
434	     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b2
435	 | GE_IfFalse : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b3 b2:tm),
436	     GDefEq P psi a0 a_False ->
437	     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
438	     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
439	     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3
440	with CGDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
441	 | CGE_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
442	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
443	     GDefEq P psi a b ->
444	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b
445	 | CGE_NLeq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
446	     lc_tm a ->
447	     lc_tm b ->
448	      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
449	      uniq  P  ->
450	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b.

463	     Ctx  nil
464	 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (psi:grade) (s:sort),

475	     Ctx W ->
476	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
477	      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
478	     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
479	 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
480	     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
481	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
482	      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
483	     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)

486	     Typing W psi1  ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
487	     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
488	 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
489	     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
490	     Typing W psi0 a A ->
491	     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
492	 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (psi0:grade) (s:sort),
493	     Typing W psi a A ->
494	     Typing W psi0 B (a_Type s) ->
495	     DefEq  (labels  W )  A B ->
496	     Typing W psi a B
497	 | T_Refl : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (psi2:grade) (s:sort),
498	     Typing W psi2  (a_CEq psi0 a a psi1 A)  (a_Type s) ->
499	     Typing W psi a_Refl  (a_CEq psi0 a a psi1 A)
500	 | T_CEq : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (s2:sort) (psi2:grade) (s1:sort),
501	     Typing W psi1 a A ->
502	     Typing W psi1 b A ->
503	     Typing W psi2 A (a_Type s1) ->
504	      rule_eq  s1   s2  ->
505	      ( psi1  <=  psi0 )  ->
506	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
507	     Typing W psi  (a_CEq psi0 a b psi1 A)  (a_Type s2)
508	 | T_Transp : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi:grade) (a b B a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort) (a0:tm) (psi2:grade) (s1:sort),
509	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W )  psi0  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s) )  ->
510	     Typing W psi a  (a_CEq psi0 a0 a1 psi1 A)  ->
511	     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a0 )  ->
512	      Typing W psi2 A (a_Type s1)  ->
513	     Typing W psi (a_Transp a b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a1 )
514	 | T_T : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s2 s1:sort),
515	     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
516	      rule_t  s1   s2  ->
517	     Typing W psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_Type s2)
518	 | T_Box : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),

521	     Typing W psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_T psi0 A)

525	     Typing W psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) A
526	 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
527	     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
528	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
529	      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
530	     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
531	 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (psi1:grade) (s:sort),
532	     Typing W psi1 (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
533	     Typing W psi0 a A ->
534	     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->

536	 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),

538	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
539	     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
540	 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),

543	     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
544	 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
545	     Ctx W ->
546	      rule_unit  s  ->
547	     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
548	 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),
549	     Typing W psi0 a_TyUnit (a_Type s) ->

551	 | T_Bool : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
552	     Ctx W ->
553	      rule_bool  s  ->
554	     Typing W psi a_Bool (a_Type s)
555	 | T_True : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),

557	     Typing W psi a_True a_Bool
558	 | T_False : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (s:sort),

561	 | T_If : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a b0 b1 A:tm),

Lemma Par_subst_cond : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b ->
  forall x psi0 u1 u2,
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 P ->
    lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 ->
    (psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
    Par P psi (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b Hpar.
  apply (@Par_mutind
    (fun P psi a b _ => forall x psi0 u1 u2,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 P ->
      lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 -> (psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
      Par P psi (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b))
    (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => forall x g u1 u2,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
      lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 -> (g <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
      CPar P psi psi0 (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b))).
  all: try (intros; simpl in *; eauto).
  - destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x x0) as [e|Hne].
    + subst x0. simpl.
      have E : psi2 = psi1 by exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_unique grade x psi2 psi1 P0 H0 b0 u).
      subst psi2. exact (H3 i).
    + simpl. exact (@Par_Var P0 psi0 x psi1 u i b0).
  - eapply Par_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0))).
    + exact (@H x psi2 u1 u2 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5).
    + move=> y Hy.
      have HyL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 y L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0)) Hy.
      have HyRest : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0)) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 y L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0)) Hy.
      have HyS : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0) HyRest.
      have Hydom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0) HyRest.
      have Hyx : y <> x.
      { intro e. apply HyS. rewrite e. apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. done. }
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B1 u1 x y H3 (fun e => Hyx (eq_sym e)))
              (@subst_open_var B2 u2 x y H4 (fun e => Hyx (eq_sym e))).
      refine (@H0 y HyL x _ u1 u2 _ _ _ _ _).
      * apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push; [exact H1|exact Hydom].
      * unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. right. match goal with H : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x _ P0 |- _ => exact H end.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.
      * intro Hle. apply (@Par_weaken P0 _ u1 u2 (H5 Hle) ((y, _) :: P0)).
        -- move=> aa gg Haa. unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. right. match goal with H : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds aa _ P0 |- _ => exact H end.
        -- apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push; [exact H1|exact Hydom].
  - rewrite (@subst_open_rec a' 0 u2 x b' H4).
    eapply Par_AppBeta.
    + exact (@H x _ u1 u2 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5).
    + exact (@H0 x _ u1 u2 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5).
  - eapply Par_Abs with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0))).
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst A1 u1 x l H2).
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst A2 u2 x l0 H3).
    + move=> y Hy.
      have HyL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 y L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0)) Hy.
      have HyRest : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0)) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 y L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0)) Hy.
      have HyS : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0) HyRest.
      have Hydom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0) HyRest.
      have Hyx : y <> x.
      { intro e. apply HyS. rewrite e. apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. done. }
      rewrite (@subst_open_var b1 u1 x y H2 (fun e => Hyx (eq_sym e)))
              (@subst_open_var b2 u2 x y H3 (fun e => Hyx (eq_sym e))).
      refine (@H y HyL x _ u1 u2 _ _ _ _ _).
      * apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push; [exact H0|exact Hydom].
      * unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. right. match goal with H : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x _ P0 |- _ => exact H end.
      * exact H2.
      * exact H3.
      * intro Hle. apply (@Par_weaken P0 _ u1 u2 (H4 Hle) ((y, _) :: P0)).
        -- move=> aa gg Haa. unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. right. match goal with H : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds aa _ P0 |- _ => exact H end.
        -- apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push; [exact H0|exact Hydom].
  - eapply Par_CEq.
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst A0 u1 x l H3).
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst A1 u2 x l0 H4).
    + exact (@H x _ u1 u2 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5).
    + exact (@H0 x _ u1 u2 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5).
    + exact i.
  - eapply Par_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0))).
    + exact (@H x psi2 u1 u2 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5).
    + move=> y Hy.
      have HyL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 y L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0)) Hy.
      have HyRest : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0)) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 y L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0)) Hy.
      have HyS : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0) HyRest.
      have Hydom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 y (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0) HyRest.
      have Hyx : y <> x.
      { intro e. apply HyS. rewrite e. apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. done. }
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B0 u1 x y H3 (fun e => Hyx (eq_sym e)))
              (@subst_open_var B1 u2 x y H4 (fun e => Hyx (eq_sym e))).
      refine (@H0 y HyL x _ u1 u2 _ _ _ _ _).
      * apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push; [exact H1|exact Hydom].
      * unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. right. match goal with H : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x _ P0 |- _ => exact H end.
      * exact H3.
      * exact H4.
      * intro Hle. apply (@Par_weaken P0 _ u1 u2 (H5 Hle) ((y, _) :: P0)).
        -- move=> aa gg Haa. unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. right. match goal with H : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds aa _ P0 |- _ => exact H end.
        -- apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push; [exact H1|exact Hydom].
Qed.

220	Fixpoint subst_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
221	  match a_6 with
222	  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
223	  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
224	  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
225	  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
226	  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
227	  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
228	  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
229	  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
230	  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b) psi0 (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
231	  | a_Refl => a_Refl
232	  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
233	  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
234	  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
235	  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
236	  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
237	  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
238	  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
239	  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
240	  | a_Bool => a_Bool
241	  | a_True => a_True
242	  | a_False => a_False
243	  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b0) (subst_tm a5 x5 b1)
244	end.

252	Definition tm_to_headform (a : tm) : option headform :=
253	  match a with
254	  | a_Abs _ _ _ => Some h_Abs
255	  | a_Pi psi _ _ => Some (h_Pi psi)
256	  | a_Type s => Some (h_Type s)
257	  | a_CEq psi _ _ psi0 _ => Some (h_CEq psi psi0)
258	  | a_Refl => Some h_Refl
259	  | a_Box psi _ => Some (h_Box psi)
260	  | a_T psi _ => Some (h_T psi)
261	  | a_SPair _ _ _ => Some h_SPair
262	  | a_SSigma psi _ _ => Some (h_SSigma psi)
263	  | a_TyUnit => Some h_TyUnit
264	  | a_TmUnit => Some h_TmUnit
265	  | a_Bool => Some h_Bool
266	  | a_True => Some h_True
267	  | a_False => Some h_False
268	  | _ => None
269	  end.

271	Definition Consistent (a b : tm) : Prop :=
272	  match tm_to_headform a, tm_to_headform b with
273	  | Some h1, Some h2 => h1 = h2
274	  | _, _ => True

324	 | GE_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),

326	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
327	      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
328	     GDefEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
329	 | GE_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
330	      uniq  P  ->
331	     GDefEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
332	 | GE_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
333	     GDefEq P psi a b ->
334	     GDefEq P psi b a
335	 | GE_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b b0:tm),
336	     GDefEq P psi a b0 ->
337	     GDefEq P psi b0 b ->
338	     GDefEq P psi a b
339	 | GE_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b0:tm) (psi0:grade) (a0 b1 a1:tm),
340	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
341	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
342	     GDefEq P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App b1 psi0 a1)
343	 | GE_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 b0 A1 b1:tm),
