345	     lc_tm A1 ->
346	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
347	     GDefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A0 b0) (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1)
348	 | GE_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
349	     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
350	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
351	     GDefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A0 B0) (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1)
352	 | GE_AppAbs : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a0 b1 A:tm),
353	     GDefEq P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a0) ->
354	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 b0 b1 ->
355	     GDefEq P psi (a_App a psi0 b0)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a0   b1 )
356	 | GE_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
357	      uniq  P  ->
358	     GDefEq P psi a_Refl a_Refl
359	 | GE_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
360	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
361	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
362	     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
363	 | GE_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
364	     lc_tm A0 ->
365	     lc_tm A1 ->
366	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
367	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
368	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
369	     GDefEq P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
370	 | GE_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
371	     GDefEq P psi a0 a_Refl ->
372	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
373	     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1
374	 | GE_T : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
375	     GDefEq P psi A B ->
376	     GDefEq P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
377	 | GE_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
378	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b ->
379	     GDefEq P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
380	 | GE_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
381	     GDefEq P psi a b ->
382	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
383	     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
384	 | GE_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
385	     GDefEq P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
386	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->

389	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
390	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
391	     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
392	 | GE_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
393	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
394	     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
395	 | GE_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
396	     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
397	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
398	     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
399	 | GE_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
400	     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
401	     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 b) a2
402	 | GE_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),
403	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
404	     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
405	     GDefEq P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
406	 | GE_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
407	     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
408	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
409	     GDefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)
410	 | GE_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
411	      uniq  P  ->
412	     GDefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
413	 | GE_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
414	      uniq  P  ->
415	     GDefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
416	 | GE_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
417	      uniq  P  ->
418	     GDefEq P psi a_Bool a_Bool
419	 | GE_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
420	      uniq  P  ->
421	     GDefEq P psi a_True a_True
422	 | GE_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
423	      uniq  P  ->
424	     GDefEq P psi a_False a_False
425	 | GE_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
426	     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
427	     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
428	     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
429	     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
430	 | GE_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),
431	     GDefEq P psi a0 a_True ->
432	     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
433	     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
434	     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b2
435	 | GE_IfFalse : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b3 b2:tm),
436	     GDefEq P psi a0 a_False ->
437	     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
438	     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
439	     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3
440	with CGDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
441	 | CGE_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),

443	     GDefEq P psi a b ->
444	     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b
445	 | CGE_NLeq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
446	     lc_tm a ->
447	     lc_tm b ->
448	      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
449	      uniq  P  ->

553	      rule_bool  s  ->

Lemma Typing_par_self : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A ->
  forall psi', psi <= psi' -> Par (labels W) psi' a a.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A H. induction H; intros psi' Hle; simpl in *.

Lemma Typing_App_inv_strong : forall W psi a psi0 b A,
  Typing W psi (a_App a psi0 b) A ->

Proof.
  move=> W psi a psi0 b A H.

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Context permutation and thinning helpers                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma binds_swap : forall (A:Type) (x y:MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom) (a b:A)
  (P:list (MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom * A)) z c,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds z c ((x,a)::(y,b)::P) <->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds z c ((y,b)::(x,a)::P).
Proof.
  move=> A x y a b P z c.
  unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_swap : forall (A:Type) (x y:MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom) (a b:A)
  (P:list (MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom * A)),
  x <> y ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x,a)::(y,b)::P) ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((y,b)::(x,a)::P).
Proof.
  move=> A x y a b P Hxy H.
  have HuP : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P :=
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 H).
  have HxP : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P).
  { apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 A x a ((y,b)::P)). exact H. }
  have HyP : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P).
  { apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 A y b P).
    exact (Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 H). }
  apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_3 A y b ((x,a)::P)).
  - apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_3 A x a P); assumption.
  - unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom. simpl.
    intro Hin. apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hin.
    destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in Hin. subst y. auto.
    + exact (HyP Hin).
Qed.

Lemma Par_swap : forall (P:econtext) psi a b x y gx gy,
  x <> y ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x,gx)::(y,gy)::P) ->
  Par ((x,gx)::(y,gy)::P) psi a b ->
  Par ((y,gy)::(x,gx)::P) psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b x y gx gy Hxy Hu H.
  eapply Par_weaken; [exact H| |].
  - move=> z c. apply binds_swap.
  - apply uniq_swap; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma CPar_swap : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b x y gx gy,
  x <> y ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x,gx)::(y,gy)::P) ->
  CPar ((x,gx)::(y,gy)::P) psi psi0 a b ->
  CPar ((y,gy)::(x,gx)::P) psi psi0 a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b x y gx gy Hxy Hu H.
  eapply CPar_weaken; [exact H| |].
  - move=> z c. apply binds_swap.
  - apply uniq_swap; assumption.
Qed.

(* General context equivalence: same binds + uniq *)
Lemma Par_ctx_iff : forall (P Q:econtext) psi a b,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq Q ->
  (forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P <->
              Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g Q) ->
  Par P psi a b -> Par Q psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P Q psi a b HuP HuQ Hb H.
  eapply Par_weaken; [exact H| |exact HuQ].
  move=> z c. exact (proj1 (Hb z c)).
Qed.

Lemma CPar_ctx_iff : forall (P Q:econtext) psi psi0 a b,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq Q ->
  (forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P <->
              Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g Q) ->
  CPar P psi psi0 a b -> CPar Q psi psi0 a b.
Proof.
  move=> P Q psi psi0 a b HuP HuQ Hb H.
  eapply CPar_weaken; [exact H| |exact HuQ].
  move=> z c. exact (proj1 (Hb z c)).
Qed.

(* If a term and its reduct do not mention x, then a binding of x in the
   context is unnecessary. *)
Lemma Par_drop : forall (P:econtext) x psi0 psi a b,
  Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi a b ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm b) ->
  Par P psi a b.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma CPar_drop : forall (P:econtext) x psi0 psi psi1 a b,
  CPar ((x,psi0)::P) psi psi1 a b ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm b) ->
  CPar P psi psi1 a b.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Open/substitute a body after dropping the fresh binder, yielding a
   Par judgement in the original context. *)
Lemma Par_open_subst : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 (A1 A3:tm) y u1 u2,
  y \notin fv_tm A1 ->
  y \notin fv_tm A3 ->
  y \notin fv_tm u1 ->
  y \notin fv_tm u2 ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P ->
  lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 ->
  (psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
  Par ((y,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm A1 (a_Var_f y))
                          (open_tm_wrt_tm A3 (a_Var_f y)) ->
  Par P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm A1 u1) (open_tm_wrt_tm A3 u2).
Proof.
Admitted.

(* Join of two CPar reducts of the same term, at the same grades. *)
Lemma CPar_join : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 x x1 x2,
  CPar P psi psi0 x x1 ->
  CPar P psi psi0 x x2 ->
  exists x3, lc_tm x3 /\ CPar P psi psi0 x1 x3 /\ CPar P psi psi0 x2 x3.
Proof.
Admitted.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Same-grade diamond for Par (and its companion for CPar).            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition DPar (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) : Prop :=
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.

Definition DCPar (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) : Prop :=
  forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 b d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d.

Lemma Par_diamond_mut :
  (forall (P:econtext) psi a b, Par P psi a b -> DPar P psi a b) /\
  (forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b, CPar P psi psi0 a b -> DCPar P psi psi0 a b).
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma Par_diamond : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj1 Par_diamond_mut P psi a b H).
Qed.

Lemma CPar_diamond : forall P psi psi0 a b, CPar P psi psi0 a b ->
  forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 b d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj2 Par_diamond_mut P psi psi0 a b H).
Qed.

Lemma Par_local_join : forall P psi a b c,
  Par P psi a b -> Par P psi a c -> EJoins P b c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b c H1 H2.
  destruct (Par_diamond H1 H2) as [d [Hb Hc]].
  eapply EJ_ejoins.
  - apply EMP_One, EP_One. exact Hb.
  - apply EMP_One, EP_One. exact Hc.
Qed.

  (forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b, CPar P psi psi0 a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P).
Proof.
  apply (@Par_mutind2
    (fun (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (_:Par P psi a b) =>
       Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P)
    (fun (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CPar P psi psi0 a b) =>
       Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P)).
  - (* Var *) move=> P1 psi x psi0 u i b. exact u.
  - (* Type *) move=> P1 psi s u. exact u.
  - (* Pi *) move=> L P1 psi psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2 p IHp p0 IHp0. exact IHp.
  - (* AppBeta *) move=> P1 psi a psi0 b a' b' A p IHp c IHc. exact IHp.
  - (* App *) move=> P1 psi a psi0 b a' b' p IHp c IHc. exact IHp.
  - (* Abs *) move=> L P1 psi psi0 A1 b1 A2 b2 l l0 p IHp.
    destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [z Hz].
    exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 grade z psi0 P1 (IHp z Hz)).
  - (* Refl *) move=> P1 psi u. exact u.
  - (* Transp *) move=> P1 psi a0 b0 a1 b1 p IHp p0 IHp0. exact IHp.
  - (* CEq *) move=> P1 psi psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0 a1 b1 A1 l l0 p IHp p0 IHp0 i. exact IHp.
  - (* TranspRefl *) move=> P1 psi a0 b0 b1 p IHp p0 IHp0. exact IHp.
  - (* T *) move=> P1 psi psi0 A B p IHp. exact IHp.
  - (* Box *) move=> P1 psi psi0 a b c IHc. exact IHc.
  - (* Unbox *) move=> P1 psi psi0 a b p IHp i. exact IHp.
  - (* UnboxBox *) move=> P1 psi psi0 a b p IHp i. exact IHp.
  - (* Proj1Cong *) move=> P1 psi psi0 a0 a1 p IHp i. exact IHp.
  - (* Proj2Cong *) move=> P1 psi psi0 a0 a1 p IHp. exact IHp.
  - (* Proj1Beta *) move=> P1 psi psi0 b a1 a2 p IHp i. exact IHp.
  - (* Proj2Beta *) move=> P1 psi psi0 b a2 a1 p IHp. exact IHp.
  - (* SPair *) move=> P1 psi a0 psi0 b0 a1 b1 c IHc p IHp. exact IHc.
  - (* SSigma *) move=> L P1 psi psi0 A0 B0 A1 B1 p IHp p0 IHp0. exact IHp.
  - (* TyUnit *) move=> P1 psi u. exact u.
  - (* TmUnit *) move=> P1 psi u. exact u.
  - (* Bool *) move=> P1 psi u. exact u.
  - (* True *) move=> P1 psi u. exact u.
  - (* False *) move=> P1 psi u. exact u.
  - (* If *) move=> P1 psi a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3 p IHp p0 IHp0 p1 IHp1. exact IHp.
  - (* IfTrue *) move=> P1 psi a0 b0 b1 b2 b3 p IHp p0 IHp0 p1 IHp1. exact IHp.
  - (* IfFalse *) move=> P1 psi a0 b0 b1 b3 b2 p IHp p0 IHp0 p1 IHp1. exact IHp.
  - (* CPar_Leq *) move=> P1 psi psi0 a1 a2 i p IHp. exact IHp.
  - (* CPar_Nleq *) move=> P1 psi psi0 a1 a2 l l0 n u. exact u.
Qed.

Lemma Par_uniq : forall (P:econtext) psi a b, Par P psi a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof. move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj1 Par_uniq_mut P psi a b H). Qed.

  CPar P psi psi0 a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof. move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj2 Par_uniq_mut P psi psi0 a b H). Qed.

     Par P psi a b ->

Lemma Par_subst : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b ->
  forall x psi0 u1 u2,
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 P ->
    Par P psi u1 u2 ->
    Par P psi (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b Hpar.
  apply (@Par_mutind
    (fun P psi a b _ => forall x psi0 u1 u2,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 P ->
      Par P psi u1 u2 ->
      Par P psi (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b))
    (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => forall x g u1 u2,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
      Par P psi u1 u2 ->
      CPar P psi psi0 (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b))).
  all: try (intros; simpl in *; eauto).
  - destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x x0) as [e|Hne].
    + subst x0. simpl. exact H1.
    + simpl. exact (@Par_Var P0 psi0 x psi1 u i b0).
  - eapply Par_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0))).

Lemma subst_tm_notin : forall a u x,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) -> subst_tm u x a = a.
Proof.
  move=> a. induction a; simpl in *; auto;
  try (intros u xx H).
  - (* Pi *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa1. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
    + apply IHa2. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
  - (* Abs *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa1. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
    + apply IHa2. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
  - (* App *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa1. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
    + apply IHa2. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
  - (* Var_f *) destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x xx) as [e|Hne].
    + subst xx. exfalso. exact (H (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2 x x eq_refl)).
    + auto.
  - (* CEq *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa1. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3))). exact H.
    + apply IHa2. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3)). apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3))). exact H.
    + apply IHa3. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3)). apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3))). exact H.
  - (* Transp *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa1. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
    + apply IHa2. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
  - (* T *) rewrite IHa; auto.
  - (* Box *) rewrite IHa; auto.
  - (* Unbox *) rewrite IHa; auto.
  - (* SSigma *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa1. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
    + apply IHa2. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
  - (* SPair *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa1. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
    + apply IHa2. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (fv_tm a2)). exact H.
  - (* Proj1 *) rewrite IHa; auto.
  - (* Proj2 *) rewrite IHa; auto.
  - (* If *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa1. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3))). exact H.
    + apply IHa2. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3)). apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3))). exact H.
    + apply IHa3. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3)). apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm a1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a2) (fv_tm a3))). exact H.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tm_var_same : forall u x, subst_tm u x (a_Var_f x) = u.

Lemma subst_open_self : forall body u x,
  lc_tm u -> ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm body) ->
  subst_tm u x (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x)) = open_tm_wrt_tm body u.
Proof.

  rewrite (@subst_open_rec body 0 u x (a_Var_f x) Hu).
  rewrite (@subst_tm_notin body u x Hfv).
  rewrite (@subst_tm_var_same u x). done.
Qed.

From Coq Require Import Lia.

Definition flab (p : grade * tm) : grade := fst p.

Lemma labels_cons : forall A W, labels (A :: W) = ((fst A, flab (snd A)) :: labels W).
Proof. by case. Qed.

Lemma labels_app : forall W1 W2, labels (W1 ++ W2) = (labels W1 ++ labels W2).
Proof. move=> W1 W2. unfold labels. rewrite Metatheory.EnvImpl.map_app. done. Qed.

Lemma binds_labels : forall W x psi A,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (psi,A) W -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi (labels W).
Proof. move=> W x psi A H. exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_map_2 (grade*tm) grade flab x (psi,A) W H). Qed.

Lemma binds_labels_inv : forall W x psi,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi (labels W) -> exists A, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (psi,A) W.
Proof.
  move=> W x psi H.
  move/(@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_map_3 (grade*tm) grade flab x psi W) in H.
  move: H => [[g A] [Ea Hb]]. exists A.
  move: Ea => /= Ea. rewrite Ea in Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_labels : forall W, Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq W -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq (labels W).
Proof. move=> W H. exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_map_2 (grade*tm) grade flab W H). Qed.

Ltac inv_red_value :=
  match goal with
  | h : Red (a_Abs _ _ _) _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red (a_Box _ _) _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red (a_SPair _ _ _) _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red (a_SSigma _ _ _) _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red (a_Pi _ _ _) _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red (a_Type _) _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red (a_CEq _ _ _ _ _) _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red a_Refl _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red a_TyUnit _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red a_TmUnit _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red a_Bool _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red a_True _ |- _ => inversion h
  | h : Red a_False _ |- _ => inversion h
  end.

Lemma Red_det : forall a b, Red a b -> forall c, Red a c -> b = c.
Proof.
  move=> a b H. elim: H.
  - move=> a0 psi0 b0 a1 hb hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi0 A a0 b0 hA hAbs hb c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> a0 b0 a1 hb hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> a0 ha c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi0 a0 a1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi0 a0 ha c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi a0 a1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi a0 a1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi a1 a2 ha2 ha1 c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi a1 a2 ha1 ha2 c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> a0 b0 b1 a' hb0 hb1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> b0 b1 hb1 hb0 c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> b0 b1 hb0 hb1 c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
Qed.

Lemma Red_value_impossible : forall a b, Value a -> Red a b -> False.
Proof.
  move=> a. case: a => //=; move=> *;
  match goal with h : Red _ _ |- False => inversion h end.
Qed.

Lemma Reds_value_inv : forall a b, Value a -> Reds a b -> b = a.
Proof.
  move=> a b hv hr. inversion hr; subst; auto.
  - exfalso. exact (Red_value_impossible hv H).
Qed.

Lemma Reds_det_value : forall a b c, Reds a b -> Reds a c -> Value b -> Value c -> b = c.
Proof.
  move=> a b c h1. elim: h1 => {a b}.
  - move=> a0 ha h2 hvb hvc. inversion h2; subst; auto.
    exfalso. exact (Red_value_impossible hvb H).
  - move=> a0 a1 b0 hr hb ih h2 hvb hvc. inversion h2; subst.
    + exfalso. exact (Red_value_impossible hvc hr).
    + move: (Red_det hr H) => E; subst b0. exact (ih H0 hvb hvc).
Qed.

(* ---------- de Bruijn locally closed predicate ---------- *)
Fixpoint lc_d (n:nat) (a:tm) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | a_Var_b k => lt k n
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi _ A B => lc_d n A /\ lc_d (S n) B
  | a_Abs _ A B => lc_d n A /\ lc_d (S n) B
  | a_App a _ b => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b /\ lc_d n A
  | a_Refl => True
  | a_Transp a b => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b
  | a_T _ A => lc_d n A
  | a_Box _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_Unbox _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_SSigma _ A B => lc_d n A /\ lc_d (S n) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_Bool => True
  | a_True => True
  | a_False => True
  | a_If a b0 b1 => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b0 /\ lc_d n b1
  end.

Definition lcD (a:tm) := lc_d 0 a.

Lemma lc_d_mono : forall a m n, le m n -> lc_d m a -> lc_d n a.
Proof.
  move=> a. induction a; intros m0 n0 hmn H; simpl in *; auto.
  - destruct H as [hA hB]. split.
    + exact (IHa1 m0 n0 hmn hA).
    + exact (IHa2 (S m0) (S n0) (le_n_S _ _ hmn) hB).
  - destruct H as [hA hB]. split.
    + exact (IHa1 m0 n0 hmn hA).
    + exact (IHa2 (S m0) (S n0) (le_n_S _ _ hmn) hB).
  - destruct H as [ha hb]. split; [exact (IHa1 m0 n0 hmn ha)|exact (IHa2 m0 n0 hmn hb)].
  - exact (PeanoNat.Nat.lt_le_trans _ _ _ H hmn).
  - destruct H as [ha [hb hA]]. split; [|split].

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition qualityvar : Set := atom.

Inductive tm : Type :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_Pi (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Abs (psi:grade) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Type (s:sort)
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_CEq (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm)
 | a_Refl : tm
 | a_Transp (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_T (psi:grade) (A:tm)
 | a_Box (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Unbox (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_SSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_SPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Proj1 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Proj2 (psi:grade) (a:tm)

 | a_If (a:tm) (b0:tm) (b1:tm).

Definition context : Type := list ( atom * (grade * tm) ).

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b0) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1)
end.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:var) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
       if (lt_dec nat k)
         then a_Var_b nat
         else a_Var_b (S nat)
  | (a_Var_f x) => if (a5 === x) then (a_Var_b k) else (a_Var_f x)
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True

# 181 — Internalizing indistinguishability: noninterference

## Task

Show that two indistinguishable well-typed Boolean programs that reduce to values yield the same value.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `non_interference`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib and MathComp.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
====
From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Unset Strict Implicit.

Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope order_scope.

Theorem non_interference
    ψ a0 b0 v0 v1
    (h0 : GDefEq nil ψ a0 b0)
    (h1 : Typing nil ψ a0 a_Bool)
    (h2 : Typing nil ψ b0 a_Bool)
    (h3 : Reds a0 v0)
    (h4 : Reds b0 v1)
    (hv0 : Value v0)
    (hv1 : Value v1) :
    v0 = v1.

  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x s -> ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x s' ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union s s').

Lemma fv_open_notin : forall B y x k,
  x <> y -> ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm B) ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) B)).
Proof.
  move=> B. induction B; simpl in *; auto;
  try (intros y xx k Hxy H).
  - (* Pi *) apply notin_union_intro.
    + apply IHB1; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
    + apply IHB2; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
  - (* Abs *) apply notin_union_intro.
    + apply IHB1; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
    + apply IHB2; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
  - (* App *) apply notin_union_intro.
    + apply IHB1; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
    + apply IHB2; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
  - (* Var_b *) destruct (Compare_dec.lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h|h]|h]; simpl.
    + intro Hin. exact (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty_1 xx Hin).
    + intro Hin. apply Hxy. symmetry.
      exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 y xx Hin).
    + intro Hin. exact (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty_1 xx Hin).
  - (* CEq *) apply notin_union_intro.
    + apply IHB1; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm B2) (fv_tm B3)) H).
    + apply notin_union_intro.
      * apply IHB2; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B2) (fv_tm B3) (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm B2) (fv_tm B3)) H)).
      * apply IHB3; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B2) (fv_tm B3) (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm B2) (fv_tm B3)) H)).
  - (* Transp *) apply notin_union_intro.
    + apply IHB1; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
    + apply IHB2; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
  - (* SSigma *) apply notin_union_intro.

    + apply IHB2; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
  - (* SPair *) apply notin_union_intro.
    + apply IHB1; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
    + apply IHB2; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
  - (* If *) apply notin_union_intro.
    + apply IHB1; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm B2) (fv_tm B3)) H).

     (lc_tm b0) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm (a_If a b0 b1)).

Fixpoint fv_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Type s) => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b) \u (fv_tm A)
  | a_Refl => {}
  | (a_Transp a b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_T psi A) => (fv_tm A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | a_Bool => {}
  | a_True => {}
  | a_False => {}
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b0) \u (fv_tm b1)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b) psi0 (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool

dom =
fix dom (C : Type) (E : list (atom * C)) {struct E} : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (x, _) :: E' => add x (dom C E')
  end
     : forall [C : Type], list (atom * C) -> atoms

Arguments dom [C]%_type_scope E%_list_scope
AtomSetImpl.add_1
     : forall (s : atoms) (x y : atom), x = y -> y `in` add x s
AtomSetImpl.add_2
     : forall (s : atoms) (x y : atom), y `in` s -> y `in` add x s
AtomSetImpl.add_3
     : forall (s : atoms) (x y : atom), x <> y -> y `in` add x s -> y `in` s
AtomSetImpl.singleton_2
     : forall x y : atom, x = y -> y `in` singleton x
AtomSetImpl.union_1
     : forall (s s' : atoms) (x : atom),
       x `in` union s s' -> x `in` s \/ x `in` s'
AtomSetImpl.union_2
     : forall (s s' : atoms) (x : atom), x `in` s -> x `in` union s s'
AtomSetImpl.union_3
     : forall (s s' : atoms) (x : atom), x `in` s' -> x `in` union s s'

Fixpoint econtext_remove (x:tmvar) (P:econtext) : econtext :=
  match P with
  | nil => nil
  | (y,g) :: P' => if eq_var y x then econtext_remove x P' else (y,g) :: econtext_remove x P'
  end.

Lemma dom_remove : forall (P:econtext) x z,
  MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P)) <->
  MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) /\ z <> x.
Proof.
  move=> P.
  elim: P => [| [y h] P' IH].
  - move=> x z. simpl. split.
    + intro H. exfalso. exact (notin_empty z H).
    + intro H. destruct H as [H1 _]. exfalso. exact (notin_empty z H1).
  - move=> x z. simpl.
    destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne].
    + subst y. simpl. split.
      * intro H. destruct (proj1 (IH x z) H) as [H1 H2]. split.
        -- exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') x z H1).
        -- exact H2.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Hin H2]. apply (proj2 (IH x z)). split.
        -- refine (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') x z _ Hin).
           intro E. exact (H2 (eq_sym E)).
        -- exact H2.
    + split.
      * intro H. destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec z y) as [E|nE].
        -- subst z. split.
           ++ exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_1 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') y y eq_refl).
           ++ exact ne.
        -- have Hz : MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) :=
             @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) y z (fun E => nE (eq_sym E)) H.
           destruct (proj1 (IH x z) Hz) as [H1 H2]. split.
           ++ exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') y z H1).
           ++ exact H2.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Hin H2].
        destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec z y) as [E|nE].
        -- subst z. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_1 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) y y eq_refl).
        -- have Hz : MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') :=
             @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') y z (fun E => nE (eq_sym E)) Hin.
           exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) y z
                    (proj2 (IH x z) (conj Hz H2))).
Qed.

  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom ((y,g)::P)) ->
  x <> y /\\ ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P).

  - intro Hin. apply H. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) y x Hin).

Lemma remove_notin : forall (P:econtext) x,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) ->
  econtext_remove x P = P.

  move=> P.
  elim: P => [| [y g] P' IH].
  - move=> x H. reflexivity.
  - move=> x H. simpl.
    destruct (notin_dom_cons P' H) as [Hxy HP'].
    destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne].
    + exfalso. apply Hxy. symmetry. exact e.
    + f_equal. apply IH. exact HP'.

  - exfalso. exact (ne eq_refl).

Lemma uniq_remove : forall (P:econtext) x,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq (econtext_remove x P).

      * intro Hin. exact (Hy (proj1 (proj1 (dom_remove P' x y) Hin))).

Definition PDrop (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (_:Par P psi a b) : Prop :=
  forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
    ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
    Par (econtext_remove x P) psi a b.

Definition CDrop (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CPar P psi psi0 a b) : Prop :=
  forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
    ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
    CPar (econtext_remove x P) psi psi0 a b.

Lemma remove_cons_other : forall (P:econtext) x y g,
  y <> x -> econtext_remove x ((y,g)::P) = (y,g)::econtext_remove x P.
Proof.
  move=> P x y g H. simpl.
  destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne].
  - exfalso. exact (H e).
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma Par_drop_mut :
  (forall (P:econtext) psi a b, Par P psi a b -> PDrop P psi a b) /\

    exact (proj1 (binds_remove_other P1 x xv psi0 Hne) b).

                      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union

          (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)

          (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)

Lemma Par_drop : forall (P:econtext) x psi0 psi a b,
  Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi a b ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm b) ->
  Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P x psi0 psi a b H Hfa Hfb.
  have Hu := Par_uniq H.
  have Hb : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x x psi0 psi0 P eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hres := (proj1 Par_drop_mut) ((x,psi0)::P) psi a b H x psi0 Hb Hfa.
  rewrite (@remove_cons_self P x psi0
             (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 grade x psi0 P Hu)) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Lemma CPar_drop : forall (P:econtext) x psi0 psi psi1 a b,
  CPar ((x,psi0)::P) psi psi1 a b ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm b) ->
  CPar P psi psi1 a b.
Proof.
  move=> P x psi0 psi psi1 a b H Hfa Hfb.
  have Hu := CPar_uniq H.
  have Hb : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x x psi0 psi0 P eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hres := (proj2 Par_drop_mut) ((x,psi0)::P) psi psi1 a b H x psi0 Hb Hfa.
  rewrite (@remove_cons_self P x psi0
             (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 grade x psi0 P Hu)) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.
From Metalib Require Import Metatheory.
Lemma is_left_eq_dec_right : forall (A:Type) (E:EqDec_eq A) (x y:A), x<>y ->
  @is_left (@eq A x y) (not (@eq A x y)) (@eq_dec A E x y) = false.
Proof.
  move=> A E x y H. simpl.
  destruct (@eq_dec A E x y) as [e|ne].
  - exfalso. exact (H e).
  - reflexivity.
Qed.
Fixpoint econtext_remove (x:tmvar) (P:econtext) : econtext :=
  match P with
  | nil => nil
  | (y,g) :: P' => if eq_var y x then econtext_remove x P' else (y,g) :: econtext_remove x P'
  end.
Lemma remove_cons_other : forall (P:econtext) x y g,
  y <> x -> econtext_remove x ((y,g)::P) = (y,g)::econtext_remove x P.
Proof.
  move=> P x y g H. simpl.
  rewrite (@is_left_eq_dec_right tmvar _ y x H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF

Inductive EMPar : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EMP_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm),
     EPar P a b ->
     EMPar P a b
 | EMP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (a a' b:tm),
     EPar P a b ->
     EMPar P b a' ->
     EMPar P a a'.

Inductive EJoins : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | EJ_ejoins : forall (P:econtext) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     EMPar P a1 b ->
     EMPar P a2 b ->
     EJoins P a1 a2.

Inductive MultiPar : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | MP_One : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi a b
 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
     MultiPar P psi a a'.

Inductive Joins : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | join : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     MultiPar P psi a1 b ->
     MultiPar P psi a2 b ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2.

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CMP_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Inductive CJoins : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CJ_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2 ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CJ_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Proof.

  - move=> a0 b0 a1 hb hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.

  - move=> psi0 a0 a1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi0 a0 ha c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi a0 a1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.

  - move=> psi a1 a2 ha2 ha1 c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.

Qed.

Lemma Red_value_impossible : forall a b, Value a -> Red a b -> False.
Proof.
  move=> a. case: a => //=; move=> *;
  match goal with h : Red _ _ |- False => inversion h end.
Qed.

Lemma Reds_value_inv : forall a b, Value a -> Reds a b -> b = a.
Proof.
  move=> a b hv hr. inversion hr; subst; auto.

Lemma Reds_det_value : forall a b c, Reds a b -> Reds a c -> Value b -> Value c -> b = c.
Proof.
  move=> a b c h1. elim: h1 => {a b}.
  - move=> a0 ha h2 hvb hvc. inversion h2; subst; auto.
    exfalso. exact (Red_value_impossible hvb H).

    + exfalso. exact (Red_value_impossible hvc hr).

Inductive GDefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | GE_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | GE_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | GE_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     GDefEq P psi b a
 | GE_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b b0:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b0 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b ->
     GDefEq P psi a b
 | GE_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b0:tm) (psi0:grade) (a0 b1 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App b1 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 b0 A1 b1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A0 b0) (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1)
 | GE_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A0 B0) (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1)
 | GE_AppAbs : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a0 b1 A:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a0) ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_App a psi0 b0)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a0   b1 )
 | GE_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_Refl a_Refl
 | GE_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
 | GE_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
 | GE_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_Refl ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1
 | GE_T : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A B ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
 | GE_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
 | GE_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
 | GE_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) b
 | GE_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
 | GE_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
 | GE_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 b) a2
 | GE_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b1 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
 | GE_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     GDefEq P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GDefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)
 | GE_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | GE_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | GE_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_Bool a_Bool
 | GE_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_True a_True
 | GE_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GDefEq P psi a_False a_False
 | GE_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a1 ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
 | GE_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_True ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b2
 | GE_IfFalse : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b3 b2:tm),
     GDefEq P psi a0 a_False ->
     GDefEq P psi b0 b2 ->
     GDefEq P psi b1 b3 ->
     GDefEq P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3
with CGDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CGE_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b
 | CGE_NLeq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b.

Inductive DefEq : econtext -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | E_One : forall (P:econtext) (a b:tm) (psi:grade),
     GDefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P a b
 | E_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (a b b0:tm),
     DefEq P a b0 ->
     DefEq P b0 b ->
     DefEq P a b.

  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))

  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A)

Lemma Par_drop : forall (P:econtext) x psi0 psi a b,
  Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi a b ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm b) ->
  Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P x psi0 psi a b H Hfa Hfb.
  have Hu := Par_uniq H.
  have Hb : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x x psi0 psi0 P eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hres := (proj1 Par_drop_mut) ((x,psi0)::P) psi a b H x psi0 Hb Hfa.
  rewrite (@remove_cons_self P x psi0
             (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 grade x psi0 P Hu)) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Lemma CPar_drop : forall (P:econtext) x psi0 psi psi1 a b,
  CPar ((x,psi0)::P) psi psi1 a b ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm b) ->

Proof.

  have Hres := (proj2 Par_drop_mut) ((x,psi0)::P) psi psi1 a b H x psi0 Hb Hfa.

Lemma fv_close_notin : forall (t:tm) x k,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x t)).
Proof.
  move=> t. induction t => xx k; simpl; auto.
  - (* Var_b *) destruct (lt_dec n k); simpl; apply notin_empty.
  - (* Var_f *) simpl. set (u := eq_var xx x). destruct u as [e|ne].
    + subst x. simpl. apply notin_empty.
    + simpl. intro Hin. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 x xx) in Hin.
      exfalso. exact (ne (eq_sym Hin)).
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_var_b_lt : forall n k yy,
  (n < k)%nat ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (a_Var_b n) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  move=> n k yy H.
  cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  case: (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) => [[H1|H1]|H1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. lia.
  - exfalso. lia.

(* ================= inversion lemmas ================= *)

Lemma Par_App_inv : forall P psi a psi0 b c,
  Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) c ->
  (exists a' b' A, c = open_tm_wrt_tm a' b' /\
     Par P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a') /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b')
  \/ (exists a' b', c = a_App a' psi0 b' /\
     Par P psi a a' /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi a psi0 b c H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Par_Transp_inv : forall P psi a0 b0 c,
  Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) c ->
  (exists a1 b1, c = a_Transp a1 b1 /\ Par P psi a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b1)
  \/ (exists b1, c = b1 /\ Par P psi a0 a_Refl /\ Par P psi b0 b1).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 b0 c H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Par_Unbox_inv : forall P psi psi0 a c,
  Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) c ->
  (exists b, c = a_Unbox psi0 b /\ Par P psi a b /\ psi0 <= psi)
  \/ (exists b, c = b /\ Par P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) /\ psi0 <= psi).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a c H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Par_Proj1_inv : forall P psi psi0 a0 c,
  Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) c ->
  (exists a1, c = a_Proj1 psi0 a1 /\ Par P psi a0 a1 /\ psi0 <= psi)
  \/ (exists a1 a2, c = a1 /\ Par P psi a0 (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) /\ psi0 <= psi).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a0 c H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Par_Proj2_inv : forall P psi psi0 a0 c,
  Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) c ->
  (exists a1, c = a_Proj2 psi0 a1 /\ Par P psi a0 a1)
  \/ (exists a1 a2, c = a2 /\ Par P psi a0 (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2)).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a0 c H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Par_If_inv : forall P psi a0 b0 b1 c,
  Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) c ->
  (exists a1 b2 b3, c = a_If a1 b2 b3 /\
     Par P psi a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b2 /\ Par P psi b1 b3)
  \/ (exists b2 b3, c = b2 /\
     Par P psi a0 a_True /\ Par P psi b0 b2 /\ Par P psi b1 b3)
  \/ (exists b2 b3, c = b3 /\
     Par P psi a0 a_False /\ Par P psi b0 b2 /\ Par P psi b1 b3).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 b0 b1 c H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

AtomSetImpl.add_1
     : forall (s : atoms) (x y : atom), x = y -> y `in` add x s
AtomSetImpl.add_2
     : forall (s : atoms) (x y : atom), y `in` s -> y `in` add x s
AtomSetImpl.add_3
     : forall (s : atoms) (x y : atom), x <> y -> y `in` add x s -> y `in` s
uniq_push
     : forall (A : Type) (x : AtomSetImpl.elt) (a : A) (E : list (atom * A)),
       uniq E -> x `notin` dom E -> uniq (x ~ a ++ E)
uniq_cons_1
     : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a : A) (E : list (atom * A)),
       uniq ((x, a) :: E) -> uniq E
uniq_cons_2
     : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a : A) (E : list (atom * A)),
       uniq ((x, a) :: E) -> x `notin` dom E
uniq_cons
     : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a : A) (E : list (atom * A)),
       uniq E -> x `notin` dom E -> uniq ((x, a) :: E)
binds_unique
     : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a b : A) (E : list (atom * A)),
       binds x a E -> binds x b E -> uniq E -> a = b
binds_app_iff
     : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a : A) (E F : list (atom * A)),
       binds x a (E ++ F) <-> binds x a E \/ binds x a F

(* ================= the diamond ================= *)

Definition PDPar (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (H:Par P psi a b) : Prop :=
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Arguments PDPar _ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.

Definition PDCPar (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) (H:CPar P psi psi0 a b) : Prop :=
  forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 b d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d.
Arguments PDCPar _ _ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.

Combined Scheme Par_diam_comb from Par_mutind2, CPar_mutind2.

Lemma Par_diamond_mut :
  (forall (P:econtext) psi a b (H:Par P psi a b), PDPar P psi a b H) /\
  (forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 a b (H:CPar P psi psi0 a b), PDCPar P psi psi0 a b H).

Lemma Par_subst_cond : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b ->
  forall x psi0 u1 u2,
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 P ->
    lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 ->
    (psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
    Par P psi (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b Hpar.
  apply (@Par_mutind
    (fun P psi a b _ => forall x psi0 u1 u2,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 P ->
      lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 -> (psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
      Par P psi (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b))
    (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => forall x g u1 u2,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
      lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 -> (g <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
      CPar P psi psi0 (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b))).
  all: try (intros; simpl in *; eauto).
  - destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x x0) as [e|Hne].
    + subst x0. simpl.
      have E : psi2 = psi1 by exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_unique grade x psi2 psi1 P0 H0 b0 u).
      subst psi2. exact (H3 i).
    + simpl. exact (@Par_Var P0 psi0 x psi1 u i b0).
  - eapply Par_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0))).
    + exact (@H x psi2 u1 u2 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5).

Lemma CPar_lc : forall P psi psi0 a b, CPar P psi psi0 a b -> lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H. induction H.
  - exact (@Par_lc P psi a1 a2 H0).
  - split; assumption.
Qed.
Lemma Par_lc : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b -> lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b.
Proof.
  apply (@Par_mutind (fun P psi a b _ => lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b)
                     (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b)).
  all: try (intros; split; dest_conjs; try lc_head; eauto).
  - apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact H.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
      exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all B1 x0 x (proj1 (H0 x0 Hx0))).
  - apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact H1.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
      exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all B2 x0 x (proj2 (H0 x0 Hx0))).
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact l.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
      exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all b1 x0 x (proj1 (H x0 Hx0))).
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact l0.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].

  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit

  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>

  Par P psi a b ->
  forall P', (forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P') ->
            Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P' -> Par P' psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H.
  apply (@Par_mutind
    (fun P psi a b _ => forall P', (forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P') -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P' -> Par P' psi a b)
    (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => forall P', (forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P') -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P' -> CPar P' psi psi0 a b)).
  all: try (intros; eauto).
  - apply (@Par_Pi (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P')) P' psi0 psi1 A1 B1 A2 B2).
    + exact (H0 P' H2 H3).
    + move=> x Hx.
      apply (H1 x (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') Hx)).
      * move=> y g Hy.
        apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_app_iff.
        apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_app_iff in Hy.
        destruct Hy as [Hy|Hy].
        -- left. exact Hy.

      * apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push.
        -- exact H3.
        -- exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') Hx).
  - apply (@Par_Abs (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P')) P' psi0 psi1 A1 b1 A2 b2 l l0).
    move=> x Hx.
    apply (H0 x (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') Hx)).
    + move=> y g Hy.
      apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_app_iff.

      destruct Hy as [Hy|Hy].

      exact (H0 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi1, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_incl_ctx x (psi1, A) W W' Hb)).

      exact (H1 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_incl_ctx x (psi0, A) W W' Hb)).
    + exact H2.

Definition PDPar (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (H:Par P psi a b) : Prop :=
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.

Lemma Par_diamond : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.

Qed.

Lemma CPar_diamond : forall P psi psi0 a b, CPar P psi psi0 a b ->
  forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 b d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj2 Par_diamond_mut P psi psi0 a b H).
Qed.

Lemma Par_local_join : forall P psi a b c,
  Par P psi a b -> Par P psi a c -> EJoins P b c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b c H1 H2.
  destruct (@Par_diamond P psi a b H1 c H2) as [d [Hb Hc]].
  eapply (@EJ_ejoins P b c d).
  - apply EMP_One. apply (@EP_One P b d psi). exact Hb.
  - apply EMP_One. apply (@EP_One P c d psi). exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_gdefeq_self : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A ->
  forall psi', psi <= psi' -> GDefEq (labels W) psi' a a.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A H. induction H; intros psi' Hle; simpl in *.
  - (* T_Type *) apply GE_Type. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_Var *) apply (@GE_Var (labels W) psi' x psi0).
    + apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
    + exact (binds_labels H1).
  - (* T_Pi *) eapply GE_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W))).
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W)) Hx.
      exact (H1 x HxL psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Abs *) eapply GE_Abs with (L := L).
    + exact (lc_tm_pi_dom (Typing_lc H1)).
    + exact (lc_tm_pi_dom (Typing_lc H1)).
    + move=> x Hx. exact (H0 x Hx psi' Hle).
  - (* T_App *) eapply GE_App.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + case E: (psi0 <= psi').
      * have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
        apply CGE_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle0)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CGE_NLeq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Conv *) exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Refl *) apply GE_Refl. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_CEq *) eapply GE_CEq.
    + exact (Typing_lc H1).
    + exact (Typing_lc H1).
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H3 (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle))).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H3 (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle))).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle).
  - (* T_Transp *) eapply GE_Transp.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_T *) apply GE_T. exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Box *) eapply GE_Box.
    case E: (psi0 <= psi').
    + have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
      apply CGE_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle0)].
    + have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
      apply CGE_NLeq.
      * exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H).
      * exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H).
      * exact Hnle.
      * apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Unbox *) apply GE_Unbox.
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
  - (* T_SSigma *) eapply GE_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W))).
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W)) Hx.
      exact (H1 x HxL psi' Hle).
  - (* T_SPair *) eapply GE_SPair.
    + case E: (psi0 <= psi').
      * have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
        apply CGE_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle0)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CGE_NLeq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
    + exact (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Proj1 *) apply GE_Proj1Cong.
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
  - (* T_Proj2 *) apply GE_Proj2Cong. exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_TyUnit *) apply GE_TyUnit. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_TmUnit *) apply GE_TmUnit. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Bool *) apply GE_Bool. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_True *) apply GE_True. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_False *) apply GE_False. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_If *) eapply GE_If.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
Qed.

Scheme GDefEq_mutind := Induction for GDefEq Sort Prop
  with CGDefEq_mutind := Induction for CGDefEq Sort Prop.
Lemma GDefEq_lc : forall P psi a b, GDefEq P psi a b -> lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b.
Proof.
  apply (@GDefEq_mutind (fun P psi a b _ => lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b) (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b)).
  all: try (intros; split; dest_conjs; try lc_head; eauto).
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact l.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all b0 L (fun x Hx => proj1 (H x Hx))).
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact l0.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all b1 L (fun x Hx => proj2 (H x Hx))).
  - apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact H.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all B0 L (fun x Hx => proj1 (H0 x Hx))).
  - apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact H1.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all B1 L (fun x Hx => proj2 (H0 x Hx))).
  - apply lc_a_SSigma.
    + exact H.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all B0 L (fun x Hx => proj1 (H0 x Hx))).
  - apply lc_a_SSigma.
    + exact H1.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all B1 L (fun x Hx => proj2 (H0 x Hx))).
Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_lc : forall P psi psi0 a b, CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H. induction H.
  - exact (@GDefEq_lc P psi a b H0).
  - split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Red_par : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A ->
  forall b, Red a b -> Par (labels W) psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A HT b HR. revert W psi A HT.
  induction HR; intros WW pp AA TT.
  - (* R_App *) destruct (@Typing_App_inv WW pp a0 psi0 b AA TT) as [A0 [B [hfun harg]]].
    eapply Par_App.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp (a_Pi psi0 A0 B) hfun).
    + case E: (psi0 <= pp).
      * have Hle : psi0 <= pp by rewrite E; done.
        apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle | exact (@Typing_par_self WW psi0 b A0 harg pp Hle)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= pp) by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CPar_Nleq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc WW psi0 b A0 harg).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc WW psi0 b A0 harg).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx WW _ _ _ TT).
  - (* R_AppAbs *) destruct (@Typing_App_inv WW pp (a_Abs psi0 A a) psi0 b AA TT) as [A2 [B [hfun harg]]].
    eapply Par_AppBeta.
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B) hfun pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + case E: (psi0 <= pp).
      * have Hle : psi0 <= pp by rewrite E; done.
        apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle | exact (@Typing_par_self WW psi0 b A2 harg pp Hle)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= pp) by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CPar_Nleq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc WW psi0 b A2 harg).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc WW psi0 b A2 harg).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx WW _ _ _ TT).
  - (* R_Transp *) destruct (@Typing_Transp_inv WW pp a b AA TT) as [p0 [x0 [x1 [p1 [A0 [B [h_a h_b]]]]]]].
    eapply Par_Transp.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp (a_CEq p0 x0 x1 p1 A0) h_a).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b (open_tm_wrt_tm B x0) h_b pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_TranspRefl *) destruct (@Typing_Transp_inv WW pp a_Refl a AA TT) as [p0 [x0 [x1 [p1 [A0 [B [h_a h_b]]]]]]].
    eapply Par_TranspRefl.
    + apply Par_Refl. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx WW _ _ _ TT).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp a (open_tm_wrt_tm B x0) h_b pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_Unbox *) destruct (@Typing_Unbox_inv WW pp psi0 a AA TT) as [A0 [Hle h_a]].
    eapply Par_Unbox.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp (a_T psi0 A0) h_a).
    + exact Hle.
  - (* R_UnboxBox *) destruct (@Typing_Unbox_inv WW pp psi0 (a_Box psi0 a) AA TT) as [A0 [Hle h_box]].
    eapply Par_UnboxBox.
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp (a_Box psi0 a) (a_T psi0 A0) h_box pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact Hle.
  - (* R_Proj1Cong *) destruct (@Typing_Proj1_inv WW pp psi a AA TT) as [A0 [B [h_a Hle]]].
    eapply Par_Proj1Cong.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp (a_SSigma psi A0 B) h_a).
    + exact Hle.
  - (* R_Proj2Cong *) destruct (@Typing_Proj2_inv WW pp psi a AA TT) as [A0 [B [h_a h_proj]]].
    eapply Par_Proj2Cong.
    exact (IHHR WW pp (a_SSigma psi A0 B) h_a).
  - (* R_Proj1Beta *) destruct (@Typing_Proj1_inv WW pp psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2) AA TT) as [A0 [B [h_pair Hle]]].
    eapply Par_Proj1Beta.
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp (a_SPair a1 psi a2) (a_SSigma psi A0 B) h_pair pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact Hle.
  - (* R_Proj2Beta *) destruct (@Typing_Proj2_inv WW pp psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2) AA TT) as [A0 [B [h_pair h_proj]]].
    eapply Par_Proj2Beta.
    exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp (a_SPair a1 psi a2) (a_SSigma psi A0 B) h_pair pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_If *) destruct (@Typing_If_inv WW pp a b0 b1 AA TT) as [A0 [hg [hb0 hb1]]].
    eapply Par_If.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp a_Bool hg).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b0 A0 hb0 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b1 A0 hb1 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_IfTrue *) destruct (@Typing_If_inv WW pp a_True b0 b1 AA TT) as [A0 [hg [hb0 hb1]]].
    eapply Par_IfTrue.
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp a_True a_Bool hg pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b0 A0 hb0 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b1 A0 hb1 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_IfFalse *) destruct (@Typing_If_inv WW pp a_False b0 b1 AA TT) as [A0 [hg [hb0 hb1]]].
    eapply Par_IfFalse.
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp a_False a_Bool hg pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b0 A0 hb0 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b1 A0 hb1 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
Qed.

            Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P' -> DefEq P' a b.

  move=> P a b H P' Hincl Hu.
  induction H.
  - eapply E_One. exact (@GDefEq_weaken P psi a b H P' Hincl Hu).
  - eapply E_Trans; eauto.

Qed.

Lemma Par_lc : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b -> lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b.
Proof.
  apply (@Par_mutind (fun P psi a b _ => lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b)
                     (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b)).
  all: try (intros; split; dest_conjs; try lc_head; eauto).
  - apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact H.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
      exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all B1 x0 x (proj1 (H0 x0 Hx0))).
  - apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact H1.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
      exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all B2 x0 x (proj2 (H0 x0 Hx0))).
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact l.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
      exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all b1 x0 x (proj1 (H x0 Hx0))).
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact l0.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
      exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all b2 x0 x (proj2 (H x0 Hx0))).
  - apply lc_a_SSigma.
    + exact H.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
      exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all B0 x0 x (proj1 (H0 x0 Hx0))).
  - apply lc_a_SSigma.
    + exact H1.
    + move=> x. destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
      exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all B1 x0 x (proj2 (H0 x0 Hx0))).
Qed.

Lemma CPar_lc : forall P psi psi0 a b, CPar P psi psi0 a b -> lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H. induction H.

Qed.

Lemma fv_close_notin : forall (t:tm) x k,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x t)).
Proof.
  move=> t. induction t => xx k; simpl; auto.
  - (* Var_b *) destruct (lt_dec n k); simpl; apply notin_empty.
  - (* Var_f *) simpl. set (u := eq_var xx x). destruct u as [e|ne].
    + subst x. simpl. apply notin_empty.
    + simpl. intro Hin. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 x xx) in Hin.
      exfalso. exact (ne (eq_sym Hin)).
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_var_b_lt : forall n k yy,
  (n < k)%nat ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (a_Var_b n) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  move=> n k yy H.
  cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  case: (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) => [[H1|H1]|H1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. lia.
  - exfalso. lia.
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_var_b_ge : forall n k yy,
  ~ (n < k)%nat ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (a_Var_b (S n)) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  move=> n k yy H.
  cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  case: (lt_eq_lt_dec (S n) k) => [[H1|H1]|H1]; simpl.
  - exfalso. lia.
  - exfalso. lia.
  - rewrite Nat.sub_0_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_var_b_eq : forall k yy,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (a_Var_b k) = a_Var_f yy.
Proof.
  move=> k yy.
  cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  case: (lt_eq_lt_dec k k) => [[H1|H1]|H1]; simpl; try reflexivity; exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma oc_var_b : forall xx yy k n,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_b n)) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  move=> xx yy k n.
  cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  case: (lt_dec n k) => [Hlt|Hge].
  - rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_lt n k yy Hlt). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_ge n k yy Hge). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma is_left_eq_dec_comm : forall (A:Type) (E:EqDec_eq A) x y,
  @is_left (@eq A x y) (not (@eq A x y)) (@eq_dec A E x y) =
  @is_left (@eq A y x) (not (@eq A y x)) (@eq_dec A E y x).
Proof.
  move=> A E x y. simpl.
  destruct (@eq_dec A E x y) as [e|ne].
  - destruct (@eq_dec A E y x) as [e'|ne']; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. exact (ne' (eq_sym e)).
  - destruct (@eq_dec A E y x) as [e'|ne']; simpl.
    + exfalso. exact (ne (eq_sym e')).
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma oc_var_f : forall xx yy k x,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_f x)) =
  subst_tm (a_Var_f yy) xx (a_Var_f x).
Proof.
  move=> xx yy k x.
  cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm].
  rewrite <- (@is_left_eq_dec_comm Atom.atom EqDec_eq_of_X x xx).
  change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy)
    match @is_left (@eq tmvar x xx) (not (@eq tmvar x xx))
            (@eq_dec tmvar EqDec_eq_of_X x xx) with
    | @true => a_Var_b k
    | @false => a_Var_f x
    end =
    match @is_left (@eq tmvar x xx) (not (@eq tmvar x xx))
            (@eq_dec tmvar EqDec_eq_of_X x xx) with
    | @true => a_Var_f yy
    | @false => a_Var_f x
    end).
  destruct (@eq_dec tmvar EqDec_eq_of_X x xx) as [Heq|Hne].
  - rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_eq k yy). reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_close_subst : forall (t:tm) x y k,
  y <> x ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x t) =
  subst_tm (a_Var_f y) x t.
Proof.
  move=> t. induction t => xx yy k Hxy; simpl; auto.
  - (* Pi *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy (S k) Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Abs *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy (S k) Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* App *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Var_b *)
    change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy)
              (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_b n)) = a_Var_b n).
    rewrite (@oc_var_b xx yy k n). reflexivity.
  - (* Var_f *)
    change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy)
              (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_f x)) =
            subst_tm (a_Var_f yy) xx (a_Var_f x)).
    rewrite (@oc_var_f xx yy k x). reflexivity.
  - (* CEq *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt3 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Transp *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* T *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Box *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Unbox *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* SSigma *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy (S k) Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* SPair *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj1 *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj2 *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* If *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt3 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma labels_app : forall W1 W2, labels (W1 ++ W2) = (labels W1 ++ labels W2).

Lemma binds_labels : forall W x psi A,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (psi,A) W -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi (labels W).
Proof. move=> W x psi A H. exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_map_2 (grade*tm) grade flab x (psi,A) W H). Qed.

Lemma binds_labels_inv : forall W x psi,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi (labels W) -> exists A, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (psi,A) W.
Proof.
  move=> W x psi H.
  move/(@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_map_3 (grade*tm) grade flab x psi W) in H.
  move: H => [[g A] [Ea Hb]]. exists A.
  move: Ea => /= Ea. rewrite Ea in Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_labels : forall W, Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq W -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq (labels W).
