From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic helpers                                                 *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Par_to_CPar_any : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  Par P psi a b -> CPar P psi psi0 a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  case E: (psi0 <= psi).
  - have Hle : psi0 <= psi by rewrite E; done.
    apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle | exact H].
  - have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi) by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
    apply CPar_Nleq.
    + exact (proj1 (@Par_lc P psi a b H)).
    + exact (proj2 (@Par_lc P psi a b H)).
    + exact Hnle.
    + exact (@Par_uniq P psi a b H).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_uniq : forall P psi a b,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H. elim: H.
  - move=> P0 psi0 a0 b0 Hp. exact (@Par_uniq P0 psi0 a0 b0 Hp).
  - move=> P0 psi0 a0 b0 b' Hp Hmp IH. exact (@Par_uniq P0 psi0 a0 b0 Hp).
Qed.

(* substituting a different atom for x removes x from the free variables *)
Lemma notin_fv_subst_var_other : forall (a:tm) x x0,
  x <> x0 ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 a)).
Proof.
  move=> a. induction a => xx x0 Hne; simpl in *; auto.
  - (* Var_b *) apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty.
  - (* Var_f *) destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x xx) as [e|e].
    + subst xx. simpl. intro Hin.
      apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 xx x) in Hin.
      exfalso. exact (Hne (eq_sym Hin)).
    + simpl. intro Hin. apply e.
      exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 xx x Hin).
  - (* Pi *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* Abs *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* App *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* CEq *) apply notin_union_intro; [eauto|]. apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* Transp *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* T *) eauto.
  - (* Box *) eauto.
  - (* Unbox *) eauto.
  - (* SSigma *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* SPair *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* Proj1 *) eauto.
  - (* Proj2 *) eauto.
  - (* If *) apply notin_union_intro; [eauto|]. apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
Qed.

(* Rename the bound atom x0 to a different atom x in an arbitrary Par step. *)
Lemma Par_rename_general : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 d1 d2 x0 x,
  x <> x0 ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
  Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi d1 d2 ->
  Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d1)
                          (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d2).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 d1 d2 x0 x Hxx0 Hxdom Hu H.
  have HuP : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 grade x0 psi0 P Hu.
  have Hx0dom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 grade x0 psi0 P Hu.
  have Hux : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x psi0 P HuP Hxdom.
  have Hx0not : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom ((x,psi0)::P)).
  { simpl. intro Hin.
    apply Hx0dom.
    exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) x x0 Hxx0 Hin). }
  have Hux0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x0 psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) Hux Hx0not.
  have Hincl : forall z g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds z g ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
                            Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds z g ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P).
  { move=> z g Hz. unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds in *.
    simpl in *. destruct Hz as [E|Hin]; [left; exact E|right; right; exact Hin]. }
  have Hw : Par ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi d1 d2 :=
    @Par_weaken ((x0,psi0)::P) psi d1 d2 H ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) Hincl Hux0.
  have Hbindx0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x0 psi0 ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x0 x0 psi0 psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hlcx : lc_tm (a_Var_f x) := lc_a_Var_f x.
  have Hcond : psi0 <= psi ->
      Par ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x).
  { move=> Hle. apply (@Par_Var ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi x psi0 Hux0 Hle).
    unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. right. left. reflexivity. }
  have Hsub := @Par_subst_cond ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi d1 d2 Hw
                 x0 psi0 (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x) Hux0 Hbindx0 Hlcx Hlcx Hcond.
  have Hnotin : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (fv_tm (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d1)) :=
    @notin_fv_subst_var_other d1 x x0 (fun e => Hxx0 (eq_sym e)).
  exact (@Par_drop_src ((x,psi0)::P) x0 psi0 psi
           (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d1)
           (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d2) Hsub Hnotin).
Qed.

(* Open/close at the same atom for a body that does not contain the atom. *)
Lemma close_open_self : forall (b:tm) x0,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b) ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm x0 (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x0)) = b.
Proof.
  move=> b. induction b => x0 Hfresh; simpl in *; auto.
  - (* Var_b *) case: (lt_dec n 0); simpl; auto. lia.
  - (* Var_f *) destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x x0) as [e|e].
    + subst x0. exfalso. apply Hfresh.
      simpl. apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. done.
    + simpl. rewrite e. done.
  - (* Pi *) rewrite IHb1 IHb2; auto.
    + apply notin_union_intro; [exact (fun H => Hfresh (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 _ _ _ H))|]. admit.
Admitted.

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b0) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1)
end.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:var) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
       if (lt_dec nat k)
         then a_Var_b nat
         else a_Var_b (S nat)
  | (a_Var_f x) => if (a5 === x) then (a_Var_b k) else (a_Var_f x)
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b) psi0 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b0) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1)
end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm a_6 a5 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
Fixpoint fv_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Type s) => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b) \u (fv_tm A)
  | a_Refl => {}
  | (a_Transp a b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_T psi A) => (fv_tm A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | a_Bool => {}
  | a_True => {}
  | a_False => {}
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b0) \u (fv_tm b1)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => a_CEq psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b) psi0 (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | a_Refl => a_Refl
  | (a_Transp a b) => a_Transp (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_T psi A) => a_T psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => a_Box psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => a_Unbox psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | a_Bool => a_Bool
  | a_True => a_True
  | a_False => a_False
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => a_If (subst_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm a5 x5 b0) (subst_tm a5 x5 b1)
end.

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm a x A))).

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic helpers                                                 *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Par_to_CPar_any : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  Par P psi a b -> CPar P psi psi0 a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  case E: (psi0 <= psi).
  - have Hle : psi0 <= psi by rewrite E; done.
    apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle | exact H].
  - have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi) by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
    apply CPar_Nleq.
    + exact (proj1 (@Par_lc P psi a b H)).
    + exact (proj2 (@Par_lc P psi a b H)).
    + exact Hnle.
    + exact (@Par_uniq P psi a b H).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_uniq : forall P psi a b,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H. elim: H.
  - move=> P0 psi0 a0 b0 Hp. exact (@Par_uniq P0 psi0 a0 b0 Hp).
  - move=> P0 psi0 a0 b0 b' Hp Hmp IH. exact (@Par_uniq P0 psi0 a0 b0 Hp).
Qed.

(* substituting a different atom for x removes x from the free variables *)
Lemma notin_fv_subst_var_other : forall (a:tm) x x0,
  x <> x0 ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 a)).
Proof.
  move=> a. induction a => x x0 Hne; simpl in *.
  - (* TyUnit *) apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty.
  - (* TmUnit *) apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty.
  - (* Pi *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* Abs *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* App *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* Type *) apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty.
  - (* Var_b *) apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty.
  - (* Var_f *) destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec v x0) as [e|e].
    + subst v. simpl. intro Hin.
      apply Hne. symmetry.
      exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 x x0 Hin).
    + simpl. intro Hin.
      apply e. symmetry.
      exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 v x0 Hin).
  - (* CEq *) apply notin_union_intro; [eauto|]. apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* Refl *) apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty.
  - (* Transp *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* T *) eauto.
  - (* Box *) eauto.
  - (* Unbox *) eauto.
  - (* SSigma *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* SPair *) apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
  - (* Proj1 *) eauto.
  - (* Proj2 *) eauto.
  - (* Bool *) apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty.
  - (* True *) apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty.
  - (* False *) apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_empty.
  - (* If *) apply notin_union_intro; [eauto|]. apply notin_union_intro; eauto.
Qed.

(* Rename the bound atom x0 to a different atom x in an arbitrary Par step. *)
Lemma Par_rename_general : forall (P:econtext) psi psi0 d1 d2 x0 x,
  x <> x0 ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
  Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi d1 d2 ->
  Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d1)
                          (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d2).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 d1 d2 x0 x Hxx0 Hxdom Hu H.
  have HuP : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 grade x0 psi0 P Hu.
  have Hx0dom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 grade x0 psi0 P Hu.
  have Hux : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x psi0 P HuP Hxdom.
  have Hx0not : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom ((x,psi0)::P)).
  { simpl. intro Hin.
    apply Hx0dom.
    exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) x x0 Hxx0 Hin). }
  have Hux0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x0 psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) Hux Hx0not.
  have Hincl : forall z g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds z g ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
                            Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds z g ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P).
  { move=> z g Hz. unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds in *.
    simpl in *. destruct Hz as [E|Hin]; [left; exact E|right; right; exact Hin]. }
  have Hw : Par ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi d1 d2 :=
    @Par_weaken ((x0,psi0)::P) psi d1 d2 H ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) Hincl Hux0.
  have Hbindx0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x0 psi0 ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x0 x0 psi0 psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hlcx : lc_tm (a_Var_f x) := lc_a_Var_f x.
  have Hcond : psi0 <= psi ->
      Par ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x).
  { move=> Hle. apply (@Par_Var ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi x psi0 Hux0 Hle).
    unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. right. left. reflexivity. }
  have Hsub := @Par_subst_cond ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi d1 d2 Hw
                 x0 psi0 (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x) Hux0 Hbindx0 Hlcx Hlcx Hcond.
  have Hnotin : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (fv_tm (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d1)) :=
    @notin_fv_subst_var_other d1 x x0 (fun e => Hxx0 (eq_sym e)).
  exact (@Par_drop_src ((x,psi0)::P) x0 psi0 psi
           (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d1)
           (subst_tm (a_Var_f x) x0 d2) Hsub Hnotin).
Qed.

Lemma Par_diamond : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj1 Par_diamond_mut P psi a b H).
Qed.

Lemma CPar_diamond : forall P psi psi0 a b, CPar P psi psi0 a b ->
  forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 b d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d.
Proof.

Lemma Par_local_join : forall P psi a b c,
  Par P psi a b -> Par P psi a c -> EJoins P b c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b c H1 H2.
  destruct (@Par_diamond P psi a b H1 c H2) as [d [Hb Hc]].
  eapply (@EJ_ejoins P b c d).
  - apply EMP_One. apply (@EP_One P b d psi). exact Hb.
  - apply EMP_One. apply (@EP_One P c d psi). exact Hc.
Qed.
Lemma Par_subst_cond : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b ->
  forall x psi0 u1 u2,
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 P ->
    lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 ->
    (psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
    Par P psi (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b Hpar.
  apply (@Par_mutind
    (fun P psi a b _ => forall x psi0 u1 u2,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 P ->
      lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 -> (psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
      Par P psi (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b))
    (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => forall x g u1 u2,
      Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
      lc_tm u1 -> lc_tm u2 -> (g <= psi -> Par P psi u1 u2) ->
      CPar P psi psi0 (subst_tm u1 x a) (subst_tm u2 x b))).
  all: try (intros; simpl in *; eauto).
  - destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x x0) as [e|Hne].
    + subst x0. simpl.
      have E : psi2 = psi1 by exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_unique grade x psi2 psi1 P0 H0 b0 u).
      subst psi2. exact (H3 i).
    + simpl. exact (@Par_Var P0 psi0 x psi1 u i b0).
  - eapply Par_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P0))).
    + exact (@H x psi2 u1 u2 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5).
Lemma Par_drop_src : forall (P:econtext) x psi0 psi a b,
  Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi a b ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
  Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P x psi0 psi a b H Hfa.
  have Hu := Par_uniq H.
  have Hb : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x x psi0 psi0 P eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hres := (proj1 Par_drop_mut) ((x,psi0)::P) psi a b H x psi0 Hb Hfa.
  rewrite (@remove_cons_self P x psi0
             (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 grade x psi0 P Hu)) in Hres.
Lemma CPar_par_leq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CPar P psi psi0 a b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle H. inversion H; subst.
  - exact H1.
  - exfalso. exact (H2 Hle).
Qed.

Lemma Par_diamond : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b ->
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj1 Par_diamond_mut P psi a b H).

Lemma CPar_diamond : forall P psi psi0 a b, CPar P psi psi0 a b ->
  forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 b d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj2 Par_diamond_mut P psi psi0 a b H).
Qed.

Lemma Par_local_join : forall P psi a b c,
  Par P psi a b -> Par P psi a c -> EJoins P b c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b c H1 H2.
  destruct (@Par_diamond P psi a b H1 c H2) as [d [Hb Hc]].
  eapply (@EJ_ejoins P b c d).
  - apply EMP_One. apply (@EP_One P b d psi). exact Hb.
  - apply EMP_One. apply (@EP_One P c d psi). exact Hc.

Lemma Par_Abs_arg_step : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') ->
  (psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi b b') ->
  lc_tm b -> lc_tm b' ->
  Par P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' H Hcond Hlcb Hlcb'.
  inversion H; subst.
  (* Context now contains the fresh set L, lc annotations, and the
     pointwise body relation H9. *)
  set S := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L
             (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a)
               (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a')
                 (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
                   (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
                     (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P))))).
  destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh S) as [x0 Hx0].
  have Hx0L : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 L :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 L _ Hx0.
  have Hx0rest : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a')
          (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
            (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')

    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 L _ Hx0.
  have Hx0a : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm a) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm a) _ Hx0rest.
  have Hx0rest1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a')
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
          (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
            (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P)))) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm a) _ Hx0rest.
  have Hx0a' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm a') :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm a') _ Hx0rest1.
  have Hx0rest2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
          (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P))) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm a') _ Hx0rest1.
  have Hx0b : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm b) _ Hx0rest2.
  have Hx0rest3 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b') (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P)) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm b) _ Hx0rest2.
  have Hx0b' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b') :=

  have Hx0dom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm b') _ Hx0rest3.

  have HuniqP : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P :=
    @Par_uniq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') H.

    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x0 psi0 P HuniqP Hx0dom.
  have Hbindx0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x0 psi0 ((x0,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x0 x0 psi0 psi0 P eq_refl eq_refl.

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_one_arg : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') ->
  forall (N:MultiPar P psi b b'),
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' Hm N.
  induction N as [PN psiN bS bT Hn | PN psiN bS bT bM Hn Ntail IH].
  - move=> Hself. apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A' a' bS bT Hm
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))).
  - move=> Hself.
    have Hstep : Par PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bS) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bM Hself
               (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))). }
    have Htail : MultiPar PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' bT).
    { apply IH; [exact Hm | exact Hself]. }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

(* Body is an arbitrary multi-step derivation, the argument is a
   single parallel step.  We state a generalized version over the
   body endpoints, since the intermediate body steps are only known
   to be abstractions after inversion. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_one_gen : forall P psi (X Y:tm) (M:MultiPar P psi X Y)
  psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  X = a_Abs psi0 A a -> Y = a_Abs psi0 A' a' ->
  Par P psi b b' -> Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi X Y M.
  induction M as [PM psiM X0 Y0 Hm | PM psiM X0 Y0 Ymid Hm Mtail IH].
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b b' EX EY Hn Hself.
    subst X0. subst Y0. apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PM psiM psi0 A a A' a' b b' Hm
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b' Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b' Hn))).
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b b' EX EY Hn Hself.
    subst X0. subst Y0.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PM psiM psi0 A a Ymid Hm) as
      [L [A2 [a2 [EYmid [HlcA2 Hbody]]]]].
    subst Ymid.
    have Htail : MultiPar PM psiM (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
    { exact (IH psi0 A2 a2 A' a' b b' eq_refl eq_refl Hn Hself). }
    have Hstep : Par PM psiM (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PM psiM psi0 A a A2 a2 b b Hm
               (fun _ => Hself) (proj1 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b Hself))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b Hself))). }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_one : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  forall (M:MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a')),
  Par P psi b b' ->
  Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' M Hn Hself.
  exact (@MultiPar_Abs_arg_one_gen P psi
           (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') M
           psi0 A a A' a' b b' eq_refl eq_refl Hn Hself).
Qed.

(* Transitivity of MultiPar (needed to compose the two phases). *)
Lemma MultiPar_trans : forall P psi a b c,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b c H. induction H.
  - intros Hbc. eapply MP_Step; [exact H|exact Hbc].
  - intros Hbc. eapply MP_Step; [exact H|exact (IHMultiPar Hbc)].
Qed.

     Joins P psi a1 a2.

     lc_tm a1 ->

      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Lemma Par_drop_src : forall (P:econtext) x psi0 psi a b,
  Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi a b ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
  Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P x psi0 psi a b H Hfa.
  have Hu := Par_uniq H.
  have Hb : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x x psi0 psi0 P eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hres := (proj1 Par_drop_mut) ((x,psi0)::P) psi a b H x psi0 Hb Hfa.
  rewrite (@remove_cons_self P x psi0
             (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 grade x psi0 P Hu)) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

          (open_tm_wrt_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 d) (a_Var_f x)).

    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 grade x0 psi0 P Hu.

Lemma open_close_subst : forall (t:tm) x y k,
  y <> x ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x t) =
  subst_tm (a_Var_f y) x t.
Proof.
  move=> t. induction t => xx yy k Hxy; simpl; auto.
  - (* Pi *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy (S k) Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Abs *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy (S k) Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* App *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Var_b *)
    change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy)
              (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_b n)) = a_Var_b n).
    rewrite (@oc_var_b xx yy k n). reflexivity.
  - (* Var_f *)
    change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy)
              (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_f x)) =
            subst_tm (a_Var_f yy) xx (a_Var_f x)).
    rewrite (@oc_var_f xx yy k x). reflexivity.
  - (* CEq *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt3 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Transp *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* T *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Box *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Unbox *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* SSigma *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy (S k) Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* SPair *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj1 *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj2 *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* If *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt3 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma fv_close_notin : forall (t:tm) x k,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x t)).
Proof.
  move=> t. induction t => xx k; simpl; auto.
  - (* Var_b *) destruct (lt_dec n k); simpl; apply notin_empty.
  - (* Var_f *) simpl. set (u := eq_var xx x). destruct u as [e|ne].

    + simpl. intro Hin. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 x xx) in Hin.
      exfalso. exact (ne (eq_sym Hin)).
Qed.

        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Conv *) exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Refl *) apply GE_Refl. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_CEq *) eapply GE_CEq.
    + exact (Typing_lc H1).
    + exact (Typing_lc H1).
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H3 (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle))).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H3 (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle))).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle).
  - (* T_Transp *) eapply GE_Transp.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_T *) apply GE_T. exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Box *) eapply GE_Box.
    case E: (psi0 <= psi').
    + have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
      apply CGE_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle0)].
    + have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
      apply CGE_NLeq.
      * exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H).
      * exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H).
      * exact Hnle.
      * apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Unbox *) apply GE_Unbox.
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
  - (* T_SSigma *) eapply GE_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W))).
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W)) Hx.
      exact (H1 x HxL psi' Hle).
  - (* T_SPair *) eapply GE_SPair.
    + case E: (psi0 <= psi').
      * have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
        apply CGE_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle0)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CGE_NLeq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
    + exact (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Proj1 *) apply GE_Proj1Cong.
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
  - (* T_Proj2 *) apply GE_Proj2Cong. exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_TyUnit *) apply GE_TyUnit. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_TmUnit *) apply GE_TmUnit. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Bool *) apply GE_Bool. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_True *) apply GE_True. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_False *) apply GE_False. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_If *) eapply GE_If.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
Qed.

Fixpoint lc_d (n:nat) (a:tm) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | a_Var_b k => lt k n
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi _ A B => lc_d n A /\ lc_d (S n) B
  | a_Abs _ A B => lc_d n A /\ lc_d (S n) B
  | a_App a _ b => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b /\ lc_d n A
  | a_Refl => True
  | a_Transp a b => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b
  | a_T _ A => lc_d n A
  | a_Box _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_Unbox _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_SSigma _ A B => lc_d n A /\ lc_d (S n) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_Bool => True
  | a_True => True
  | a_False => True
  | a_If a b0 b1 => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b0 /\ lc_d n b1
  end.

Definition lcD (a:tm) := lc_d 0 a.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B))
 | lc_a_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a psi b))
 | lc_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     (lc_tm (a_Type s))
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_CEq : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A))
 | lc_a_Refl :
     (lc_tm a_Refl)
 | lc_a_Transp : forall (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Transp a b))
 | lc_a_T : forall (psi:grade) (A:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
     (lc_tm (a_T psi A))
 | lc_a_Box : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Box psi a))
 | lc_a_Unbox : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Unbox psi a))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj1 psi a))
 | lc_a_Proj2 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj2 psi a))
 | lc_a_Bool :
     (lc_tm a_Bool)
 | lc_a_True :
     (lc_tm a_True)
 | lc_a_False :
     (lc_tm a_False)
 | lc_a_If : forall (a b0 b1:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b0) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm (a_If a b0 b1)).

Lemma Par_App_inv : forall P psi a psi0 b c,
  Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) c ->
  (exists a' b' A, c = open_tm_wrt_tm a' b' /\
     Par P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a') /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b')
  \/ (exists a' b', c = a_App a' psi0 b' /\
     Par P psi a a' /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi a psi0 b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
  - right. eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.


Lemma Par_Transp_inv : forall P psi a0 b0 c,
  Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) c ->
  (exists a1 b1, c = a_Transp a1 b1 /\ Par P psi a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b1)
  \/ (exists b1, c = b1 /\ Par P psi a0 a_Refl /\ Par P psi b0 b1).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 b0 c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
  - right. eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_Unbox_inv : forall P psi psi0 a c,
  Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) c ->
  (exists b, c = a_Unbox psi0 b /\ Par P psi a b /\ psi0 <= psi)
  \/ (exists b, c = b /\ Par P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) /\ psi0 <= psi).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
  - right. eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_Proj1_inv : forall P psi psi0 a0 c,
  Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) c ->
  (exists a1, c = a_Proj1 psi0 a1 /\ Par P psi a0 a1 /\ psi0 <= psi)
  \/ (exists a1 a2, c = a1 /\ Par P psi a0 (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) /\ psi0 <= psi).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a0 c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
  - right. eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_Proj2_inv : forall P psi psi0 a0 c,
  Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) c ->
  (exists a1, c = a_Proj2 psi0 a1 /\ Par P psi a0 a1)
  \/ (exists a1 a2, c = a2 /\ Par P psi a0 (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2)).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a0 c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists. split; [reflexivity|eauto].
  - right. eexists. eexists. split; [reflexivity|eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_If_inv : forall P psi a0 b0 b1 c,
  Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) c ->
  (exists a1 b2 b3, c = a_If a1 b2 b3 /\
     Par P psi a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b2 /\ Par P psi b1 b3)
  \/ (exists b2 b3, c = b2 /\
     Par P psi a0 a_True /\ Par P psi b0 b2 /\ Par P psi b1 b3)
  \/ (exists b2 b3, c = b3 /\
     Par P psi a0 a_False /\ Par P psi b0 b2 /\ Par P psi b1 b3).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 b0 b1 c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; [eauto|split; eauto]].
  - right; left. eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; [eauto|split; eauto]].
  - right; right. eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; [eauto|split; eauto]].
Qed.


Lemma Par_Abs_inv : forall P psi psi0 A b c,
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) c ->
  exists L A2 b2, c = a_Abs psi0 A2 b2 /\ lc_tm A2 /\
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
                                (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A b c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_Pi_inv : forall P psi psi1 A B c,
  Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A B) c ->
  exists L A2 B2, c = a_Pi psi1 A2 B2 /\ Par P psi A A2 /\
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       Par ((x,psi1)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi1 A B c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_SSigma_inv : forall P psi psi0 A B c,
  Par P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) c ->
  exists L A2 B2, c = a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2 /\ Par P psi A A2 /\
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A B c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_CEq_inv : forall P psi psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0 c,
  Par P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) c ->
  exists a1 b1 A1, c = a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1 /\ lc_tm A1 /\
    Par P psi a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b1 /\ psi0 <= psi.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0 c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; [eauto|split; [eauto|split; eauto]]].
Qed.

Lemma Par_T_inv : forall P psi psi0 A c,
  Par P psi (a_T psi0 A) c ->
  exists B, c = a_T psi0 B /\ Par P psi A B.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists. split; [reflexivity|eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_Box_inv : forall P psi psi0 a c,
  Par P psi (a_Box psi0 a) c ->
  exists b, c = a_Box psi0 b /\ CPar P psi psi0 a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists. split; [reflexivity|eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_SPair_inv : forall P psi a0 psi0 b0 c,
  Par P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) c ->
  exists a1 b1, c = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\ CPar P psi psi0 a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 psi0 b0 c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

(* ================= the diamond ================= *)

Definition PDPar (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (H:Par P psi a b) : Prop :=
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Arguments PDPar _ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.

Definition PDCPar (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) (H:CPar P psi psi0 a b) : Prop :=
  forall c, CPar P psi psi0 a c -> exists d, CPar P psi psi0 b d /\ CPar P psi psi0 c d.
Arguments PDCPar _ _ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.

GDefEq_mutind
     : forall
         (P : forall (e : econtext) (s : grade) (t t0 : tm),
              GDefEq e s t t0 -> Prop)
         (P0 : forall (e : econtext) (s s0 : grade) (t t0 : tm),
               CGDefEq e s s0 t t0 -> Prop),
       (forall (P1 : econtext) (psi : grade) (x : tmvar) 
          (psi0 : grade) (u : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P1)
          (i : (psi0 <= psi)%O) (b : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 P1),
        P P1 psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x) (GE_Var P1 psi x psi0 u i b)) ->
       (forall (P1 : econtext) (psi : grade) (s : sort)
          (u : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P1),
        P P1 psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s) (GE_Type P1 psi s u)) ->
       (forall (P1 : econtext) (psi : grade) (b a : tm)
          (g : GDefEq P1 psi a b),
        P P1 psi a b g -> P P1 psi b a (GE_Sym P1 psi b a g)) ->
       (forall (P1 : econtext) (psi : grade) (a b b0 : tm)
          (g : GDefEq P1 psi a b0),
        P P1 psi a b0 g ->
        forall g0 : GDefEq P1 psi b0 b,
        P P1 psi b0 b g0 -> P P1 psi a b (GE_Trans P1 psi a b b0 g g0)) ->
       (forall (P1 : econtext) (psi : grade) (b0 : tm) 
          (psi0 : grade) (a0 b1 a1 : tm) (g : GDefEq P1 psi b0 b1),
        P P1 psi b0 b1 g ->
        forall c : CGDefEq P1 psi psi0 a0 a1,
        P0 P1 psi psi0 a0 a1 c ->
        P P1 psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App b1 psi0 a1)
          (GE_App P1 psi b0 psi0 a0 b1 a1 g c)) ->
       (forall (L : MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.t) 
          (P1 : econtext) (psi psi0 : grade) (A0 b0 A1 b1 : tm)
          (l : lc_tm A0) (l0 : lc_tm A1)
          (g : forall x : MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom,
               ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L ->
               GDefEq (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, psi0) ++ P1)%list psi
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x))
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))),
        (forall (x : MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom)
           (n : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L),
         P (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, psi0) ++ P1)%list psi
           (open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
           (g x n)) ->
        P P1 psi (a_Abs psi0 A0 b0) (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1)
          (GE_Abs L P1 psi psi0 A0 b0 A1 b1 l l0 g)) ->
       (forall (L : MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.t) 
          (P1 : econtext) (psi psi0 : grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1 : tm)
          (g : GDefEq P1 psi A0 A1),
        P P1 psi A0 A1 g ->
        forall
          g0 : forall x : MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom,
               ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L ->
               GDefEq (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, psi0) ++ P1)%list psi
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x))
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)),
        (forall (x : MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom)
           (n : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L),
         P (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, psi0) ++ P1)%list psi
           (open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
           (g0 x n)) ->
        P P1 psi (a_Pi psi0 A0 B0) (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1)
          (GE_Pi L P1 psi psi0 A0 B0 A1 B1 g g0)) ->
       (forall (P1 : econtext) (psi : grade) (a : tm) 
          (psi0 : grade) (b0 a0 b1 A : tm)
          (g : GDefEq P1 psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a0)),
        P P1 psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a0) g ->
        forall c : CGDefEq P1 psi psi0 b0 b1,
        P0 P1 psi psi0 b0 b1 c ->
        P P1 psi (a_App a psi0 b0) (open_tm_wrt_tm a0 b1)

Lemma CGDefEq_sym : forall P psi psi0 a b, CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 b a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H. induction H.
  - eapply CGE_Leq; [exact H|apply GE_Sym; exact H0].
  - eapply CGE_NLeq; [exact H0|exact H|exact H1|exact H2]. 
Qed.
Lemma CGDefEq_trans : forall P psi psi0 a b c,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 b c -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b c H1 H2.
  have Hl1 := CGDefEq_lc H1. have Hl2 := CGDefEq_lc H2.
  case E: (psi0 <= psi).
  - inversion H1; subst.
    + inversion H2; subst.
      * eapply CGE_Leq; [exact E | eapply GE_Trans; eauto].
      * exfalso; eauto.
    + exfalso; eauto.
  - inversion H1; subst.
    + exfalso. move: H. rewrite E. done.
    + eapply CGE_NLeq; [exact (proj1 Hl1) | exact (proj2 Hl2) | move=> Hle; rewrite E in Hle; done | eauto].
Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_self_r : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 b b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H. have Hl := CGDefEq_lc H.
  case E: (psi0 <= psi).
  - inversion H; subst.
    + eapply CGE_Leq; [exact E | eapply GE_Trans; [apply GE_Sym; exact H1 | exact H1]].
    + exfalso. eauto.
  - inversion H; subst.
    + exfalso. move: H0. rewrite E. done.
    + eapply CGE_NLeq; [exact H1 | exact H1 | move=> Hle; rewrite E in Hle; done | exact H3].
Qed.
Lemma CGDefEq_self_l : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H. have Hl := CGDefEq_lc H.
  case E: (psi0 <= psi).
  - inversion H; subst.
    + eapply CGE_Leq; [exact E | eapply GE_Trans; [exact H1 | apply GE_Sym; exact H1]].
    + exfalso. eauto.
  - inversion H; subst.
    + exfalso. move: H0. rewrite E. done.
    + eapply CGE_NLeq; [exact H0 | exact H0 | move=> Hle; rewrite E in Hle; done | exact H3].

Lemma CGE_leq_gdefeq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> GDefEq P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle H. inversion H; subst.
  - assumption.
  - exfalso. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Par_gdefeq : forall P psi a b, Par P psi a b -> GDefEq P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  induction H using Par_mutind2
    with (P0 := fun P psi psi0 a b _ => CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b).

    | |- CGDefEq _ _ _ _ _ => idtac

  - eapply CGE_Leq; [exact i | exact IHPar].
  - eapply CGE_NLeq; [exact l | exact l0 | exact n | exact u].
Qed.
Lemma CPar_cgdefeq : forall P psi psi0 a b, CPar P psi psi0 a b -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b.
Proof.

  - eapply CGE_Leq; [exact H0 | apply Par_gdefeq; exact H1].
  - eapply CGE_NLeq; [exact H0 | exact H1 | exact H2 | exact H3].

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.

Lemma MultiPar_gdefeq : forall P psi a b,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> GDefEq P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H. induction H.
  - apply Par_gdefeq. exact H.
  - eapply GE_Trans; [apply Par_gdefeq; exact H | exact IHMultiPar].
Qed.

(* Par self of the argument of a self-reducible abstraction. *)
Lemma CPar_self_abs_arg : forall P psi psi0 A a b,
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
  CPar P psi psi0 b b ->
  Par P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a b Hself Hc.
  have Hc' := Hc.
  have Hcond : psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi b b.
  { move=> Hle. inversion Hc; subst.
    - exact H2.
    - exfalso. exact (H3 Hle). }
  have Hl := CPar_lc Hc'.
  exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step P psi psi0 A a A a b b Hself Hcond (proj1 Hl) (proj2 Hl)).
Qed.

(* Par self of components of a reflexive SPair / Box step. *)
Lemma Par_SPair_self_l : forall P psi a psi0 b,
  Par P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SPair a psi0 b) ->
  CPar P psi psi0 a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a psi0 b H.
  destruct (@Par_SPair_inv P psi a psi0 b (a_SPair a psi0 b) H)
    as [a1 [b1 [E [Hc Hp]]]].
  inversion E; subst. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma Par_SPair_self_r : forall P psi a psi0 b,
  Par P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SPair a psi0 b) ->
  Par P psi b b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a psi0 b H.
  destruct (@Par_SPair_inv P psi a psi0 b (a_SPair a psi0 b) H)
    as [a1 [b1 [E [Hc Hp]]]].
  inversion E; subst. exact Hp.
Qed.

Lemma Par_Box_self_c : forall P psi psi0 a,
  Par P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 a) ->
  CPar P psi psi0 a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a H.
  destruct (@Par_Box_inv P psi psi0 a (a_Box psi0 a) H) as [b [E Hc]].
  inversion E; subst. exact Hc.

  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' H Hcond Hlcb Hlcb'.
  inversion H; subst.
  (* Context now contains the fresh set L, lc annotations, and the
     pointwise body relation H9. *)
  set S := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L
             (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a)
               (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a')
                 (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
                   (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
                     (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P))))).
  destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh S) as [x0 Hx0].
  have Hx0L : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 L :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 L _ Hx0.
  have Hx0rest : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a')
          (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
            (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
              (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P))))) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 L _ Hx0.
  have Hx0a : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm a) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm a) _ Hx0rest.
  have Hx0rest1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a')
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
          (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
            (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P)))) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm a) _ Hx0rest.
  have Hx0a' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm a') :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm a') _ Hx0rest1.
  have Hx0rest2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
          (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P))) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm a') _ Hx0rest1.
  have Hx0b : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm b) _ Hx0rest2.
  have Hx0rest3 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b') (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P)) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm b) _ Hx0rest2.
  have Hx0b' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b') :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm b') _ Hx0rest3.
  have Hx0dom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm b') _ Hx0rest3.

  have HuniqP : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P :=
    @Par_uniq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') H.
  have Huniq0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x0 psi0 P HuniqP Hx0dom.
  have Hbindx0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x0 psi0 ((x0,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x0 x0 psi0 psi0 P eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hbody0 : Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi
      (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x0)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x0)) :=
    H9 x0 Hx0L.
  have Hcond0 : psi0 <= psi -> Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi b b' :=
    fun Hle => @Par_weaken P psi b b' (Hcond Hle) ((x0,psi0)::P)
      (fun z g Hz => @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_3 grade z x0 g psi0 P Hz)

      (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x0)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x0)) Hbody0

  rewrite (@subst_open_self a b x0 Hlcb Hx0a) in Hsub.
  rewrite (@subst_open_self a' b' x0 Hlcb' Hx0a') in Hsub.
  have Hnotin : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm a b)) :=
    @notin_fv_open a b x0 Hx0a Hx0b.
  exact (@Par_drop_src P x0 psi0 psi

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Variants with one derivation a single parallel step.          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_one_arg : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') ->
  forall (N:MultiPar P psi b b'),
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' Hm N.
  induction N as [PN psiN bS bT Hn | PN psiN bS bT bM Hn Ntail IH].
  - move=> Hself. apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A' a' bS bT Hm
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))).
  - move=> Hself.
    have Hstep : Par PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bS) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bM Hself
               (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))). }
    have Htail : MultiPar PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' bT).
    { apply IH; [exact Hm | exact Hself]. }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

(* Body is an arbitrary multi-step derivation, the argument is a
   single parallel step.  We state a generalized version over the
   body endpoints, since the intermediate body steps are only known
   to be abstractions after inversion. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_one_gen : forall P psi (X Y:tm) (M:MultiPar P psi X Y)
  psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  X = a_Abs psi0 A a -> Y = a_Abs psi0 A' a' ->
  Par P psi b b' -> Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi X Y M.
  induction M as [PM psiM X0 Y0 Hm | PM psiM X0 Y0 Ymid Hm Mtail IH].
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b b' EX EY Hn Hself.
    subst X0. subst Y0. apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PM psiM psi0 A a A' a' b b' Hm
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b' Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b' Hn))).
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b b' EX EY Hn Hself.
    subst X0. subst Y0.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PM psiM psi0 A a Ymid Hm) as
      [L [A2 [a2 [EYmid [HlcA2 Hbody]]]]].
    subst Ymid.
    have Htail : MultiPar PM psiM (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
    { exact (IH psi0 A2 a2 A' a' b b' eq_refl eq_refl Hn Hself). }
    have Hstep : Par PM psiM (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PM psiM psi0 A a A2 a2 b b Hm
               (fun _ => Hself) (proj1 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b Hself))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b Hself))). }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_one : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  forall (M:MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a')),
  Par P psi b b' ->
  Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' M Hn Hself.
  exact (@MultiPar_Abs_arg_one_gen P psi
           (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') M
           psi0 A a A' a' b b' eq_refl eq_refl Hn Hself).
Qed.

(* Transitivity of MultiPar (needed to compose the two phases). *)
(* A multi-step argument path at a fixed (self-reducible) abstraction. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_self_body : forall P psi psi0 A a b b',
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
  forall (N:MultiPar P psi b b'),
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a b b' Hself N.
  induction N as [PN psiN bS bT Hn | PN psiN bS bT bM Hn Ntail IH].
  - apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bT Hself
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))).
  - have Hstep : Par PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bS) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bM Hself
               (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))). }
    have Htail : MultiPar PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bT).
    { exact (IH Hself). }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

(* Multi-step body path with a self-reducible argument. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_self_arg : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b,
  forall (M:MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a')),
  Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b M Hself.
  exact (@MultiPar_Abs_arg_one P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b M Hself Hself).
Qed.

  Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x0)) d ->
  Par ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
          (open_tm_wrt_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 d) (a_Var_f x)).

  move=> P psi psi0 b d x0 x Hxx0 Hxdom Hx0b Hu H.
  have HuP : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 grade x0 psi0 P Hu.
  have Hx0dom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 grade x0 psi0 P Hu.
  have Hx0x : x0 <> x := fun e => Hxx0 (eq_sym e).
  have Hux : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x psi0 P HuP Hxdom.
  have Hx0not : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom ((x,psi0)::P)).
  { simpl. intro Hin.
    apply Hx0dom.
    exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) x x0 Hxx0 Hin). }
  have Hux0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x0 psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) Hux Hx0not.
  have Hincl : forall z g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds z g ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
                            Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds z g ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P).
  { move=> z g Hz. unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds in *.
    simpl in *. destruct Hz as [E|Hin]; [left; exact E|right; right; exact Hin]. }
  have Hw : Par ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi
               (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x0)) d.
  { exact (@Par_weaken ((x0,psi0)::P) psi
             (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x0)) d H
             ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) Hincl Hux0). }

    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x0 x0 psi0 psi0 ((x,psi0)::P) eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hbindx : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi0 ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P).
  { unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds. simpl. right. left. reflexivity. }
  have Hlcx : lc_tm (a_Var_f x) := lc_a_Var_f x.
  have Hcond : psi0 <= psi -> Par ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x).
  { move=> Hle. exact (@Par_Var ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi x psi0 Hux0 Hle Hbindx). }
  have Hsub := @Par_subst_cond ((x0,psi0)::(x,psi0)::P) psi
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x0)) d Hw
                 x0 psi0 (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x) Hux0 Hbindx0 Hlcx Hlcx Hcond.
  rewrite (@subst_open_self b (a_Var_f x) x0 Hlcx Hx0b) in Hsub.
  rewrite <- (@open_close_subst d x0 x 0 Hxx0) in Hsub.
  have Hfa : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
               (fv_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))) :=
    @fv_open_notin b x x0 0 Hx0x Hx0b.
  exact (@Par_drop_src ((x,psi0)::P) x0 psi0 psi
           (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
           (open_tm_wrt_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 d) (a_Var_f x)) Hsub Hfa).
Qed.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Par P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | Par_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     lc_tm A1 ->
     lc_tm A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_Refl a_Refl
 | Par_Transp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 a1 b1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp a1 b1)
 | Par_CEq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 b0:tm) (psi1:grade) (A0 a1 b1 A1:tm),
     lc_tm A0 ->
     lc_tm A1 ->
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_CEq psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0) (a_CEq psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1)
 | Par_TranspRefl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a_Refl ->
     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) b1
 | Par_T : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Par P psi A B ->
     Par P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 B)
 | Par_Box : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a b ->
     Par P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 b)
 | Par_Unbox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 b)
 | Par_UnboxBox : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) b
 | Par_Proj1Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a0) (a_Proj1 psi0 a1)
 | Par_Proj2Cong : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a0 a1:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a0) (a_Proj2 psi0 a1)
 | Par_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 b) a1
 | Par_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b a2 a1:tm),
     Par P psi b (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 b) a2
 | Par_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0:tm) (psi0:grade) (b0 a1 b1:tm),

     Par P psi b0 b1 ->
     Par P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1)
 | Par_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A0 B0 A1 B1:tm),
     Par P psi A0 A1 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B0 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B0) (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1)
 | Par_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Par_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | Par_Bool : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_Bool a_Bool
 | Par_True : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_True a_True
 | Par_False : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Par P psi a_False a_False
 | Par_If : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3:tm),
     Par P psi a0 a1 ->
     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b3 ->
     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) (a_If a1 b2 b3)
 | Par_IfTrue : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a0 b0 b1 b2 b3:tm),

     Par P psi b0 b2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b3 ->

     Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) b3.

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.
From G Require Import base.

Lemma open_close_self_rec : forall (t:tm) x k,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x t) = t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros x k; simpl; auto.
  - (* Pi *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x (S k)). reflexivity.
  - (* Abs *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x (S k)). reflexivity.
  - (* App *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x k). reflexivity.
  - (* Var_b *) rename n into n.
    destruct (lt_dec n k) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_lt (S n) k x ltac:(lia)). reflexivity.
    + have hge : k <= n by lia.
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec (S n) k) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt].
      * exfalso. lia.
      * exfalso. lia.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* Var_f *) destruct (eq_var x a) as [e|ne].
    + subst a. simpl. reflexivity.
    + simpl. reflexivity.
  - (* CEq *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x k). rewrite (IHt3 x k). reflexivity.
  - (* Transp *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x k). reflexivity.
  - (* T *) rewrite (IHt x k). reflexivity.
  - (* Box *) rewrite (IHt x k). reflexivity.
  - (* Unbox *) rewrite (IHt x k). reflexivity.
  - (* SSigma *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x (S k)). reflexivity.
  - (* SPair *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x k). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj1 *) rewrite (IHt x k). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj2 *) rewrite (IHt x k). reflexivity.
  - (* If *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x k). rewrite (IHt3 x k). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma close_open_self_rec : forall (t:tm) x k,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm t) ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) t) = t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros x k Hfv; simpl; auto.
  - (* Pi *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x (S k)).
    + reflexivity.
    + exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv).
    + exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv).
  - (* Abs *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x (S k)).
    + reflexivity.
    + exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv).
    + exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv).
  - (* App *) rewrite (IHt1 x k). rewrite (IHt2 x k).
    + reflexivity.
    + exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv).
    + exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv).
  - (* Var_b *) rename n into n.
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h|h]|h]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + subst n. simpl. reflexivity.
    + simpl.
      destruct (lt_dec (n - 1) k) as [hlt|hge].
      * exfalso. lia.
      * rewrite Nat.sub_succ. simpl. rewrite Nat.sub_0_r. reflexivity.
  - (* Var_f *) simpl.
    destruct (eq_var x a) as [e|ne].

  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) ->

  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm u x0))
            (a_Abs psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm v x0)).

  move=> P psi psi0 A x0 u v Hu HlcA Hstep.
  eapply (@Par_Abs
            (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P)
               (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x0))
            P psi psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm u x0) A (close_tm_wrt_tm v x0)).

    have Hxdom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) :=

Lemma is_left_eq_dec_comm : forall (A:Type) (E:EqDec_eq A) x y,
  @is_left (@eq A x y) (not (@eq A x y)) (@eq_dec A E x y) =
  @is_left (@eq A y x) (not (@eq A y x)) (@eq_dec A E y x).
Proof.
  move=> A E x y. simpl.
  destruct (@eq_dec A E x y) as [e|ne].
  - destruct (@eq_dec A E y x) as [e'|ne']; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. exact (ne' (eq_sym e)).
  - destruct (@eq_dec A E y x) as [e'|ne']; simpl.
    + exfalso. exact (ne (eq_sym e')).
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint fv_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Type s) => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_CEq psi a b psi0 A) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b) \u (fv_tm A)
  | a_Refl => {}
  | (a_Transp a b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_T psi A) => (fv_tm A)
  | (a_Box psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Unbox psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm A) \u (fv_tm B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm a)
  | a_Bool => {}
  | a_True => {}
  | a_False => {}
  | (a_If a b0 b1) => (fv_tm a) \u (fv_tm b0) \u (fv_tm b1)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))

Lemma Par_T_inv : forall P psi psi0 A c,
  Par P psi (a_T psi0 A) c ->
  exists B, c = a_T psi0 B /\ Par P psi A B.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists. split; [reflexivity|eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_Box_inv : forall P psi psi0 a c,
  Par P psi (a_Box psi0 a) c ->
  exists b, c = a_Box psi0 b /\ CPar P psi psi0 a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists. split; [reflexivity|eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_SPair_inv : forall P psi a0 psi0 b0 c,
  Par P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) c ->
  exists a1 b1, c = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\ CPar P psi psi0 a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 psi0 b0 c H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

(* ================= the diamond ================= *)

Definition PDPar (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (H:Par P psi a b) : Prop :=
  forall c, Par P psi a c -> exists d, Par P psi b d /\ Par P psi c d.
Arguments PDPar _ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.

From Coq Require Import Lia.
From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.
From G Require Import base.
From G Require Import self.
From G Require Import self3.
From G Require Import lift0.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* CPar at a smaller grade is a Par step                         *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma CPar_leq_inv : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CPar P psi psi0 a b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle Hc.
  inversion Hc; subst.
  - exact H1.
  - exfalso. exact (H2 Hle).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Multi-step lifting under binders                              *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma MultiPar_under_abs_close : forall P psi psi0 A x0 u v,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
  lc_tm A ->
  MultiPar ((x0,psi0)::P) psi u v ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 u))
                 (a_Abs psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 v)).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A x0 u v Hu HlcA H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. exact (@Par_under_abs_close PN psiN psi0 A x0 s t Hu HlcA Hp).
  - apply MP_Step with (b := a_Abs psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 m)).
    + exact (@Par_under_abs_close PN psiN psi0 A x0 s m Hu HlcA Hp).
    + exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_under_pi_close : forall P psi psi0 A0 A1 x0 u v,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
  Par P psi A0 A1 ->
  MultiPar ((x0,psi0)::P) psi u v ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Pi psi0 A0 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 u))
                 (a_Pi psi0 A1 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 v)).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A0 A1 x0 u v Hu Hdom H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. exact (@Par_under_pi_close_dom PN psiN psi0 A0 A1 x0 s t Hu Hdom Hp).
  - apply MP_Step with (b := a_Pi psi0 A0 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 m)).
    + exact (@Par_under_pi_close_dom PN psiN psi0 A0 A1 x0 s m Hu Hdom Hp).
    + exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_under_pi_close_self : forall P psi psi0 A x0 u v,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
  Par P psi A A ->
  MultiPar ((x0,psi0)::P) psi u v ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Pi psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 u))
                 (a_Pi psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 v)).
Proof. move=> P psi psi0 A x0 u v H Hu. exact (@MultiPar_under_pi_close P psi psi0 A A x0 u v H Hu). Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_under_sigma_close : forall P psi psi0 A0 A1 x0 u v,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
  Par P psi A0 A1 ->
  MultiPar ((x0,psi0)::P) psi u v ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 u))
                 (a_SSigma psi0 A1 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 v)).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A0 A1 x0 u v Hu Hdom H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. exact (@Par_under_sigma_close_dom PN psiN psi0 A0 A1 x0 s t Hu Hdom Hp).
  - apply MP_Step with (b := a_SSigma psi0 A0 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 m)).
    + exact (@Par_under_sigma_close_dom PN psiN psi0 A0 A1 x0 s m Hu Hdom Hp).
    + exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_under_sigma_close_self : forall P psi psi0 A x0 u v,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
  Par P psi A A ->
  MultiPar ((x0,psi0)::P) psi u v ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 u))
                 (a_SSigma psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 v)).
Proof. move=> P psi psi0 A x0 u v H Hu. exact (@MultiPar_under_sigma_close P psi psi0 A A x0 u v H Hu). Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Shape lemmas for multi-step reductions                        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_shape : forall P psi psi0 A a d,
  MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) d ->
  exists L A' a', d = a_Abs psi0 A' a' /\ lc_tm A' /\
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       MultiPar ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x))
                                  (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a d H.
  remember (a_Abs psi0 A a) as src eqn:E.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PN psiN psi0 A a t Hp) as [L [A2 [a2 [Et [Hlc2 Hbody]]]]].
    subst t. exists L, A2, a2. split; [reflexivity|split; [exact Hlc2|]].
    move=> x Hx. apply MP_One. exact (Hbody x Hx).
  - subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PN psiN psi0 A a t Hp) as [L [A2 [a2 [Et [Hlc2 Hbody]]]]].
    subst t.
    destruct (IH psi0 A2 a2 eq_refl) as
      [L' [A' [a' [Ed [Hlc' Hbody']]]]].
    exists (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L L'), A', a'.
    split; [exact Ed|split; [exact Hlc'|]].
    move=> x Hx.
    have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L L' Hx.
    have HxL' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L' :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L L' Hx.
    eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (Hbody x HxL).
    + exact (Hbody' x HxL').
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Box_shape : forall P psi psi0 a d,
  psi0 <= psi ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Box psi0 a) d ->
  exists b, d = a_Box psi0 b /\ MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a d Hle H.
  remember (a_Box psi0 a) as src eqn:E.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Box_inv PN psiN psi0 a t Hp) as [b [Et Hc]].
    subst t. exists b. split; [reflexivity|].
    apply MP_One. exact (@CPar_leq_inv PN psiN psi0 a b Hle Hc).
  - subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Box_inv PN psiN psi0 a t Hp) as [b [Et Hc]].
    subst t.
    destruct (IH psi0 b eq_refl) as [b' [Ed Htail']].
    exists b'. split; [exact Ed|].
    eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@CPar_leq_inv PN psiN psi0 a b Hle Hc).
    + exact Htail'.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_SPair_shape : forall P psi a0 psi0 b0 d,
  psi0 <= psi ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) d ->
  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\
    MultiPar P psi a0 a1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 psi0 b0 d Hle H.
  remember (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) as src eqn:E.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - subst s.
    destruct (@Par_SPair_inv PN psiN a0 psi0 b0 t Hp) as
      [a1 [b1 [Et [Hc Hpb]]]].
    subst t. exists a1, b1. split; [reflexivity|split].
    + apply MP_One. exact (@CPar_leq_inv PN psiN psi0 a0 a1 Hle Hc).
    + apply MP_One. exact Hpb.
  - subst s.
    destruct (@Par_SPair_inv PN psiN a0 psi0 b0 t Hp) as
      [a1 [b1 [Et [Hc Hpb]]]].
    subst t.
    destruct (IH psi0 a1 b1 eq_refl) as [a2 [b2 [Ed [Hpa2 Hpb2]]]].
    exists a2, b2. split; [exact Ed|split].
    + eapply MP_Step.
      * exact (@CPar_leq_inv PN psiN psi0 a0 a1 Hle Hc).
      * exact Hpa2.
    + eapply MP_Step.
      * exact Hpb.
      * exact Hpb2.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_SPair_shape_snd : forall P psi a0 psi0 b0 d,
  MultiPar P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) d ->
  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 psi0 b0 d H.
  remember (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) as src eqn:E.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - subst s.
    destruct (@Par_SPair_inv PN psiN a0 psi0 b0 t Hp) as
      [a1 [b1 [Et [Hc Hpb]]]].
    subst t. exists a1, b1. split; [reflexivity|].
    apply MP_One. exact Hpb.
  - subst s.
    destruct (@Par_SPair_inv PN psiN a0 psi0 b0 t Hp) as
      [a1 [b1 [Et [Hc Hpb]]]].
    subst t.
    destruct (IH psi0 a1 b1 eq_refl) as [a2 [b2 [Ed Hpb2]]].
    exists a2, b2. split; [exact Ed|].
    eapply MP_Step.
    + exact Hpb.
    + exact Hpb2.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_True_shape : forall P psi d,
  MultiPar P psi a_True d -> d = a_True.
Proof.
  move=> P psi d H. induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - inversion Hp; subst; reflexivity.
  - inversion Hp; subst. exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_False_shape : forall P psi d,
  MultiPar P psi a_False d -> d = a_False.
Proof.
  move=> P psi d H. induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - inversion Hp; subst; reflexivity.
  - inversion Hp; subst. exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Refl_shape : forall P psi d,
  MultiPar P psi a_Refl d -> d = a_Refl.
Proof.
  move=> P psi d H. induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - inversion Hp; subst; reflexivity.
  - inversion Hp; subst. exact IH.
Qed.

  MultiPar P psi src d ->
  forall psi0 A a, src = a_Abs psi0 A a ->
  exists L A' a', d = a_Abs psi0 A' a' /\ lc_tm A' /\
    (forall x : tmvar, ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L ->
       MultiPar ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x))
                                  (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> psi0 A a E. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PN psiN psi0 A a t Hp) as [L [A2 [a2 [Et [Hlc2 Hbody]]]]].
    subst t. exists L, A2, a2. split; [reflexivity|split; [exact Hlc2|]].
    move=> x Hx. apply MP_One. exact (Hbody x Hx).
  - move=> psi0 A a E. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PN psiN psi0 A a m Hp) as [L [A2 [a2 [Em [Hlc2 Hbody]]]]].
    destruct (IH psi0 A2 a2 Em) as [L' [A' [a' [Ed [Hlc' Hbody']]]]].
    exists (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L L'), A', a'.
    split; [exact Ed|split; [exact Hlc'|]].
    move=> x Hx.

    + exact (Hbody' x HxL').

  MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) d ->
  exists L A' a', d = a_Abs psi0 A' a' /\ lc_tm A' /\
    (forall x : tmvar, ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L ->
       MultiPar ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x))
                                  (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a d H.
