Lemma MultiPar_Box_shape_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d ->
  forall psi0 a, src = a_Box psi0 a -> psi0 <= psi ->
  exists b, d = a_Box psi0 b /\ MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> psi0 a E Hle. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Box_inv PN psiN psi0 a t Hp) as [b [Et Hc]].
    subst t. exists b. split; [reflexivity|].

  - move=> psi0 a E Hle. subst s.

    destruct (IH psi0 b Em Hle) as [b' [Ed Htail']].
    exists b'. split; [exact Ed|].

  psi0 <= psi ->

  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\
    MultiPar P psi a0 a1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> a0 psi0 b0 E Hle. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_SPair_inv PN psiN a0 psi0 b0 t Hp) as
      [a1 [b1 [Et [Hc Hpb]]]].
    subst t. exists a1, b1. split; [reflexivity|split].
    + apply MP_One. exact (@CPar_leq_inv PN psiN psi0 a0 a1 Hle Hc).

  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\
    MultiPar P psi a0 a1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 psi0 b0 d Hle H.
  exact (@MultiPar_SPair_shape_gen P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) d H a0 psi0 b0 eq_refl Hle).

Lemma MultiPar_SPair_shape_snd_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d ->
  forall a0 psi0 b0, src = a_SPair a0 psi0 b0 ->
  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.

      [a1 [b1 [Em [Hc Hpb]]]].

    exists a2, b2. split; [exact Ed|].

  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.
Proof.

From Coq Require Import Lia.
From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.
From G Require Import base.
From G Require Import self.
From G Require Import self3.
From G Require Import lift0.
From G Require Import lift1.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Multi-step congruence lifts                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma MultiPar_App_fun_leq : forall P psi psi0 b b' a,
  psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi a a ->
  MultiPar P psi b b' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_App b psi0 a) (a_App b' psi0 a).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 b b' a Hle Ha H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_App; [exact Hp|apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Ha]].
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + apply Par_App; [exact Hp|apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Ha]].
    + exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_App_arg_leq : forall P psi psi0 b a a',
  psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_App b psi0 a) (a_App b psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 b a a' Hle Hb H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_App; [exact Hb|apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Hp]].
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + apply Par_App; [exact Hb|apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Hp]].
    + exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_App_fun_nleq : forall P psi psi0 b b' a,
  ~ psi0 <= psi -> lc_tm a -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P ->
  MultiPar P psi b b' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_App b psi0 a) (a_App b' psi0 a).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 b b' a Hnle Hlca Hu H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_App; [exact Hp|apply CPar_Nleq; assumption].
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + apply Par_App; [exact Hp|apply CPar_Nleq; assumption].
    + exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_App_two_leq : forall P psi psi0 b0 dB a0 dA,
  psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi a0 a0 -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P ->
  MultiPar P psi b0 dB -> Par P psi dB dB ->
  MultiPar P psi a0 dA ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App dB psi0 dA).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 b0 dB a0 dA Hle Ha0 Hu Hb HdB Ha.
  have H1 : MultiPar P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App dB psi0 a0) :=
    @MultiPar_App_fun_leq P psi psi0 b0 dB a0 Hle Ha0 Hb.
  have H2 : MultiPar P psi (a_App dB psi0 a0) (a_App dB psi0 dA) :=
    @MultiPar_App_arg_leq P psi psi0 dB a0 dA Hle HdB Ha.
  exact (MultiPar_trans H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Transp_l : forall P psi a a' b,
  Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Transp a b) (a_Transp a' b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a a' b Hb H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_Transp; assumption.
  - eapply MP_Step; [apply Par_Transp; assumption|exact IH].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Transp_r : forall P psi a b b',
  Par P psi a a ->
  MultiPar P psi b b' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Transp a b) (a_Transp a b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b b' Ha H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_Transp; assumption.
  - eapply MP_Step; [apply Par_Transp; assumption|exact IH].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Transp_two : forall P psi a0 b0 dA dB,
  Par P psi a0 a0 -> Par P psi b0 b0 ->
  MultiPar P psi a0 dA -> MultiPar P psi b0 dB ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp dA dB).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 b0 dA dB Ha0 Hb0 Ha Hb.
  have H1 : MultiPar P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp dA b0) :=
    @MultiPar_Transp_l P psi a0 dA b0 Hb0 Ha.
  have H2 : MultiPar P psi (a_Transp dA b0) (a_Transp dA dB) :=
    @MultiPar_Transp_r P psi dA b0 dB
       (proj1 (@Par_lc P psi dA b0 (proj_of_MP _))) Hb.
Abort.

Lemma MultiPar_T : forall P psi psi0 A A',
  MultiPar P psi A A' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 A').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A A' H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_T. exact Hp.
  - eapply MP_Step; [apply Par_T; exact Hp|exact IH].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Box_leq : forall P psi psi0 a a',
  psi0 <= psi ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' Hle H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_Box. apply CPar_Leq; assumption.
  - eapply MP_Step; [apply Par_Box; apply CPar_Leq; assumption|exact IH].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Box_cpar : forall P psi psi0 a a',
  CPar P psi psi0 a a' ->
  Par P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' Hc Hp.
  apply MP_One. apply Par_Box. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Unbox_leq : forall P psi psi0 a a',
  psi0 <= psi ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' Hle H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].

  have Hx0a' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm a') :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm a') _ Hx0rest1.
  have Hx0rest2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
          (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P))) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm a') _ Hx0rest1.
  have Hx0b : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm b) _ Hx0rest2.
  have Hx0rest3 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b') (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P)) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm b) _ Hx0rest2.
  have Hx0b' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b') :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm b') _ Hx0rest3.
  have Hx0dom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm b') _ Hx0rest3.

  have HuniqP : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P :=
    @Par_uniq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') H.
  have Huniq0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x0 psi0 P HuniqP Hx0dom.
  have Hbindx0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x0 psi0 ((x0,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x0 x0 psi0 psi0 P eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hbody0 : Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi
      (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x0)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x0)) :=
    H9 x0 Hx0L.
  have Hcond0 : psi0 <= psi -> Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi b b' :=
    fun Hle => @Par_weaken P psi b b' (Hcond Hle) ((x0,psi0)::P)
      (fun z g Hz => @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_3 grade z x0 g psi0 P Hz)
      Huniq0.
  have Hsub := @Par_subst_cond ((x0,psi0)::P) psi
      (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x0)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x0)) Hbody0
      x0 psi0 b b' Huniq0 Hbindx0 Hlcb Hlcb' Hcond0.
  rewrite (@subst_open_self a b x0 Hlcb Hx0a) in Hsub.
  rewrite (@subst_open_self a' b' x0 Hlcb' Hx0a') in Hsub.
  have Hnotin : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm a b)) :=
    @notin_fv_open a b x0 Hx0a Hx0b.
  exact (@Par_drop_src P x0 psi0 psi
           (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b') Hsub Hnotin).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Variants with one derivation a single parallel step.          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_one_arg : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') ->
  forall (N:MultiPar P psi b b'),
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' Hm N.
  induction N as [PN psiN bS bT Hn | PN psiN bS bT bM Hn Ntail IH].
  - move=> Hself. apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A' a' bS bT Hm
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))).
  - move=> Hself.
    have Hstep : Par PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bS) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bM Hself
               (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))). }
    have Htail : MultiPar PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' bT).
    { apply IH; [exact Hm | exact Hself]. }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

(* Body is an arbitrary multi-step derivation, the argument is a
   single parallel step.  We state a generalized version over the
   body endpoints, since the intermediate body steps are only known
   to be abstractions after inversion. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_one_gen : forall P psi (X Y:tm) (M:MultiPar P psi X Y)
  psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  X = a_Abs psi0 A a -> Y = a_Abs psi0 A' a' ->
  Par P psi b b' -> Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi X Y M.
  induction M as [PM psiM X0 Y0 Hm | PM psiM X0 Y0 Ymid Hm Mtail IH].
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b b' EX EY Hn Hself.
    subst X0. subst Y0. apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PM psiM psi0 A a A' a' b b' Hm
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b' Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b' Hn))).
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b b' EX EY Hn Hself.
    subst X0. subst Y0.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PM psiM psi0 A a Ymid Hm) as
      [L [A2 [a2 [EYmid [HlcA2 Hbody]]]]].
    subst Ymid.
    have Htail : MultiPar PM psiM (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
    { exact (IH psi0 A2 a2 A' a' b b' eq_refl eq_refl Hn Hself). }
    have Hstep : Par PM psiM (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PM psiM psi0 A a A2 a2 b b Hm
               (fun _ => Hself) (proj1 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b Hself))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b Hself))). }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_one : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  forall (M:MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a')),
  Par P psi b b' ->
  Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' M Hn Hself.
  exact (@MultiPar_Abs_arg_one_gen P psi
           (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') M
           psi0 A a A' a' b b' eq_refl eq_refl Hn Hself).
Qed.

(* Transitivity of MultiPar (needed to compose the two phases). *)
(* A multi-step argument path at a fixed (self-reducible) abstraction. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_self_body : forall P psi psi0 A a b b',
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
  forall (N:MultiPar P psi b b'),
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a b b' Hself N.
  induction N as [PN psiN bS bT Hn | PN psiN bS bT bM Hn Ntail IH].
  - apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bT Hself
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))).
  - have Hstep : Par PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bS) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bM Hself
               (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))). }
    have Htail : MultiPar PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bT).
    { exact (IH Hself). }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

(* Multi-step body path with a self-reducible argument. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_self_arg : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b,
  forall (M:MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a')),
  Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b M Hself.
  exact (@MultiPar_Abs_arg_one P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b M Hself Hself).
Qed.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall P psi a b, Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  inversion H as [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
  exact (@join P psi b a b0 H2 H1).
Qed.

Lemma Joins_trans : forall P psi a b c,
  Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b c -> Joins P psi a c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b c H1 H2.
  inversion H1 as [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b0 H1a H1b]; subst.
  inversion H2 as [P1 psi1 a1' a2' b1 H2a H2b]; subst.
  destruct (@MultiPar_diamond P psi b b0 H1b b1 H2a) as [d [Hb1d Hb0d]].
  exact (@join P psi a c d (MultiPar_trans H1a Hb0d) (MultiPar_trans H2b Hb1d)).
Qed.

From Coq Require Import Lia.
From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.
From G Require Import base.
From G Require Import self.
From G Require Import self3.
From G Require Import lift0.
From G Require Import lift1.
From G Require Import lift2.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Small helpers                                                 *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma GDefEq_uniq : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  exact (@Par_uniq P psi a a (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_uniq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  exact (@CPar_uniq P psi psi0 a a (proj1 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma GDefEq_par_l : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof. move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b H)). Qed.

Lemma GDefEq_par_r : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b -> Par P psi b b.
Proof. move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj2 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b H)). Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_cpar_l : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CPar P psi psi0 a a.
Proof. move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj1 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b H)). Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_cpar_r : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CPar P psi psi0 b b.
Proof. move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj2 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b H)). Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_par_l_of_leq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle H.
  exact (@CPar_leq_inv P psi psi0 a a Hle (@CGDefEq_cpar_l P psi psi0 a b H)).
Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_par_r_of_leq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> Par P psi b b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle H.
  exact (@CPar_leq_inv P psi psi0 a b Hle (@CGDefEq_cpar_r P psi psi0 a b H)).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_start_self : forall P psi a b,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  exact (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b (@MultiPar_gdefeq P psi a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma Joins_self : forall P psi a,
  Par P psi a a -> Joins P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a H.
  exact (@join P psi a a a (MP_One H) (MP_One H)).
Qed.

Lemma Joins_inv : forall P psi a b,
  Joins P psi a b -> exists c, MultiPar P psi a c /\ MultiPar P psi b c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  inversion H as [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
  exists b0. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Main soundness: graded definable equality is a join           *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma GDefEq_Joins : forall P psi a b, GDefEq P psi a b -> Joins P psi a b.
Proof.
  apply GDefEq_mutind with
    (P := fun P psi a b _ => Joins P psi a b)
    (P0 := fun P psi psi0 a b _ => CJoins P psi psi0 a b).
  (* 1 GE_Var *)
  - move=> P psi x psi0 u Hle Hb.
    apply Joins_self. apply Par_Var; assumption.
  (* 2 GE_Type *)
  - move=> P psi s u.
    apply Joins_self. apply Par_Type. exact u.
  (* 3 GE_Sym *)
  - move=> P psi b a g IH.
    apply Joins_sym. exact IH.
  (* 4 GE_Trans *)
  - move=> P psi a b b0 g1 IH1 g2 IH2.
    exact (Joins_trans IH1 IH2).
  (* 5 GE_App *)
  - move=> P psi b0 psi0 a0 b1 a1 g1 IH1 c2 IH2.
    destruct (Joins_inv IH1) as [dF [Hb0dF Hb1dF]].
    destruct IH2 as [Hle HJarg | lca lcb nle u].
    + destruct (Joins_inv HJarg) as [dA [Ha0dA Ha1dA]].
      have Ha0self : Par P psi a0 a0 :=
        @CGDefEq_par_l_of_leq P psi psi0 a0 a1 Hle c2.
      have Ha1self : Par P psi a1 a1 :=
        @CGDefEq_par_r_of_leq P psi psi0 a0 a1 Hle c2.
      have HdFself : Par P psi dF dF := @MultiPar_end_self P psi b0 dF Hb0dF.
      have HdAself : Par P psi dA dA := @MultiPar_end_self P psi a0 dA Ha0dA.
      apply join with (b := a_App dF psi0 dA).
      * exact (@MultiPar_App_two_leq P psi psi0 b0 dF a0 dA
                 Hle Ha0self (GDefEq_uniq g1) Hb0dF HdFself Ha0dA).
      * exact (@MultiPar_App_two_leq P psi psi0 b1 dF a1 dA
                 Hle Ha1self (GDefEq_uniq g1) Hb1dF HdFself Ha1dA).
    + have HdFself : Par P psi dF dF := @MultiPar_end_self P psi b0 dF Hb0dF.

Lemma lc_tm_bodies_all : forall (B:tm) (L:MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.t),
  (forall x, ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L -> lc_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) ->
  forall x, lc_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  move=> B L H x.
  destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh L) as [x0 Hx0].
  exact (@lc_tm_open_var_all B x0 x (H x0 Hx0)).
Qed.

Lemma Typing_lc : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A H. induction H; simpl; auto.
  - apply lc_a_Type.
  - apply lc_a_Var_f.
  - apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact IHTyping.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all B L H1).
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact (lc_tm_pi_dom IHTyping).
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all b L H0).
  - apply lc_a_App; auto.
  - apply lc_a_Refl.
  - apply lc_a_CEq; auto.
  - apply lc_a_Transp; auto.
  - apply lc_a_T; auto.
  - apply lc_a_Box; auto.
  - apply lc_a_Unbox; auto.
  - apply lc_a_SSigma.
    + exact IHTyping.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all B L H1).
  - apply lc_a_SPair; auto.
  - apply lc_a_Proj1; auto.
  - apply lc_a_Proj2; auto.
  - apply lc_a_TyUnit.
  - apply lc_a_TmUnit.
  - apply lc_a_Bool.
  - apply lc_a_True.
  - apply lc_a_False.
  - apply lc_a_If; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_Ctx : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A -> Ctx W.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A H. induction H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Ctx_uniq : forall W, Ctx W -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq W.
Proof.
  move=> W H. induction H.
  - apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_nil.
  - apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_par_self : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A ->
  forall psi', psi <= psi' -> Par (labels W) psi' a a.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A H. induction H; intros psi' Hle; simpl in *.
  - (* T_Type *) apply Par_Type. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_Var *) apply (@Par_Var (labels W) psi' x psi0).
    + apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
    + exact (binds_labels H1).
  - (* T_Pi *) eapply Par_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W))).
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W)) Hx.
      exact (H1 x HxL psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Abs *) eapply Par_Abs with (L := L).
    + exact (lc_tm_pi_dom (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H1)).
    + exact (lc_tm_pi_dom (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H1)).
    + move=> x Hx. exact (H0 x Hx psi' Hle).
  - (* T_App *) eapply Par_App.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + case E: (psi0 <= psi').
      * have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
        apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle0)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CPar_Nleq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H0).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H0).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Conv *) exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Refl *) apply Par_Refl. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_CEq *) eapply Par_CEq.
    + exact (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H1).
    + exact (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H1).
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H3 (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle))).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H3 (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle))).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle).
  - (* T_Transp *) eapply Par_Transp.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_T *) apply Par_T. exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Box *) eapply Par_Box.
    case E: (psi0 <= psi').
    + have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
      apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle0)].
    + have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
      apply CPar_Nleq.
      * exact (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H).
      * exact (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H).
      * exact Hnle.
      * apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Unbox *) apply Par_Unbox.
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
  - (* T_SSigma *) eapply Par_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W))).
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W)) Hx.
      exact (H1 x HxL psi' Hle).
  - (* T_SPair *) eapply Par_SPair.
    + case E: (psi0 <= psi').
      * have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
        apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle0)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CPar_Nleq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H0).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W _ _ _ H0).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
    + exact (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Proj1 *) apply Par_Proj1Cong.
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
  - (* T_Proj2 *) apply Par_Proj2Cong. exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_TyUnit *) apply Par_TyUnit. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_TmUnit *) apply Par_TmUnit. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Bool *) apply Par_Bool. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_True *) apply Par_True. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_False *) apply Par_False. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_If *) eapply Par_If.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
Qed.

Lemma Typing_App_inv : forall W psi a psi0 b A,
  Typing W psi (a_App a psi0 b) A ->
  exists A0 B, Typing W psi a (a_Pi psi0 A0 B) /\ Typing W psi0 b A0.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a psi0 b A H.
  remember (a_App a psi0 b) as t eqn:E.
  revert a psi0 b E.
  induction H; intros aa pp bb E; try discriminate E.
  - inversion E; subst. eauto.
  - destruct (IHTyping1 aa pp bb E) as [A0 [B0 [h1 h2]]]. exists A0, B0. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_Transp_inv : forall W psi a b A,
  Typing W psi (a_Transp a b) A ->
  exists psi0 a0 a1 psi1 A0 B,
    Typing W psi a (a_CEq psi0 a0 a1 psi1 A0) /\ Typing W psi b (open_tm_wrt_tm B a0).
Proof.
  move=> W psi a b A H.
  remember (a_Transp a b) as t eqn:E.
  revert a b E.
  induction H; intros aa bb E; try discriminate E.
  - destruct (IHTyping1 aa bb E) as [p0 [x0 [x1 [p1 [A0 [B0 [h1 h2]]]]]]].
    exists p0, x0, x1, p1, A0, B0. split; assumption.
  - inversion E; subst; repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_Unbox_inv : forall W psi psi0 a A,
  Typing W psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) A ->
  exists A0, psi0 <= psi /\ Typing W psi a (a_T psi0 A0).
Proof.
  move=> W psi psi0 a A H.
  remember (a_Unbox psi0 a) as t eqn:E.
  revert psi0 a E.
  induction H; intros p0 aa E; try discriminate E.
  - destruct (IHTyping1 p0 aa E) as [A0 [h1 h2]]. exists A0. split; assumption.
  - inversion E; subst; repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_Box_inv : forall W psi psi0 a A,
  Typing W psi (a_Box psi0 a) A ->
  exists psi1 A0 s, Typing W psi0 a A0 /\ Typing W psi1 (a_T psi0 A0) (a_Type s).
Proof.
  move=> W psi psi0 a A H.
  remember (a_Box psi0 a) as t eqn:E.
  revert psi0 a E.
  induction H; intros p0 aa E; try discriminate E.
  - destruct (IHTyping1 p0 aa E) as [p1 [A0 [s0 [h1 h2]]]]. exists p1, A0, s0. split; assumption.
  - inversion E; subst; repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_Proj1_inv : forall W psi psi0 a A,
  Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A ->
  exists A0 B, Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B) /\ psi0 <= psi.
Proof.
  move=> W psi psi0 a A H.
  remember (a_Proj1 psi0 a) as t eqn:E.
  revert psi0 a E.
  induction H; intros p0 aa E; try discriminate E.
  - destruct (IHTyping1 p0 aa E) as [A0 [B0 [h1 h2]]]. exists A0, B0. split; assumption.
  - inversion E; subst; repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_Proj2_inv : forall W psi psi0 a A,
  Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a) A ->
  exists A0 B, Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A0 B) /\ Typing W psi0 (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A0.
Proof.
  move=> W psi psi0 a A H.
  remember (a_Proj2 psi0 a) as t eqn:E.
  revert psi0 a E.
  induction H; intros p0 aa E; try discriminate E.
  - destruct (IHTyping1 p0 aa E) as [A0 [B0 [h1 h2]]]. exists A0, B0. split; assumption.
  - inversion E; subst; repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_If_inv : forall W psi a b0 b1 A,
  Typing W psi (a_If a b0 b1) A ->
  exists A0, Typing W psi a a_Bool /\ Typing W psi b0 A0 /\ Typing W psi b1 A0.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a b0 b1 A H.
  remember (a_If a b0 b1) as t eqn:E.
  revert a b0 b1 E.
  induction H; intros aa bb0 bb1 E; try discriminate E.
  - destruct (IHTyping1 aa bb0 bb1 E) as [A0 [h1 [h2 h3]]]. exists A0. split; [exact h1|split; assumption].
  - inversion E; subst; repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Red_par : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A ->
  forall b, Red a b -> Par (labels W) psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A HT b HR. revert W psi A HT.
  induction HR; intros WW pp AA TT.
  - (* R_App *) destruct (@Typing_App_inv WW pp a0 psi0 b AA TT) as [A0 [B [hfun harg]]].
    eapply Par_App.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp (a_Pi psi0 A0 B) hfun).
    + case E: (psi0 <= pp).
      * have Hle : psi0 <= pp by rewrite E; done.
        apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle | exact (@Typing_par_self WW psi0 b A0 harg pp Hle)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= pp) by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CPar_Nleq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc WW psi0 b A0 harg).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc WW psi0 b A0 harg).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx WW _ _ _ TT).
  - (* R_AppAbs *) destruct (@Typing_App_inv WW pp (a_Abs psi0 A a) psi0 b AA TT) as [A2 [B [hfun harg]]].
    eapply Par_AppBeta.
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B) hfun pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + case E: (psi0 <= pp).
      * have Hle : psi0 <= pp by rewrite E; done.
        apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle | exact (@Typing_par_self WW psi0 b A2 harg pp Hle)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= pp) by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CPar_Nleq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc WW psi0 b A2 harg).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc WW psi0 b A2 harg).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx WW _ _ _ TT).
  - (* R_Transp *) destruct (@Typing_Transp_inv WW pp a b AA TT) as [p0 [x0 [x1 [p1 [A0 [B [h_a h_b]]]]]]].
    eapply Par_Transp.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp (a_CEq p0 x0 x1 p1 A0) h_a).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b (open_tm_wrt_tm B x0) h_b pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_TranspRefl *) destruct (@Typing_Transp_inv WW pp a_Refl a AA TT) as [p0 [x0 [x1 [p1 [A0 [B [h_a h_b]]]]]]].
    eapply Par_TranspRefl.
    + apply Par_Refl. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx WW _ _ _ TT).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp a (open_tm_wrt_tm B x0) h_b pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_Unbox *) destruct (@Typing_Unbox_inv WW pp psi0 a AA TT) as [A0 [Hle h_a]].
    eapply Par_Unbox.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp (a_T psi0 A0) h_a).
    + exact Hle.
  - (* R_UnboxBox *) destruct (@Typing_Unbox_inv WW pp psi0 (a_Box psi0 a) AA TT) as [A0 [Hle h_box]].
    eapply Par_UnboxBox.
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp (a_Box psi0 a) (a_T psi0 A0) h_box pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact Hle.
  - (* R_Proj1Cong *) destruct (@Typing_Proj1_inv WW pp psi a AA TT) as [A0 [B [h_a Hle]]].
    eapply Par_Proj1Cong.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp (a_SSigma psi A0 B) h_a).
    + exact Hle.
  - (* R_Proj2Cong *) destruct (@Typing_Proj2_inv WW pp psi a AA TT) as [A0 [B [h_a h_proj]]].
    eapply Par_Proj2Cong.
    exact (IHHR WW pp (a_SSigma psi A0 B) h_a).
  - (* R_Proj1Beta *) destruct (@Typing_Proj1_inv WW pp psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2) AA TT) as [A0 [B [h_pair Hle]]].

    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp (a_SPair a1 psi a2) (a_SSigma psi A0 B) h_pair pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact Hle.
  - (* R_Proj2Beta *) destruct (@Typing_Proj2_inv WW pp psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2) AA TT) as [A0 [B [h_pair h_proj]]].
    eapply Par_Proj2Beta.
    exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp (a_SPair a1 psi a2) (a_SSigma psi A0 B) h_pair pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_If *) destruct (@Typing_If_inv WW pp a b0 b1 AA TT) as [A0 [hg [hb0 hb1]]].
    eapply Par_If.
    + exact (IHHR WW pp a_Bool hg).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b0 A0 hb0 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b1 A0 hb1 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_IfTrue *) destruct (@Typing_If_inv WW pp a_True b0 b1 AA TT) as [A0 [hg [hb0 hb1]]].
    eapply Par_IfTrue.
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp a_True a_Bool hg pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b0 A0 hb0 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b1 A0 hb1 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
  - (* R_IfFalse *) destruct (@Typing_If_inv WW pp a_False b0 b1 AA TT) as [A0 [hg [hb0 hb1]]].
    eapply Par_IfFalse.
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp a_False a_Bool hg pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b0 A0 hb0 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
    + exact (@Typing_par_self WW pp b1 A0 hb1 pp (Order.POrderTheory.le_refl pp)).
Qed.

Lemma Typing_gdefeq_self : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A ->
  forall psi', psi <= psi' -> GDefEq (labels W) psi' a a.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A H. induction H; intros psi' Hle; simpl in *.
  - (* T_Type *) apply GE_Type. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_Var *) apply (@GE_Var (labels W) psi' x psi0).
    + apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
    + exact (binds_labels H1).
  - (* T_Pi *) eapply GE_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W))).
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W)) Hx.
      exact (H1 x HxL psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Abs *) eapply GE_Abs with (L := L).
    + exact (lc_tm_pi_dom (Typing_lc H1)).
    + exact (lc_tm_pi_dom (Typing_lc H1)).
    + move=> x Hx. exact (H0 x Hx psi' Hle).
  - (* T_App *) eapply GE_App.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + case E: (psi0 <= psi').
      * have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
        apply CGE_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle0)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CGE_NLeq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Conv *) exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Refl *) apply GE_Refl. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_CEq *) eapply GE_CEq.
    + exact (Typing_lc H1).
    + exact (Typing_lc H1).
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H3 (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle))).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H3 (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle))).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle).
  - (* T_Transp *) eapply GE_Transp.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_T *) apply GE_T. exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Box *) eapply GE_Box.
    case E: (psi0 <= psi').
    + have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
      apply CGE_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle0)].
    + have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
      apply CGE_NLeq.
      * exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H).
      * exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H).
      * exact Hnle.
      * apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Unbox *) apply GE_Unbox.
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
  - (* T_SSigma *) eapply GE_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W))).
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (labels W)) Hx.
      exact (H1 x HxL psi' Hle).
  - (* T_SPair *) eapply GE_SPair.
    + case E: (psi0 <= psi').
      * have Hle0 : psi0 <= psi' by rewrite E; done.
        apply CGE_Leq; [exact Hle0 | exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle0)].
      * have Hnle : ~ (psi0 <= psi') by intro Hb; rewrite E in Hb; done.
        apply CGE_NLeq.
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact (@Typing_lc W psi0 a A H0).
        -- exact Hnle.
        -- apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
    + exact (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_Proj1 *) apply GE_Proj1Cong.
    + exact (IHTyping psi' Hle).
    + exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
  - (* T_Proj2 *) apply GE_Proj2Cong. exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
  - (* T_TyUnit *) apply GE_TyUnit. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_TmUnit *) apply GE_TmUnit. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_Bool *) apply GE_Bool. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact H.
  - (* T_True *) apply GE_True. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_False *) apply GE_False. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact (@Typing_Ctx W _ _ _ H).
  - (* T_If *) eapply GE_If.
    + exact (IHTyping1 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping2 psi' Hle).
    + exact (IHTyping3 psi' Hle).
Qed.

Scheme GDefEq_mutind := Induction for GDefEq Sort Prop
  with CGDefEq_mutind := Induction for CGDefEq Sort Prop.
Lemma GDefEq_lc : forall P psi a b, GDefEq P psi a b -> lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b.
Proof.
  apply (@GDefEq_mutind (fun P psi a b _ => lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b) (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b)).
  all: try (intros; split; dest_conjs; try lc_head; eauto).
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact l.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all b0 L (fun x Hx => proj1 (H x Hx))).
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + exact l0.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all b1 L (fun x Hx => proj2 (H x Hx))).
  - apply lc_a_Pi.
    + exact H.
    + exact (@lc_tm_bodies_all B0 L (fun x Hx => proj1 (H0 x Hx))).
  - apply lc_a_Pi.

Lemma GDefEq_subst_tail : forall P psi a b, GDefEq P psi a b ->
  forall Q x gx Ax u,
    P = Q ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, gx) ->
    Typing nil gx u Ax ->
    GDefEq Q psi (subst_tm u x a) (subst_tm u x b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  apply (@GDefEq_mutind
    (fun P psi a b _ => forall Q x gx Ax u,
      P = Q ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, gx) ->
      Typing nil gx u Ax ->
      GDefEq Q psi (subst_tm u x a) (subst_tm u x b))
    (fun P psi psi0 a b _ => forall Q x gx Ax u,
      P = Q ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, gx) ->
      Typing nil gx u Ax ->
      CGDefEq Q psi psi0 (subst_tm u x a) (subst_tm u x b))).
  all: try (intros; simpl in *;
    match goal with
    | |- GDefEq _ _ a_TyUnit _ => eapply GE_TyUnit; eauto
    | |- GDefEq _ _ a_TmUnit _ => eapply GE_TmUnit; eauto
    | |- GDefEq _ _ a_Bool _ => eapply GE_Bool; eauto
    | |- GDefEq _ _ a_True _ => eapply GE_True; eauto
    | |- GDefEq _ _ a_False _ => eapply GE_False; eauto
    | |- GDefEq _ _ (a_Type _) _ => eapply GE_Type; eauto
    | |- GDefEq _ _ a_Refl _ => eapply GE_Refl; eauto
    | |- GDefEq _ _ _ _ => econstructor; eauto
    | |- CGDefEq _ _ _ _ _ => idtac
    end).
  - (* Var *)
    apply GE_Sym. simpl. destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x x0) as [E|Hne].
    + subst x0.
      have Hself : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x gx P0.
      { rewrite H0. apply (@binds_one_self Q x gx). }
      have Hg : psi1 = gx := @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_unique grade x psi1 gx P0 b0 Hself u.
      subst psi1.
      have Huq : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq Q.
      { rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u. }
      have Hgu : GDefEq nil psi0 u0 u0 := @Typing_gdefeq_self nil gx u0 Ax H1 psi0 i.
      refine (@GDefEq_weaken nil psi0 u0 u0 Hgu Q _ Huq).
      move=> y h Hy. unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds in Hy. destruct Hy.
    + have Huy : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq Q.
      { rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u. }
      have Hb : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x psi1 Q.
      { rewrite H0 in b0. eapply binds_app_one_neq; [exact b0 | exact Hne]. }
      eapply GE_Var; [exact Huy | exact i | exact Hb].
  - (* Type *)
    have Huq : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq Q.
    { rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u. }
    exact Huq.
  - (* Abs *)
    apply GE_Sym. have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H2.
    eapply GE_Abs with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)).
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst A0 u x l Hulc).
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst A1 u x l0 Hulc).
    + move=> z Hz.
      have HzL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hzx : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hxz : x <> z.
      { move=> Exz. apply Hzx. rewrite -Exz. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2 x x eq_refl). }
      have E' : Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, psi1) ++ P0 = (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, psi1) ++ Q) ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, gx).
      { rewrite H1. reflexivity. }
      have Hbz := @H0 z HzL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, psi1) ++ Q) x gx Ax u E' H2.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var b0 u x z Hulc Hxz).
      rewrite (@subst_open_var b1 u x z Hulc Hxz).
      exact Hbz.
  - (* Pi *)
    apply GE_Sym. eapply GE_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)).
    + exact (@H0 Q x gx Ax u H2 H3).
    + move=> z Hz.
      have HzL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hzx : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hxz : x <> z.
      { move=> Exz. apply Hzx. rewrite -Exz. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2 x x eq_refl). }
      have E' : Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, psi1) ++ P0 = (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, psi1) ++ Q) ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, gx).
      { rewrite H2. reflexivity. }
      have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H3.
      have Hbz := @H1 z HzL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, psi1) ++ Q) x gx Ax u E' H3.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B0 u x z Hulc Hxz).
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B1 u x z Hulc Hxz).
      exact Hbz.
  - (* AppAbs *)
    apply GE_Sym. have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H3.
    simpl. rewrite (@subst_open_rec a1 0 u x b1 Hulc).
    eapply GE_AppAbs.
    + exact (@H0 Q x gx Ax u H2 H3).
    + exact (@H1 Q x gx Ax u H2 H3).
  - (* Refl *)
    have Huq : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq Q.
    { rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u. }
    exact Huq.
  - (* CEq *)
    apply GE_Sym. have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H3.
    simpl. eapply GE_CEq.
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst A0 u x l Hulc).
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst A1 u x l0 Hulc).
    + exact (@H0 Q x gx Ax u H2 H3).
    + exact (@H1 Q x gx Ax u H2 H3).
    + exact i.
  - (* SSigma *)
    apply GE_Sym. eapply GE_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)).
    + exact (@H0 Q x gx Ax u H2 H3).
    + move=> z Hz.
      have HzL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hzx : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hxz : x <> z.
      { move=> Exz. apply Hzx. rewrite -Exz. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2 x x eq_refl). }
      have E' : Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, psi1) ++ P0 = (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, psi1) ++ Q) ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, gx).
      { rewrite H2. reflexivity. }
      have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H3.
      have Hbz := @H1 z HzL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, psi1) ++ Q) x gx Ax u E' H3.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B0 u x z Hulc Hxz).
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B1 u x z Hulc Hxz).
      exact Hbz.
  - rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u.
  - rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u.
  - rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u.
  - rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u.
  - rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u.
  - (* If *)
    apply GE_Sym. eapply GE_If.
    + exact (@H0 Q x gx Ax u H3 H4).
    + exact (@H1 Q x gx Ax u H3 H4).
    + exact (@H2 Q x gx Ax u H3 H4).
  - (* IfTrue *)
    apply GE_Sym. eapply GE_IfTrue.
    + exact (@H0 Q x gx Ax u H3 H4).
    + exact (@H1 Q x gx Ax u H3 H4).
    + exact (@H2 Q x gx Ax u H3 H4).
  - (* IfFalse *)
    apply GE_Sym. eapply GE_IfFalse.
    + exact (@H0 Q x gx Ax u H3 H4).
    + exact (@H1 Q x gx Ax u H3 H4).
    + exact (@H2 Q x gx Ax u H3 H4).
  - (* CGE_Leq *)
    eapply CGE_Leq; [exact i | exact (@H0 Q x gx Ax u H1 H2)].
  - (* CGE_NLeq *)
    have Huq : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq Q.
    { rewrite H0 in u. apply uniq_app_one_l in u. exact u. }
    have Hulc : lc_tm u0 := Typing_lc H1.
    eapply CGE_NLeq.
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst a0 u0 x l Hulc).
    + exact (@lc_tm_subst b0 u0 x l0 Hulc).
    + exact n.
    + exact Huq.
Qed.

Lemma binds_one_self_gen : forall (A:Type) (P:list (MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom * A)) x a,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x a (P ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, a)).
Proof.
  move=> A P x a. apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_app_iff. right.
  apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_one_iff A x x a a). split; done.
Qed.
Lemma uniq_app_one_l_gen : forall (A:Type) (P:list (MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom*A)) x a,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq (P ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,a)) ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> A P x a H. exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_app_1 A P (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,a)) H).
Qed.
Lemma binds_app_one_neq_gen : forall (A:Type) (P:list (MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom*A)) x a y b,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y b (P ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,a)) -> y <> x ->
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y b P.
Proof.
  move=> A P x a y b H Hne.
  apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H]; auto.
  apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_one_iff A y x b a) in H. destruct H as [E1 E2].
  exfalso. apply Hne. exact E1.
Qed.
Lemma subst_ctx_cons : forall u x (y:MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom) g B (W:context),
  subst_ctx u x ((y, (g,B)) :: W) =
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (y, (g, subst_tm u x B)) ++ subst_ctx u x W.
Proof.
  move=> u x y g B W. unfold subst_ctx.
  rewrite Metatheory.EnvImpl.map_cons. done.
Qed.
Lemma labels_subst_ctx : forall u x (W:context), labels (subst_ctx u x W) = labels W.
Proof.
  move=> u x W. induction W as [|[y [g B]] W IH].
  - unfold subst_ctx, labels. simpl. done.
  - rewrite subst_ctx_cons. rewrite labels_app. simpl. rewrite IH. done.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_grade_mono : forall W psi psi', psi <= psi' ->
  forall a A, Typing W psi a A -> Typing W psi' a A.
Proof.
  move=> W psi psi' Hle a A H.
  induction H.
  all: try (match goal with
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Type _) _ => eapply T_Type; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_App _ _ _) _ => eapply T_App; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Abs _ _ _) _ => eapply T_Abs; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Pi _ _ _) _ => eapply T_Pi; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_SSigma _ _ _) _ => eapply T_SSigma; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Transp _ _) _ => eapply T_Transp; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_CEq _ _ _ _ _) _ => eapply T_CEq; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Refl _ => eapply T_Refl; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_T _ _) _ => eapply T_T; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Box _ _) _ => eapply T_Box; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Unbox _ _) _ => eapply T_Unbox; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_SPair _ _ _) _ => eapply T_SPair; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj1 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj1; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj2 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj2; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TyUnit _ => eapply T_TyUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TmUnit _ => eapply T_TmUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Bool _ => eapply T_Bool; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_True _ => eapply T_True; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_False _ => eapply T_False; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_If _ _ _) _ => eapply T_If; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ _ _ => idtac
    end).
  - eapply T_Var; [exact H | exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle) | exact H1].
  - eapply T_Conv; [exact (IHTyping1 Hle) | exact H0 | exact H1].
  - exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H4 Hle).
  - exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
  - exact (Order.POrderTheory.le_trans H0 Hle).
Qed.

Lemma DefEq_subst_tail : forall P a b, DefEq P a b ->
  forall Q x gx Ax u,
    P = Q ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, gx) ->
    Typing nil gx u Ax ->
    DefEq Q (subst_tm u x a) (subst_tm u x b).
Proof.
  move=> P a b H.
  induction H.
  - move=> Q x gx Ax u E Hu. eapply E_One.
    exact (@GDefEq_subst_tail P psi a b H Q x gx Ax u E Hu).
  - move=> Q x gx Ax u E Hu. eapply E_Trans.
    + exact (IHDefEq1 Q x gx Ax u E Hu).
    + exact (IHDefEq2 Q x gx Ax u E Hu).
Qed.

Scheme Typing_Ctx_mutind2 := Induction for Typing Sort Prop
  with Ctx_mutind3 := Induction for Ctx Sort Prop.
Lemma Typing_subst_tail : forall C psi a B, Typing C psi a B ->
  forall W x gx A u,
    C = W ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (gx,A)) ->
    Typing nil gx u A -> ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm A) ->
    Typing (subst_ctx u x W) psi (subst_tm u x a) (subst_tm u x B).
Proof.
  move=> C psi a B H.
  induction H using Typing_Ctx_mutind2
    with (P0 := fun C _ => forall W x gx A u,
      C = W ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,(gx,A)) ->
      Typing nil gx u A -> ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm A) ->
      Ctx (subst_ctx u x W)).
  all: try (intros; simpl;
    match goal with
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Type _) _ => eapply T_Type; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_App _ _ _) _ => eapply T_App; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Refl _ => eapply T_Refl; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_CEq _ _ _ _ _) _ => eapply T_CEq; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_T _ _) _ => eapply T_T; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Box _ _) _ => eapply T_Box; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Unbox _ _) _ => eapply T_Unbox; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_SPair _ _ _) _ => eapply T_SPair; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj1 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj1; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj2 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj2; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TyUnit _ => eapply T_TyUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TmUnit _ => eapply T_TmUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Bool _ => eapply T_Bool; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_True _ => eapply T_True; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_False _ => eapply T_False; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_If _ _ _) _ => eapply T_If; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ _ _ => idtac
    | |- Ctx _ => idtac
    end).
  all: try solve [ eapply T_Var; eauto ].
  - (* Var *)
    destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x x0) as [Ex|Hne].
    + subst x0. simpl.
      have HuniqW : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq W := Ctx_uniq c.
      have Hself : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (gx, A0) W.
      { rewrite H. apply (@binds_one_self_gen (grade*tm) W0 x (gx,A0)). }
      have Hbeq := @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_unique (grade*tm) x (psi0,A) (gx,A0) W b Hself HuniqW.
      injection Hbeq as Ep EA. subst psi0 A. simpl in *.
      have HCt := IHTyping W0 x gx A0 u H H0 H1.
      have Hincl : forall (y:MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom) (g:grade) (B:tm),
        Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y (g,B) nil -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y (g,B) (subst_ctx u x W0).
      { move=> y g B Hy. unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds in Hy. destruct Hy. }
      have Huw : Typing (subst_ctx u x W0) gx u A0 := Typing_weaken_ctx H0 HCt Hincl.
      have Hmono := Typing_grade_mono i Huw.
      rewrite (@subst_tm_notin A0 u x H1). exact Hmono.
    + have HCt := IHTyping W0 x0 gx A0 u H H0 H1.
      have Hb : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (psi0, A) W0.
      { rewrite H in b. eapply (@binds_app_one_neq_gen (grade*tm) W0 x0 (gx,A0) x (psi0,A)); [exact b | exact Hne]. }
      have HbT : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (psi0, subst_tm u x0 A) (subst_ctx u x0 W0).
      { exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_map_2 (grade*tm) (grade*tm) (fun '(g,B) => (g, subst_tm u x0 B)) x (psi0,A) W0 Hb). }
      eapply T_Var; [exact HCt | exact i | exact HbT].
  - (* Pi *)
    eapply T_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)).
    + exact (IHTyping W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3).
    + move=> z Hz.
      have HzL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hzx : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hxz : x <> z.
      { move=> Exz. apply Hzx. rewrite -Exz. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2 x x eq_refl). }
      have E' : Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W =
        (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W0) ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (gx,A0)).
      { rewrite H1. reflexivity. }
      have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H2.
      have Hbz := H0 z HzL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W0) x gx A0 u E' H2 H3.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B u x z Hulc Hxz).
      exact Hbz.
    + exact r.
  - (* Abs *)
    eapply T_Abs with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)).
    + move=> z Hz.
      have HzL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hzx : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hxz : x <> z.
      { move=> Exz. apply Hzx. rewrite -Exz. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2 x x eq_refl). }
      have E' : Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W =
        (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W0) ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (gx,A0)).
      { rewrite H1. reflexivity. }
      have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H2.
      have Hbz := H z HzL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W0) x gx A0 u E' H2 H3.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var b u x z Hulc Hxz).
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B u x z Hulc Hxz).
      exact Hbz.
    + exact (IHTyping W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3).
  - (* App *)
    have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H2.
    rewrite (@subst_open_rec B 0 u x a Hulc).
    eapply T_App.
    + exact (IHTyping1 W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3).
    + exact (IHTyping2 W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3).
  - (* Conv *)
    have El : labels W = labels W0 ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, gx).
    { rewrite H1. rewrite labels_app. simpl. done. }
    have Hdsub := @DefEq_subst_tail (labels W) A B d (labels W0) x gx A0 u El H2.
    eapply T_Conv.
    + exact (IHTyping1 W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3).
    + exact (IHTyping2 W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3).
    + rewrite labels_subst_ctx. exact Hdsub.
  - (* Transp *)
    have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H4.
    have H2' := IHTyping2 W0 x gx A0 u H3 H4 H5.
    rewrite (@subst_open_rec B 0 u x a0 Hulc) in H2'.
    rewrite (@subst_open_rec B 0 u x a1 Hulc).
    eapply T_Transp with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)).
    + move=> z Hz.
      have HzL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hzx : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hxz : x <> z.
      { move=> Exz. apply Hzx. rewrite -Exz. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2 x x eq_refl). }
      have E' : Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi1,A)) ++ W =
        (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi1,A)) ++ W0) ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (gx,A0)).
      { rewrite H3. reflexivity. }
      have Hbz := H z HzL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi1,A)) ++ W0) x gx A0 u E' H4 H5.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B u x z Hulc Hxz).
      exact Hbz.
    + exact (IHTyping1 W0 x gx A0 u H3 H4 H5).
    + exact H2'.
    + exact (IHTyping3 W0 x gx A0 u H3 H4 H5).
  - (* SSigma *)
    eapply T_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)).
    + exact (IHTyping W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3).
    + move=> z Hz.
      have HzL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hzx : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hxz : x <> z.
      { move=> Exz. apply Hzx. rewrite -Exz. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2 x x eq_refl). }
      have E' : Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W =
        (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W0) ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (gx,A0)).
      { rewrite H1. reflexivity. }
      have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H2.
      have Hbz := H0 z HzL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W0) x gx A0 u E' H2 H3.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B u x z Hulc Hxz).
      exact Hbz.
    + exact r.
  - (* SPair premise *)
    have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H3.
    have Ht := IHTyping3 W0 x gx A0 u H2 H3 H4.
    rewrite (@subst_open_rec B 0 u x a Hulc) in Ht.
    exact Ht.
  - (* Proj2 *)
    have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H2.
    have Ht2 := IHTyping2 W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3.
    rewrite (@subst_open_rec B 0 u x (a_Proj1 psi0 a) Hulc).
    eapply T_Proj2.
    + exact (IHTyping1 W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3).
    + exact Ht2.
  - (* Ctx empty *)
    destruct W as [|[y p] Wt]; simpl in H; discriminate H.
  - (* Ctx cons *)
    destruct W0 as [|[y p] Wt].
    + simpl in H0. inversion H0. simpl. apply Ctx_Empty.
    + destruct p as [h Ay]. simpl in H0. inversion H0; subst.
      have HCtail : Ctx (subst_ctx u x0 Wt) := IHTyping Wt x0 gx A0 u eq_refl H1 H2.
      have Hdom : Typing (subst_ctx u x0 Wt) psi (subst_tm u x0 Ay) (a_Type s) := IHTyping0 Wt x0 gx A0 u eq_refl H1 H2.
      have Hfresh : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (subst_ctx u x0 Wt)).
      { intro Hin. apply Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_In_inv in Hin. destruct Hin as [aa Ha].
        move/(@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_map_3 (grade*tm) (grade*tm) (fun '(g,B) => (g, subst_tm u x0 B)) y aa Wt) in Ha.
        destruct Ha as [[g B] [Ef Hb]].
        have HbW : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y (g,B) (Wt ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x0, (gx,A0))).
        { eapply binds_app_l. exact Hb. }
        apply n. exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_In (grade*tm) y (g,B) (Wt ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x0, (gx,A0))) HbW). }
      rewrite subst_ctx_cons.
      eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HCtail | exact Hdom | exact Hfresh].
Qed.



Lemma Typing_subst_beta : forall x g A psi body B u,
  Typing (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (g,A))) psi body B ->
  Typing nil g u A ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm A) ->
  Typing nil psi (subst_tm u x body) (subst_tm u x B).
Proof.
  move=> x g A psi body B u H Hu HxA.
  exact (@Typing_subst_tail (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,(g,A))) psi body B H nil x g A u eq_refl Hu HxA).
Qed.

Lemma DefEq_sym : forall P a b, DefEq P a b -> DefEq P b a.
Proof.
  move=> P a b H. induction H.
  - eapply E_One. apply GE_Sym. exact H.
  - eapply E_Trans; [exact IHDefEq2 | exact IHDefEq1].
Qed.

Lemma DefEq_trans : forall P a b c, DefEq P a b -> DefEq P b c -> DefEq P a c.
Proof.
  move=> P a b c H1 H2. eapply E_Trans; [exact H1 | exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma Typing_App_inv_strong : forall W psi a psi0 b A,
  Typing W psi (a_App a psi0 b) A ->
  exists A0 B, Typing W psi a (a_Pi psi0 A0 B) /\
              Typing W psi0 b A0 /\
              (A = open_tm_wrt_tm B b \/ DefEq (labels W) A (open_tm_wrt_tm B b)).
Proof.
  move=> W psi a psi0 b A H.
  remember (a_App a psi0 b) as t eqn:E.
  revert a psi0 b E.
  induction H; intros aa pp bb E; try discriminate E.
  - (* T_App *) inversion E; subst. eauto 8.
  - (* T_Conv *)
    destruct (IHTyping1 aa pp bb E) as [A0 [B0 [h1 [h2 [EQ|DEQ]]]]].
    + exists A0, B0. split; [exact h1 | split; [exact h2 |]].
      right. subst. eapply DefEq_sym. exact H1.
    + exists A0, B0. split; [exact h1 | split; [exact h2 |]].
      right. eapply DefEq_trans; [eapply DefEq_sym; exact H1 | exact DEQ].
Qed.

Lemma Typing_Abs_inv_canon : forall W psi psi0 A body T,
  Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A body) T ->
  exists L B psi1 s,
    Typing W psi1 (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s) /\
    (forall x, ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L ->
       Typing (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W) psi
         (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) /\
    (T = a_Pi psi0 A B \/ DefEq (labels W) T (a_Pi psi0 A B)).
Proof.
  move=> W psi psi0 A body T H.
  remember (a_Abs psi0 A body) as t eqn:E.
  revert A body E.
  induction H; intros AA bb E; try discriminate E.
  - (* T_Abs *) inversion E; subst. eauto 10.
  - (* T_Conv *)
    destruct (IHTyping1 AA bb E) as [L [B0 [psi2 [s0 [hpi [hbody [EQ|DEQ]]]]]]].
    + exists L, B0, psi2, s0. split; [exact hpi | split; [exact hbody |]].
      right. subst. eapply DefEq_sym. exact H1.
    + exists L, B0, psi2, s0. split; [exact hpi | split; [exact hbody |]].
      right. eapply DefEq_trans; [eapply DefEq_sym; exact H1 | exact DEQ].
Qed.

Lemma GDefEq_uniq : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  exact (@Par_uniq P psi a a (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_uniq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  exact (@CPar_uniq P psi psi0 a a (proj1 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma GDefEq_par_l : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof. move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b H)). Qed.

Lemma GDefEq_par_r : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b -> Par P psi b b.
Proof. move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj2 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b H)). Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_cpar_l : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CPar P psi psi0 a a.
Proof. move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj1 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b H)). Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_cpar_r : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CPar P psi psi0 b b.
Proof. move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj2 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b H)). Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_par_l_of_leq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle H.
  exact (@CPar_leq_inv P psi psi0 a a Hle (@CGDefEq_cpar_l P psi psi0 a b H)).
Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_par_r_of_leq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> Par P psi b b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle H.
  exact (@CPar_leq_inv P psi psi0 b b Hle (@CGDefEq_cpar_r P psi psi0 a b H)).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_start_self : forall P psi a b,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  exact (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b (@MultiPar_gdefeq P psi a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma Joins_self : forall P psi a,
  Par P psi a a -> Joins P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a H.
  exact (@join P psi a a a (@MP_One P psi a a H) (@MP_One P psi a a H)).
Qed.

Lemma MP_One' : forall P psi a b,
  Par P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof. move=> P psi a b H. exact (@MP_One P psi a b H). Qed.

Lemma Joins_inv : forall P psi a b,
  Joins P psi a b -> exists c, MultiPar P psi a c /\ MultiPar P psi b c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  inversion H as [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
  exists b0. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma CJoins_inv : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CJoins P psi psi0 a b ->
  ((psi0 <= psi) /\ Joins P psi a b) \/
  (lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b /\ ~ psi0 <= psi /\ Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  inversion H as [P0 psiN psiN0 a0 b0 Hle HJ | P0 psiN psiN0 a0 b0 lca lcb nle u];
    subst.
  - left. split; assumption.
  - right. split; [exact lca|split; [exact lcb|split; assumption]].
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Main soundness: graded definable equality is a join           *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma GDefEq_Joins : forall P psi a b, GDefEq P psi a b -> Joins P psi a b.
Proof.
  apply GDefEq_mutind with
    (P := fun P psi a b _ => Joins P psi a b)
    (P0 := fun P psi psi0 a b _ => CJoins P psi psi0 a b).
  (* 1 GE_Var *)
  - move=> P psi x psi0 u Hle Hb.
    apply Joins_self. exact (@Par_Var P psi x psi0 u Hle Hb).
  (* 2 GE_Type *)
  - move=> P psi s u.
    apply Joins_self. apply Par_Type. exact u.
  (* 3 GE_Sym *)
  - move=> P psi b a g IH.
    apply Joins_sym. exact IH.
  (* 4 GE_Trans *)
  - move=> P psi a b b0 g1 IH1 g2 IH2.
    exact (Joins_trans IH1 IH2).
  (* 5 GE_App *)
  - move=> P psi b0 psi0 a0 b1 a1 g1 IH1 c2 IH2.
    destruct (Joins_inv IH1) as [dF [Hb0dF Hb1dF]].
    destruct (@CJoins_inv P psi psi0 a0 a1 IH2) as [[Hle HJarg] | [lca [lcb [nle u]]]].
    + destruct (Joins_inv HJarg) as [dA [Ha0dA Ha1dA]].
      have Ha0self : Par P psi a0 a0 :=
        @CGDefEq_par_l_of_leq P psi psi0 a0 a1 Hle c2.
      have Ha1self : Par P psi a1 a1 :=
        @CGDefEq_par_r_of_leq P psi psi0 a0 a1 Hle c2.
      have HdFself : Par P psi dF dF := @MultiPar_end_self P psi b0 dF Hb0dF.
      have HdAself : Par P psi dA dA := @MultiPar_end_self P psi a0 dA Ha0dA.
      apply join with (b := a_App dF psi0 dA).
      * exact (@MultiPar_App_two_leq P psi psi0 b0 dF a0 dA
                 Hle Ha0self (GDefEq_uniq g1) Hb0dF HdFself Ha0dA).
      * exact (@MultiPar_App_two_leq P psi psi0 b1 dF a1 dA
                 Hle Ha1self (GDefEq_uniq g1) Hb1dF HdFself Ha1dA).
    + have HdFself : Par P psi dF dF := @MultiPar_end_self P psi b0 dF Hb0dF.
      apply join with (b := a_App dF psi0 a0).
      * exact (@MultiPar_App_fun_nleq P psi psi0 b0 dF a0 nle lca u Hb0dF).
      * have Hredir : Par P psi (a_App dF psi0 a1) (a_App dF psi0 a0) :=
          @Par_App P psi dF psi0 a1 dF a0 HdFself
            (@CPar_Nleq P psi psi0 a1 a0 lcb lca nle u).
        exact (MultiPar_trans
                 (@MultiPar_App_fun_nleq P psi psi0 b1 dF a1 nle lcb u Hb1dF)
                 (MP_One' Hredir)).
  (* 6 GE_Abs *)
  - move=> L P psi psi0 A0 b0 A1 b1 lc0 lc1 gbody IHbody.
    destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b0) (fv_tm b1))))
      as [x0 Hx0].
    have Hx0L : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 L :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 L _ Hx0.
    have Hx0rest : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b0) (fv_tm b1)) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 L _ Hx0.
    have Hx0b0 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b0) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm b0) (fv_tm b1) Hx0rest.
    have Hx0b1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b1) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm b0) (fv_tm b1) Hx0rest.
    have Hg := gbody x0 Hx0L.
    have Hgenv := @GDefEq_self ((x0,psi0)::P) psi
      (open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x0)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x0)) Hg.

Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi u v ->
  Par P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 u))
            (a_SSigma psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 v)).

From Coq Require Import Lia.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* CPar at a smaller grade is a Par step                         *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma CPar_leq_inv : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CPar P psi psi0 a b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle Hc.
  inversion Hc; subst.
  - exact H0.
  - exfalso. exact (H1 Hle).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Multi-step lifting under binders                              *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma MultiPar_under_abs_close : forall E psi u v,
  MultiPar E psi u v ->
  forall P x0 psi0 A, E = ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq E -> lc_tm A ->
    MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 u))
                   (a_Abs psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 v)).
Proof.
  move=> E psi u v H.
  induction H as [EN psiN s t Hp | EN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> P x0 psi0 A EE Hu HlcA. subst EN.
    apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_under_abs_close P psiN psi0 A x0 s t Hu HlcA Hp).
  - move=> P x0 psi0 A EE Hu HlcA. subst EN.
    apply MP_Step with (b := a_Abs psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 m)).
    + exact (@Par_under_abs_close P psiN psi0 A x0 s m Hu HlcA Hp).
    + exact (IH P x0 psi0 A eq_refl Hu HlcA).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_under_pi_close_self : forall E psi u v,
  MultiPar E psi u v ->
  forall P x0 psi0 A, E = ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq E -> Par P psi A A ->
    MultiPar P psi (a_Pi psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 u))
                   (a_Pi psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 v)).
Proof.
  move=> E psi u v H.
  induction H as [EN psiN s t Hp | EN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> P x0 psi0 A EE Hu Hdom. subst EN.
    apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_under_pi_close_selfdom P psiN psi0 A x0 s t Hu Hdom Hp).
  - move=> P x0 psi0 A EE Hu Hdom. subst EN.
    apply MP_Step with (b := a_Pi psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 m)).
    + exact (@Par_under_pi_close_selfdom P psiN psi0 A x0 s m Hu Hdom Hp).
    + exact (IH P x0 psi0 A eq_refl Hu Hdom).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_under_pi_dom : forall E0 psi A0 A1,
  MultiPar E0 psi A0 A1 ->
  forall E x0 psi0 B, E0 = E ->
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::E) ->
    Par ((x0,psi0)::E) psi B B ->
    MultiPar E psi (a_Pi psi0 A0 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 B))
                   (a_Pi psi0 A1 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 B)).
Proof.
  move=> E0 psi A0 A1 H.
  induction H as [EN psiN s t Hp | EN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> E x0 psi0 B EE Hu Hself. subst EN.
    apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_under_pi_close_dom E psiN psi0 s t x0 B B Hu Hp Hself).
  - move=> E x0 psi0 B EE Hu Hself. subst EN.
    apply MP_Step with (b := a_Pi psi0 m (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 B)).
    + exact (@Par_under_pi_close_dom E psiN psi0 s m x0 B B Hu Hp Hself).
    + exact (IH E x0 psi0 B eq_refl Hu Hself).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_under_sigma_close_self : forall E psi u v,
  MultiPar E psi u v ->
  forall P x0 psi0 A, E = ((x0,psi0)::P) ->
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq E -> Par P psi A A ->
    MultiPar P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 u))
                   (a_SSigma psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 v)).
Proof.
  move=> E psi u v H.
  induction H as [EN psiN s t Hp | EN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> P x0 psi0 A EE Hu Hdom. subst EN.
    apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_under_sigma_close_selfdom P psiN psi0 A x0 s t Hu Hdom Hp).
  - move=> P x0 psi0 A EE Hu Hdom. subst EN.
    apply MP_Step with (b := a_SSigma psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 m)).
    + exact (@Par_under_sigma_close_selfdom P psiN psi0 A x0 s m Hu Hdom Hp).
    + exact (IH P x0 psi0 A eq_refl Hu Hdom).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_under_sigma_dom : forall E0 psi A0 A1,
  MultiPar E0 psi A0 A1 ->
  forall E x0 psi0 B, E0 = E ->
    Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::E) ->
    Par ((x0,psi0)::E) psi B B ->
    MultiPar E psi (a_SSigma psi0 A0 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 B))
                   (a_SSigma psi0 A1 (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 B)).
Proof.
  move=> E0 psi A0 A1 H.
  induction H as [EN psiN s t Hp | EN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> E x0 psi0 B EE Hu Hself. subst EN.
    apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_under_sigma_close_dom E psiN psi0 s t x0 B B Hu Hp Hself).
  - move=> E x0 psi0 B EE Hu Hself. subst EN.
    apply MP_Step with (b := a_SSigma psi0 m (close_tm_wrt_tm x0 B)).
    + exact (@Par_under_sigma_close_dom E psiN psi0 s m x0 B B Hu Hp Hself).
    + exact (IH E x0 psi0 B eq_refl Hu Hself).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_shape_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d ->
  forall psi0 A a, src = a_Abs psi0 A a ->
  exists L A' a', d = a_Abs psi0 A' a' /\ lc_tm A' /\
    (forall x : tmvar, ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L ->
       MultiPar ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x))
                                  (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> psi0 A a E. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PN psiN psi0 A a t Hp) as [L [A2 [a2 [Et [Hlc2 Hbody]]]]].
    subst t. exists L, A2, a2. split; [reflexivity|split; [exact Hlc2|]].
    move=> x Hx. apply MP_One. exact (Hbody x Hx).
  - move=> psi0 A a E. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PN psiN psi0 A a m Hp) as [L [A2 [a2 [Em [Hlc2 Hbody]]]]].
    destruct (IH psi0 A2 a2 Em) as [L' [A' [a' [Ed [Hlc' Hbody']]]]].
    exists (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L L'), A', a'.
    split; [exact Ed|split; [exact Hlc'|]].
    move=> x Hx.
    have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L L' Hx.
    have HxL' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L' :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L L' Hx.
    eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (Hbody x HxL).
    + exact (Hbody' x HxL').
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_shape : forall P psi psi0 A a d,
  MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) d ->
  exists L A' a', d = a_Abs psi0 A' a' /\ lc_tm A' /\
    (forall x : tmvar, ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L ->
       MultiPar ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x))
                                  (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x))).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a d H.
  exact (@MultiPar_Abs_shape_gen P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) d H psi0 A a eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Box_shape_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d ->
  forall psi0 a, src = a_Box psi0 a -> psi0 <= psi ->
  exists b, d = a_Box psi0 b /\ MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> psi0 a E Hle. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Box_inv PN psiN psi0 a t Hp) as [b [Et Hc]].
    subst t. exists b. split; [reflexivity|].
    apply MP_One. exact (@CPar_leq_inv PN psiN psi0 a b Hle Hc).
  - move=> psi0 a E Hle. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Box_inv PN psiN psi0 a m Hp) as [b [Em Hc]].
    destruct (IH psi0 b Em Hle) as [b' [Ed Htail']].
    exists b'. split; [exact Ed|].
    eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@CPar_leq_inv PN psiN psi0 a b Hle Hc).
    + exact Htail'.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Box_shape : forall P psi psi0 a d,
  psi0 <= psi ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Box psi0 a) d ->
  exists b, d = a_Box psi0 b /\ MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a d Hle H.
  exact (@MultiPar_Box_shape_gen P psi (a_Box psi0 a) d H psi0 a eq_refl Hle).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_SPair_shape_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d ->
  forall a0 psi0 b0, src = a_SPair a0 psi0 b0 -> psi0 <= psi ->
  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\
    MultiPar P psi a0 a1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> a0 psi0 b0 E Hle. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_SPair_inv PN psiN a0 psi0 b0 t Hp) as
      [a1 [b1 [Et [Hc Hpb]]]].
    subst t. exists a1, b1. split; [reflexivity|split].
    + apply MP_One. exact (@CPar_leq_inv PN psiN psi0 a0 a1 Hle Hc).
    + apply MP_One. exact Hpb.
  - move=> a0 psi0 b0 E Hle. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_SPair_inv PN psiN a0 psi0 b0 m Hp) as
      [a1 [b1 [Em [Hc Hpb]]]].
    destruct (IH a1 psi0 b1 Em Hle) as [a2 [b2 [Ed [Hpa2 Hpb2]]]].
    exists a2, b2. split; [exact Ed|split].
    + eapply MP_Step.
      * exact (@CPar_leq_inv PN psiN psi0 a0 a1 Hle Hc).
      * exact Hpa2.
    + eapply MP_Step.
      * exact Hpb.
      * exact Hpb2.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_SPair_shape : forall P psi a0 psi0 b0 d,
  psi0 <= psi ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) d ->
  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\
    MultiPar P psi a0 a1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 psi0 b0 d Hle H.
  exact (@MultiPar_SPair_shape_gen P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) d H a0 psi0 b0 eq_refl Hle).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_SPair_shape_snd_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d ->
  forall a0 psi0 b0, src = a_SPair a0 psi0 b0 ->
  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> a0 psi0 b0 E. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_SPair_inv PN psiN a0 psi0 b0 t Hp) as
      [a1 [b1 [Et [Hc Hpb]]]].
    subst t. exists a1, b1. split; [reflexivity|].
    apply MP_One. exact Hpb.
  - move=> a0 psi0 b0 E. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_SPair_inv PN psiN a0 psi0 b0 m Hp) as
      [a1 [b1 [Em [Hc Hpb]]]].
    destruct (IH a1 psi0 b1 Em) as [a2 [b2 [Ed Hpb2]]].
    exists a2, b2. split; [exact Ed|].
    eapply MP_Step.
    + exact Hpb.
    + exact Hpb2.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_SPair_shape_snd : forall P psi a0 psi0 b0 d,
  MultiPar P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) d ->
  exists a1 b1, d = a_SPair a1 psi0 b1 /\ MultiPar P psi b0 b1.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 psi0 b0 d H.
  exact (@MultiPar_SPair_shape_snd_gen P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b0) d H a0 psi0 b0 eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_True_shape_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d -> src = a_True -> d = a_True.
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> E. subst s. inversion Hp; subst; reflexivity.
  - move=> E. subst s. inversion Hp; subst. apply IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_True_shape : forall P psi d,
  MultiPar P psi a_True d -> d = a_True.
Proof. move=> P psi d H. exact (@MultiPar_True_shape_gen P psi a_True d H eq_refl). Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_False_shape_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d -> src = a_False -> d = a_False.
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> E. subst s. inversion Hp; subst; reflexivity.
  - move=> E. subst s. inversion Hp; subst. apply IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_False_shape : forall P psi d,
  MultiPar P psi a_False d -> d = a_False.
Proof. move=> P psi d H. exact (@MultiPar_False_shape_gen P psi a_False d H eq_refl). Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Refl_shape_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d -> src = a_Refl -> d = a_Refl.
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> E. subst s. inversion Hp; subst; reflexivity.
  - move=> E. subst s. inversion Hp; subst. apply IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Refl_shape : forall P psi d,
  MultiPar P psi a_Refl d -> d = a_Refl.
Proof. move=> P psi d H. exact (@MultiPar_Refl_shape_gen P psi a_Refl d H eq_refl). Qed.

Lemma Par_App_inv : forall P psi a psi0 b c,
  Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) c ->
  (exists a' b' A, c = open_tm_wrt_tm a' b' /\
     Par P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a') /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b')
  \/ (exists a' b', c = a_App a' psi0 b' /\
     Par P psi a a' /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi a psi0 b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
  - right. eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.


Lemma Par_Transp_inv : forall P psi a0 b0 c,
  Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) c ->
  (exists a1 b1, c = a_Transp a1 b1 /\ Par P psi a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b1)
  \/ (exists b1, c = b1 /\ Par P psi a0 a_Refl /\ Par P psi b0 b1).
Proof.

Definition PDPar (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (H:Par P psi a b) : Prop :=

Lemma Ctx_cons_inv : forall (x:tmvar) (g:grade) (A:tm) (W:context),
  Ctx (((x, (g, A)) :: W)) ->
  Ctx W /\ exists psi s, Typing W psi A (a_Type s).

Lemma Typing_Pi_dom_conv : forall W psi (A B:tm) psi0 T,
  Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) T ->
  forall s, DefEq (labels W) T (a_Type s) ->
  exists psi' s', Typing W psi' A (a_Type s').
Proof.
  move=> W psi A B psi0 T H.
  remember (a_Pi psi0 A B) as t eqn:E.
  revert A B psi0 E.
  induction H; intros A' B' psi0' E s0 HD; try discriminate E.
  - inversion E; subst. eauto.
  - subst. refine (IHTyping1 A' B' psi0' eq_refl s0 _).
    eapply E_Trans; [exact H1 | exact HD].
Qed.

Lemma binds_app_l : forall (A:Type) x a (E F:list (MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom * A)),

Lemma binds_cons_iff : forall (A:Type) (x:MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom) (a:A)
