Lemma Typing_weaken_app : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A ->
  forall E, Ctx (W ++ E) -> Typing (W ++ E) psi a A.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A H.
  induction H; intros E HC.
  all: try (match goal with
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Type _) _ => eapply T_Type; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_App _ _ _) _ => eapply T_App; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Refl _ => eapply T_Refl; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_CEq _ _ _ _ _) _ => eapply T_CEq; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_T _ _) _ => eapply T_T; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Box _ _) _ => eapply T_Box; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Unbox _ _) _ => eapply T_Unbox; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_SPair _ _ _) _ => eapply T_SPair; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj1 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj1; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj2 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj2; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TyUnit _ => eapply T_TyUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TmUnit _ => eapply T_TmUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Bool _ => eapply T_Bool; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_True _ => eapply T_True; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_False _ => eapply T_False; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_If _ _ _) _ => eapply T_If; eauto
    end).
  - (* Var *) eapply T_Var; [exact HC | exact H0 | apply binds_app_l; exact H1].
  - (* Pi *)
    eapply T_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E))).
    + exact (IHTyping E HC).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) Hx.
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ (W ++ E)).
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC | exact (IHTyping E HC) | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H1 x HxL E HCx).
    + exact H2.
  - (* Abs *)
    eapply T_Abs with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E))).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) Hx.
      have Hpi' : Typing (W ++ E) psi1 (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s) := IHTyping E HC.
      have HDs : DefEq (labels (W ++ E)) (a_Type s) (a_Type s).
      { eapply (@E_One (labels (W ++ E)) (a_Type s) (a_Type s) psi1). apply GE_Type. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact HC. }
      destruct (@Typing_Pi_dom_conv (W ++ E) psi1 A B psi0 (a_Type s) Hpi' s HDs) as [ps [ss HA]].
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ (W ++ E)).
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC | exact HA | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H0 x HxL E HCx).
    + exact (IHTyping E HC).
  - (* Conv *)
    eapply T_Conv.
    + exact (IHTyping1 E HC).
    + exact (IHTyping2 E HC).
    + refine (@DefEq_weaken (labels W) A B H1 (labels (W ++ E)) _ _).
      * move=> x g Hx. rewrite labels_app. apply binds_app_l. exact Hx.
      * apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact HC.
  - (* Transp *)
    eapply T_Transp with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E))).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) Hx.
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi1, A)) ++ (W ++ E)).
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC | exact (IHTyping3 E HC) | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H0 x HxL E HCx).
    + exact (IHTyping1 E HC).
    + exact (IHTyping2 E HC).
    + exact (IHTyping3 E HC).
  - (* SSigma *)
    eapply T_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E))).
    + exact (IHTyping E HC).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (W ++ E)) Hx.
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ (W ++ E)).
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC | exact (IHTyping E HC) | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H1 x HxL E HCx).
    + exact H2.
Qed.

Proof.

  all: try (match goal with
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Type _) _ => eapply T_Type; eauto

    | |- Typing _ _ a_Refl _ => eapply T_Refl; eauto

    | |- Typing _ _ (a_T _ _) _ => eapply T_T; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Box _ _) _ => eapply T_Box; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Unbox _ _) _ => eapply T_Unbox; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_SPair _ _ _) _ => eapply T_SPair; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj1 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj1; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj2 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj2; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TyUnit _ => eapply T_TyUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TmUnit _ => eapply T_TmUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Bool _ => eapply T_Bool; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_True _ => eapply T_True; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_False _ => eapply T_False; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_If _ _ _) _ => eapply T_If; eauto
    end).
  - (* Var *) eapply T_Var; [exact HC' | exact H0 | apply Hb; exact H1].
  - (* Pi *)
    eapply T_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W')).
    + exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W').
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC' | exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb) | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H1 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_iff_ctx x (psi0, A) W W' Hb)).
    + exact H2.
  - (* Abs *)
    eapply T_Abs with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W')).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have Hpi' : Typing W' psi1 (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s) := IHTyping W' HC' Hb.
      have HDs : DefEq (labels W') (a_Type s) (a_Type s).
      { eapply (@E_One (labels W') (a_Type s) (a_Type s) psi1). apply GE_Type. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact HC'. }
      destruct (@Typing_Pi_dom_conv W' psi1 A B psi0 (a_Type s) Hpi' s HDs) as [ps [ss HA]].
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W').
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC' | exact HA | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H0 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_iff_ctx x (psi0, A) W W' Hb)).
    + exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb).
  - (* Conv *)
    have Hbl : forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g (labels W) <-> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g (labels W').
    { move=> x g. split; move=> Hb'.
      - destruct (binds_labels_inv Hb') as [Ax HAx].
        exact (@binds_labels W' x g Ax (proj1 (Hb x g Ax) HAx)).
      - destruct (binds_labels_inv Hb') as [Ax HAx].
        exact (@binds_labels W x g Ax (proj2 (Hb x g Ax) HAx)). }
    eapply T_Conv.
    + exact (IHTyping1 W' HC' Hb).
    + exact (IHTyping2 W' HC' Hb).
    + refine (@DefEq_weaken (labels W) A B H1 (labels W') _ _).
      * exact (fun x g => proj1 (Hbl x g)).
      * apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact HC'.
  - (* Transp *)
    eapply T_Transp with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W')).
    + move=> x Hx.

      exact (H0 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi1, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_iff_ctx x (psi1, A) W W' Hb)).
    + exact (IHTyping1 W' HC' Hb).
    + exact (IHTyping2 W' HC' Hb).
    + exact (IHTyping3 W' HC' Hb).
  - (* SSigma *)
    eapply T_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W')).
    + exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W').
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC' | exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb) | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H1 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_iff_ctx x (psi0, A) W W' Hb)).
    + exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma Typing_weaken_ctx : forall W psi a A, Typing W psi a A ->
  forall W', Ctx W' ->
    (forall x g B, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (g,B) W -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (g,B) W') ->
    Typing W' psi a A.
Proof.
  move=> W psi a A H.
  induction H; intros W' HC' Hb.
  all: try (match goal with
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Type _) _ => eapply T_Type; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_App _ _ _) _ => eapply T_App; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Refl _ => eapply T_Refl; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_CEq _ _ _ _ _) _ => eapply T_CEq; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_T _ _) _ => eapply T_T; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Box _ _) _ => eapply T_Box; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Unbox _ _) _ => eapply T_Unbox; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_SPair _ _ _) _ => eapply T_SPair; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj1 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj1; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj2 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj2; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TyUnit _ => eapply T_TyUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TmUnit _ => eapply T_TmUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Bool _ => eapply T_Bool; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_True _ => eapply T_True; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_False _ => eapply T_False; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_If _ _ _) _ => eapply T_If; eauto
    end).
  - (* Var *) eapply T_Var; [exact HC' | exact H0 | apply Hb; exact H1].
  - (* Pi *)
    eapply T_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W')).
    + exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W').
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC' | exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb) | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H1 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_incl_ctx x (psi0, A) W W' Hb)).
    + exact H2.
  - (* Abs *)
    eapply T_Abs with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W')).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have Hpi' : Typing W' psi1 (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s) := IHTyping W' HC' Hb.
      have HDs : DefEq (labels W') (a_Type s) (a_Type s).
      { eapply (@E_One (labels W') (a_Type s) (a_Type s) psi1). apply GE_Type. apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact HC'. }
      destruct (@Typing_Pi_dom_conv W' psi1 A B psi0 (a_Type s) Hpi' s HDs) as [ps [ss HA]].
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W').
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC' | exact HA | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H0 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_incl_ctx x (psi0, A) W W' Hb)).
    + exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb).
  - (* Conv *)
    have Hbl : forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g (labels W) -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g (labels W').
    { move=> x g Hb'. destruct (binds_labels_inv Hb') as [Ax HAx].
      exact (@binds_labels W' x g Ax (Hb x g Ax HAx)). }
    eapply T_Conv.
    + exact (IHTyping1 W' HC' Hb).
    + exact (IHTyping2 W' HC' Hb).
    + refine (@DefEq_weaken (labels W) A B H1 (labels W') _ _).
      * exact Hbl.
      * apply uniq_labels. apply Ctx_uniq. exact HC'.
  - (* Transp *)
    eapply T_Transp with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W')).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi1, A)) ++ W').
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC' | exact (IHTyping3 W' HC' Hb) | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H0 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi1, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_incl_ctx x (psi1, A) W W' Hb)).
    + exact (IHTyping1 W' HC' Hb).
    + exact (IHTyping2 W' HC' Hb).
    + exact (IHTyping3 W' HC' Hb).
  - (* SSigma *)
    eapply T_SSigma with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W')).
    + exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb).
    + move=> x Hx.
      have HxL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have Hxd : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x L (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom W') Hx.
      have HCx : Ctx (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W').
      { eapply Ctx_Cons; [exact HC' | exact (IHTyping W' HC' Hb) | exact Hxd]. }
      exact (H1 x HxL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W') HCx (@binds_cons_incl_ctx x (psi0, A) W W' Hb)).
    + exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma Red_det : forall a b, Red a b -> forall c, Red a c -> b = c.
Proof.
  move=> a b H. elim: H.
  - move=> a0 psi0 b0 a1 hb hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi0 A a0 b0 hA hAbs hb c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> a0 b0 a1 hb hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> a0 ha c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi0 a0 a1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi0 a0 ha c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi a0 a1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi a0 a1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi a1 a2 ha2 ha1 c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> psi a1 a2 ha1 ha2 c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> a0 b0 b1 a' hb0 hb1 hr ih c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try (f_equal; eauto); try inv_red_value.
  - move=> b0 b1 hb1 hb0 c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.
  - move=> b0 b1 hb0 hb1 c hc. inversion hc; subst; auto; try inv_red_value.

Lemma Red_value_impossible : forall a b, Value a -> Red a b -> False.
Proof.
  move=> a. case: a => //=; move=> *;
  match goal with h : Red _ _ |- False => inversion h end.
Qed.

Lemma Reds_value_inv : forall a b, Value a -> Reds a b -> b = a.
Proof.
  move=> a b hv hr. inversion hr; subst; auto.
  - exfalso. exact (Red_value_impossible hv H).

Lemma Reds_det_value : forall a b c, Reds a b -> Reds a c -> Value b -> Value c -> b = c.
Proof.

  - move=> a0 ha h2 hvb hvc. inversion h2; subst; auto.

    + exfalso. exact (Red_value_impossible hvc hr).
    + move: (Red_det hr H) => E; subst b0. exact (ih H0 hvb hvc).
Qed.

(* ---------- de Bruijn locally closed predicate ---------- *)
Fixpoint lc_d (n:nat) (a:tm) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | a_Var_b k => lt k n
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Pi _ A B => lc_d n A /\ lc_d (S n) B
  | a_Abs _ A B => lc_d n A /\ lc_d (S n) B
  | a_App a _ b => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_CEq _ a b _ A => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b /\ lc_d n A
  | a_Refl => True
  | a_Transp a b => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b
  | a_T _ A => lc_d n A
  | a_Box _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_Unbox _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_SSigma _ A B => lc_d n A /\ lc_d (S n) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => lc_d n a
  | a_Bool => True
  | a_True => True
  | a_False => True
  | a_If a b0 b1 => lc_d n a /\ lc_d n b0 /\ lc_d n b1
  end.

Definition lcD (a:tm) := lc_d 0 a.

    + apply IHB1; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).
    + apply IHB2; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm B1) (fv_tm B2) H).

    + apply IHB1; [exact Hxy|]. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm B1) (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm B2) (fv_tm B3)) H).

Lemma fv_close_notin : forall (t:tm) x k,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x t)).
Proof.
  move=> t. induction t => xx k; simpl; auto.
  - (* Var_b *) destruct (lt_dec n k); simpl; apply notin_empty.
  - (* Var_f *) simpl. set (u := eq_var xx x). destruct u as [e|ne].
    + subst x. simpl. apply notin_empty.
    + simpl. intro Hin. apply (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 x xx) in Hin.
      exfalso. exact (ne (eq_sym Hin)).
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_var_b_lt : forall n k yy,
  (n < k)%nat ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (a_Var_b n) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  move=> n k yy H.
  cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  case: (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) => [[H1|H1]|H1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. lia.
  - exfalso. lia.
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_var_b_ge : forall n k yy,
  ~ (n < k)%nat ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (a_Var_b (S n)) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  move=> n k yy H.
  cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  case: (lt_eq_lt_dec (S n) k) => [[H1|H1]|H1]; simpl.
  - exfalso. lia.
  - exfalso. lia.
  - rewrite Nat.sub_0_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_var_b_eq : forall k yy,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (a_Var_b k) = a_Var_f yy.
Proof.
  move=> k yy.
  cbn [open_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  case: (lt_eq_lt_dec k k) => [[H1|H1]|H1]; simpl; try reflexivity; exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma oc_var_b : forall xx yy k n,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_b n)) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  move=> xx yy k n.
  cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
  case: (lt_dec n k) => [Hlt|Hge].
  - rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_lt n k yy Hlt). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_ge n k yy Hge). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma is_left_eq_dec_comm : forall (A:Type) (E:EqDec_eq A) x y,
  @is_left (@eq A x y) (not (@eq A x y)) (@eq_dec A E x y) =
  @is_left (@eq A y x) (not (@eq A y x)) (@eq_dec A E y x).
Proof.
  move=> A E x y. simpl.
  destruct (@eq_dec A E x y) as [e|ne].
  - destruct (@eq_dec A E y x) as [e'|ne']; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. exact (ne' (eq_sym e)).
  - destruct (@eq_dec A E y x) as [e'|ne']; simpl.
    + exfalso. exact (ne (eq_sym e')).
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma oc_var_f : forall xx yy k x,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_f x)) =
  subst_tm (a_Var_f yy) xx (a_Var_f x).
Proof.
  move=> xx yy k x.
  cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec subst_tm].
  rewrite <- (@is_left_eq_dec_comm Atom.atom EqDec_eq_of_X x xx).
  change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy)
    match @is_left (@eq tmvar x xx) (not (@eq tmvar x xx))
            (@eq_dec tmvar EqDec_eq_of_X x xx) with
    | @true => a_Var_b k
    | @false => a_Var_f x
    end =
    match @is_left (@eq tmvar x xx) (not (@eq tmvar x xx))
            (@eq_dec tmvar EqDec_eq_of_X x xx) with
    | @true => a_Var_f yy
    | @false => a_Var_f x
    end).
  destruct (@eq_dec tmvar EqDec_eq_of_X x xx) as [Heq|Hne].
  - rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_eq k yy). reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_close_subst : forall (t:tm) x y k,
  y <> x ->
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f y) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k x t) =
  subst_tm (a_Var_f y) x t.
Proof.
  move=> t. induction t => xx yy k Hxy; simpl; auto.
  - (* Pi *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy (S k) Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Abs *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy (S k) Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* App *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Var_b *)
    change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy)
              (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_b n)) = a_Var_b n).
    rewrite (@oc_var_b xx yy k n). reflexivity.
  - (* Var_f *)
    change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f yy)
              (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_f x)) =
            subst_tm (a_Var_f yy) xx (a_Var_f x)).
    rewrite (@oc_var_f xx yy k x). reflexivity.
  - (* CEq *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt3 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Transp *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* T *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Box *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Unbox *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* SSigma *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy (S k) Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* SPair *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj1 *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj2 *) rewrite (IHt xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
  - (* If *) rewrite (IHt1 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt2 xx yy k Hxy) (IHt3 xx yy k Hxy). reflexivity.
Qed.

From Metalib Require Import Metatheory.
From Coq Require Import Lia.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

Fixpoint econtext_remove (x:tmvar) (P:econtext) : econtext :=
  match P with
  | nil => nil
  | (y,g) :: P' => if eq_var y x then econtext_remove x P' else (y,g) :: econtext_remove x P'
  end.

Lemma dom_remove : forall (P:econtext) x z,
  MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P)) <->
  MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) /\ z <> x.
Proof.
  move=> P.
  elim: P => [| [y h] P' IH].
  - move=> x z. simpl. split.
    + intro H. exfalso. exact (notin_empty z H).
    + intro H. destruct H as [H1 _]. exfalso. exact (notin_empty z H1).
  - move=> x z. simpl.
    destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne].
    + subst y. simpl. split.
      * intro H. destruct (proj1 (IH x z) H) as [H1 H2]. split.
        -- exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') x z H1).
        -- exact H2.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Hin H2]. apply (proj2 (IH x z)). split.
        -- refine (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') x z _ Hin).
           intro E. exact (H2 (eq_sym E)).
        -- exact H2.
    + split.
      * intro H. destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec z y) as [E|nE].
        -- subst z. split.
           ++ exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_1 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') y y eq_refl).
           ++ exact ne.
        -- have Hz : MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) :=
             @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) y z (fun E => nE (eq_sym E)) H.
           destruct (proj1 (IH x z) Hz) as [H1 H2]. split.
           ++ exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') y z H1).
           ++ exact H2.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Hin H2].
        destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec z y) as [E|nE].
        -- subst z. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_1 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) y y eq_refl).
        -- have Hz : MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') :=
             @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') y z (fun E => nE (eq_sym E)) Hin.
           exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) y z
                    (proj2 (IH x z) (conj Hz H2))).
Qed.

Lemma binds_remove_other : forall (P:econtext) x y g,
  y <> x ->
  (Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y g (econtext_remove x P) <->
   Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y g P).
Proof.
  move=> P.
  elim: P => [| [z h] P' IH].
  - move=> x y g Hne. simpl. tauto.
  - move=> x y g Hne. simpl.
    destruct (eq_var z x) as [e|ne].
    + subst z. split.
      * intro H. apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_3 grade y x g h P'). exact (proj1 (IH x y g Hne) H).
      * intro H. apply (proj2 (IH x y g Hne)).
        destruct (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_1 grade y x g h P' H) as [[E1 E2]|Ht].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hne E1).
        -- exact Ht.
    + split.
      * intro H. simpl in H. destruct (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_1 grade y z g h (econtext_remove x P') H) as [[E1 E2]|Ht].
        -- left. subst y. subst g. reflexivity.
        -- right. exact (proj1 (IH x y g Hne) Ht).
      * intro H. simpl in H. destruct (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_1 grade y z g h P' H) as [[E1 E2]|Ht].
        -- left. subst y. subst g. reflexivity.
        -- right. exact (proj2 (IH x y g Hne) Ht).
Qed.

Lemma binds_remove_self : forall (P:econtext) x g,
  ~ Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g (econtext_remove x P).
Proof.
  move=> P.
  elim: P => [| [z h] P' IH].
  - move=> x g. simpl. tauto.
  - move=> x g. simpl.
    destruct (eq_var z x) as [e|ne].
    + subst z. exact (IH x g).
    + intro H. simpl in H. destruct (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_1 grade x z g h (econtext_remove x P') H) as [[E1 E2]|Ht].
      * exfalso. apply ne. symmetry. exact E1.
      * exact (IH x g Ht).
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_cons : forall (P:econtext) x y g,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom ((y,g)::P)) ->
  x <> y /\ ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P).
Proof.
  move=> P x y g H. simpl in H. split.
  - intro E. subst y. apply H. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_1 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) x x eq_refl).
  - intro Hin. apply H. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) y x Hin).
Qed.

Lemma remove_notin : forall (P:econtext) x,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) ->
  econtext_remove x P = P.
Proof.
  move=> P.
  elim: P => [| [y g] P' IH].
  - move=> x H. reflexivity.
  - move=> x H. simpl.
    destruct (@notin_dom_cons P' x y g H) as [Hxy HP'].
    destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne].
    + exfalso. apply Hxy. symmetry. exact e.
    + simpl. f_equal. apply IH. exact HP'.
Qed.

Lemma remove_cons_self : forall (P:econtext) x g,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) ->
  econtext_remove x ((x,g)::P) = P.
Proof.
  move=> P x g H. simpl.
  destruct (eq_var x x) as [e|ne].
  - simpl. apply remove_notin. exact H.
  - exfalso. exact (ne eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma uniq_remove : forall (P:econtext) x,
  Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq (econtext_remove x P).
Proof.
  move=> P.
  elim: P => [| [y g] P' IH].
  - move=> x H. simpl. exact H.
  - move=> x H. simpl.
    destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne].
    + subst y. simpl. apply IH. exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 grade x g P' H).
    + simpl. have Hy : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In y (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') :=
        @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_2 grade y g P' H.
      apply (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_3 grade y g (econtext_remove x P')).
      * apply IH. exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_cons_1 grade y g P' H).
      * intro Hin. exact (Hy (proj1 (proj1 (dom_remove P' x y) Hin))).
Qed.

Definition PDrop (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm) (H:Par P psi a b) : Prop :=
  forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
    ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
    Par (econtext_remove x P) psi a b.
Arguments PDrop _ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.

Definition CDrop (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b:tm) (H:CPar P psi psi0 a b) : Prop :=
  forall x g, Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x g P ->
    ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm a) ->
    CPar (econtext_remove x P) psi psi0 a b.
Arguments CDrop _ _ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.

Lemma is_left_eq_dec_right : forall (A:Type) (E:EqDec_eq A) (x y:A), x<>y ->
  @is_left (@eq A x y) (not (@eq A x y)) (@eq_dec A E x y) = false.
Proof.
  move=> A E x y H. simpl.
  destruct (@eq_dec A E x y) as [e|ne].
  - exfalso. exact (H e).
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma remove_cons_other : forall (P:econtext) x y g,
  y <> x -> econtext_remove x ((y,g)::P) = (y,g)::econtext_remove x P.
Proof.
  move=> P x y g H. simpl.
  rewrite (@is_left_eq_dec_right Atom.atom EqDec_eq_of_X y x H).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_trans : forall P psi a b c,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b c H. induction H.
  - intros Hbc. eapply MP_Step; [exact H|exact Hbc].
  - intros Hbc. eapply MP_Step; [exact H|exact (IHMultiPar Hbc)].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_diamond_step : forall P psi a b,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, Par P psi a c ->
  exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ MultiPar P psi c d.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H. induction H.
  - move=> c0 Hac0.
    destruct (@Par_diamond P psi a b H c0 Hac0) as [d [Hbd Hcd]].
    exists d. split; eapply MP_One; assumption.
  - move=> c0 Hac0.
    destruct (@Par_diamond P psi a b H c0 Hac0) as [d1 [Hbd1 Hc0d1]].
    destruct (IHMultiPar d1 Hbd1) as [d [Ha'd Hd1d]].
    exists d. split; [exact Ha'd|].
    have Hc0d1m : MultiPar P psi c0 d1 by eapply MP_One; exact Hc0d1.
    exact (MultiPar_trans Hc0d1m Hd1d).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_diamond : forall P psi a c,
  MultiPar P psi a c -> forall b, MultiPar P psi a b ->
  exists d, MultiPar P psi b d /\ MultiPar P psi c d.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a c Hc. induction Hc.
  - move=> bb Hab. exact (@MultiPar_diamond_step P psi a bb Hab b H).
  - move=> bb Hab.
    destruct (@MultiPar_diamond_step P psi a bb Hab b H) as [d1 [Hbb_d1 Hb_d1]].
    destruct (IHHc d1 Hb_d1) as [d [Hd1d Ha'd]].
    exists d. split; [exact (MultiPar_trans Hbb_d1 Hd1d)|exact Ha'd].
Qed.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall P psi a b, Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  inversion H as [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
  exact (@join P psi b a b0 H2 H1).
Qed.

Lemma Joins_trans : forall P psi a b c,
  Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b c -> Joins P psi a c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b c H1 H2.
  inversion H1 as [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b0 H1a H1b]; subst.
  inversion H2 as [P1 psi1 a1' a2' b1 H2a H2b]; subst.
  destruct (@MultiPar_diamond P psi b b0 H1b b1 H2a) as [d [Hb1d Hb0d]].
  exact (@join P psi a c d (MultiPar_trans H1a Hb0d) (MultiPar_trans H2b Hb1d)).
Qed.
(* ============================================================ *)
(* One-step commutation of a parallel step in an abstraction     *)
(* body with a parallel step of its argument.                    *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Par_Abs_arg_step : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') ->
  (psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi b b') ->
  lc_tm b -> lc_tm b' ->
  Par P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' H Hcond Hlcb Hlcb'.
  inversion H; subst.
  (* Context now contains the fresh set L, lc annotations, and the
     pointwise body relation H9. *)
  set S := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L
             (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a)
               (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a')
                 (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
                   (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
                     (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P))))).
  destruct (MetatheoryAtom.atom_fresh S) as [x0 Hx0].
  have Hx0L : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 L :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 L _ Hx0.
  have Hx0rest : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a')
          (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
            (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
              (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P))))) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 L _ Hx0.
  have Hx0a : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm a) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm a) _ Hx0rest.
  have Hx0rest1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm a')
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
          (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
            (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P)))) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm a) _ Hx0rest.
  have Hx0a' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm a') :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm a') _ Hx0rest1.
  have Hx0rest2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b')
          (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P))) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm a') _ Hx0rest1.
  have Hx0b : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm b) _ Hx0rest2.
  have Hx0rest3 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0
      (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm b') (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P)) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm b) _ Hx0rest2.
  have Hx0b' : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm b') :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 x0 (fv_tm b') _ Hx0rest3.
  have Hx0dom : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) :=
    @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 x0 (fv_tm b') _ Hx0rest3.

  have HuniqP : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P :=
    @Par_uniq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') H.
  have Huniq0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq ((x0,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq_push grade x0 psi0 P HuniqP Hx0dom.
  have Hbindx0 : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x0 psi0 ((x0,psi0)::P) :=
    @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_2 grade x0 x0 psi0 psi0 P eq_refl eq_refl.
  have Hbody0 : Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi
      (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x0)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x0)) :=
    H9 x0 Hx0L.
  have Hcond0 : psi0 <= psi -> Par ((x0,psi0)::P) psi b b' :=
    fun Hle => @Par_weaken P psi b b' (Hcond Hle) ((x0,psi0)::P)
      (fun z g Hz => @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_cons_3 grade z x0 g psi0 P Hz)
      Huniq0.
  have Hsub := @Par_subst_cond ((x0,psi0)::P) psi
      (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x0)) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x0)) Hbody0
      x0 psi0 b b' Huniq0 Hbindx0 Hlcb Hlcb' Hcond0.
  rewrite (@subst_open_self a b x0 Hlcb Hx0a) in Hsub.
  rewrite (@subst_open_self a' b' x0 Hlcb' Hx0a') in Hsub.
  have Hnotin : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x0 (fv_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm a b)) :=
    @notin_fv_open a b x0 Hx0a Hx0b.
  exact (@Par_drop_src P x0 psi0 psi
           (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b') Hsub Hnotin).
Qed.

(* Variants with one derivation a single parallel step.          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_one_arg : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') ->
  forall (N:MultiPar P psi b b'),
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' Hm N.
  induction N as [PN psiN bS bT Hn | PN psiN bS bT bM Hn Ntail IH].
  - move=> Hself. apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A' a' bS bT Hm
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))).
  - move=> Hself.
    have Hstep : Par PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bS) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bM Hself
               (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))). }
    have Htail : MultiPar PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' bT).
    { apply IH; [exact Hm | exact Hself]. }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

(* Body is an arbitrary multi-step derivation, the argument is a
   single parallel step.  We state a generalized version over the
   body endpoints, since the intermediate body steps are only known
   to be abstractions after inversion. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_one_gen : forall P psi (X Y:tm) (M:MultiPar P psi X Y)
  psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  X = a_Abs psi0 A a -> Y = a_Abs psi0 A' a' ->
  Par P psi b b' -> Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi X Y M.
  induction M as [PM psiM X0 Y0 Hm | PM psiM X0 Y0 Ymid Hm Mtail IH].
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b b' EX EY Hn Hself.
    subst X0. subst Y0. apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PM psiM psi0 A a A' a' b b' Hm
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b' Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b' Hn))).
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b b' EX EY Hn Hself.
    subst X0. subst Y0.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PM psiM psi0 A a Ymid Hm) as
      [L [A2 [a2 [EYmid [HlcA2 Hbody]]]]].
    subst Ymid.
    have Htail : MultiPar PM psiM (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
    { exact (IH psi0 A2 a2 A' a' b b' eq_refl eq_refl Hn Hself). }
    have Hstep : Par PM psiM (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PM psiM psi0 A a A2 a2 b b Hm
               (fun _ => Hself) (proj1 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b Hself))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PM psiM b b Hself))). }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_one : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b',
  forall (M:MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a')),
  Par P psi b b' ->
  Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b' M Hn Hself.
  exact (@MultiPar_Abs_arg_one_gen P psi
           (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') M
           psi0 A a A' a' b b' eq_refl eq_refl Hn Hself).
Qed.

(* Transitivity of MultiPar (needed to compose the two phases). *)
(* A multi-step argument path at a fixed (self-reducible) abstraction. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_self_body : forall P psi psi0 A a b b',
  Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) ->
  forall (N:MultiPar P psi b b'),
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a b b' Hself N.
  induction N as [PN psiN bS bT Hn | PN psiN bS bT bM Hn Ntail IH].
  - apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bT Hself
             (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))
             (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bT Hn))).
  - have Hstep : Par PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bS) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM).
    { exact (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A a bS bM Hself
               (fun _ => Hn) (proj1 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))
               (proj2 (@Par_lc PN psiN bS bM Hn))). }
    have Htail : MultiPar PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a bM) (open_tm_wrt_tm a bT).
    { exact (IH Hself). }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep | exact Htail].
Qed.

(* Multi-step body path with a self-reducible argument. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_self_arg : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b,
  forall (M:MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a')),
  Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b M Hself.
  exact (@MultiPar_Abs_arg_one P psi psi0 A a A' a' b b M Hself Hself).
Qed.

Lemma GDefEq_self : forall P psi a b, GDefEq P psi a b -> Par P psi a a /\ Par P psi b b.
Proof.
  apply GDefEq_mutind with
    (P := fun P psi a b _ => Par P psi a a /\ Par P psi b b)
    (P0 := fun P psi psi0 a b _ => CPar P psi psi0 a a /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b).
  - move=> P psi x psi0 u Hle Hb. split; econstructor; eassumption.
  - move=> P psi s u. split; apply Par_Type; exact u.
  - move=> P psi b a g IH. exact (conj (proj2 IH) (proj1 IH)).
  - move=> P psi a b b0 g1 IH1 g2 IH2. exact (conj (proj1 IH1) (proj2 IH2)).
  - move=> P psi b0 psi0 a0 b1 a1 g1 IH1 c2 IH2.
    split.
    + apply Par_App; [exact (proj1 IH1)|exact (proj1 IH2)].
    + apply Par_App; [exact (proj2 IH1)|exact (proj2 IH2)].
  - move=> L P psi psi0 A0 b0 A1 b1 lc0 lc1 gbody IHbody.
    split.
    + apply (@Par_Abs L P psi psi0 A0 b0 A0 b0 lc0 lc0).
      move=> x Hx. exact (proj1 (IHbody x Hx)).
    + apply (@Par_Abs L P psi psi0 A1 b1 A1 b1 lc1 lc1).
      move=> x Hx. exact (proj2 (IHbody x Hx)).
  - move=> L P psi psi0 A0 B0 A1 B1 gdom IHdom gbody IHbody.
    split.
    + apply (@Par_Pi L P psi psi0 A0 B0 A0 B0). exact (proj1 IHdom).
      move=> x Hx. exact (proj1 (IHbody x Hx)).
    + apply (@Par_Pi L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A1 B1). exact (proj2 IHdom).
      move=> x Hx. exact (proj2 (IHbody x Hx)).
  - move=> P psi a psi0 b0 a0 b1 A gfun IHfun carg IHcarg.
    split.
    + apply Par_App; [exact (proj1 IHfun)|exact (proj1 IHcarg)].
    + exact (@CPar_self_abs_arg P psi psi0 A a0 b1 (proj2 IHfun) (proj2 IHcarg)).
  - move=> P psi u. split; apply Par_Refl; exact u.
  - move=> P psi a0 b0 a1 b1 g1 IH1 g2 IH2.
    split.
    + apply Par_Transp; [exact (proj1 IH1)|exact (proj1 IH2)].
    + apply Par_Transp; [exact (proj2 IH1)|exact (proj2 IH2)].
  - move=> P psi psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0 a1 b1 A1 lc0 lc1 g1 IH1 g2 IH2 Hle.
    split;
      [apply (@Par_CEq P psi psi0 a0 b0 psi1 A0 a0 b0 A0 lc0 lc0 (proj1 IH1) (proj1 IH2) Hle)
      |apply (@Par_CEq P psi psi0 a1 b1 psi1 A1 a1 b1 A1 lc1 lc1 (proj2 IH1) (proj2 IH2) Hle)].
  - move=> P psi a0 b0 b1 g1 IH1 g2 IH2.
    split.
    + apply Par_Transp; [exact (proj1 IH1)|exact (proj1 IH2)].
    + exact (proj2 IH2).
  - move=> P psi psi0 A B g IH. split; apply Par_T; [exact (proj1 IH)|exact (proj2 IH)].
  - move=> P psi psi0 a b c IH. split; apply Par_Box; [exact (proj1 IH)|exact (proj2 IH)].
  - move=> P psi psi0 a b g IH Hle.
    split.
    + apply (@Par_Unbox P psi psi0 a a (proj1 IH) Hle).
    + apply (@Par_Unbox P psi psi0 b b (proj2 IH) Hle).
  - move=> P psi psi0 a b gfun IHfun Hle.
    split.
    + apply (@Par_Unbox P psi psi0 a a (proj1 IHfun) Hle).
    + exact (@CPar_par_leq P psi psi0 b b Hle
               (@Par_Box_self_c P psi psi0 b (proj2 IHfun))).
  - move=> P psi psi0 a0 a1 g IH Hle.
    split.
    + apply (@Par_Proj1Cong P psi psi0 a0 a0 (proj1 IH) Hle).
    + apply (@Par_Proj1Cong P psi psi0 a1 a1 (proj2 IH) Hle).
  - move=> P psi psi0 a0 a1 g IH.
    split; apply Par_Proj2Cong; [exact (proj1 IH)|exact (proj2 IH)].
  - move=> P psi psi0 b a1 a2 gfun IHfun Hle.
    split.
    + apply (@Par_Proj1Cong P psi psi0 b b (proj1 IHfun) Hle).
    + exact (@CPar_par_leq P psi psi0 a1 a1 Hle
               (@Par_SPair_self_l P psi a1 psi0 a2 (proj2 IHfun))).
  - move=> P psi psi0 b a2 a1 gfun IHfun.
    split.
    + apply Par_Proj2Cong. exact (proj1 IHfun).
    + exact (@Par_SPair_self_r P psi a1 psi0 a2 (proj2 IHfun)).
  - move=> P psi a0 psi0 b0 a1 b1 carg IHcarg g2 IH2.
    split.
    + apply Par_SPair; [exact (proj1 IHcarg)|exact (proj1 IH2)].
    + apply Par_SPair; [exact (proj2 IHcarg)|exact (proj2 IH2)].
  - move=> L P psi psi0 A0 B0 A1 B1 gdom IHdom gbody IHbody.
    split.
    + apply (@Par_SSigma L P psi psi0 A0 B0 A0 B0). exact (proj1 IHdom).
      move=> x Hx. exact (proj1 (IHbody x Hx)).
    + apply (@Par_SSigma L P psi psi0 A1 B1 A1 B1). exact (proj2 IHdom).
      move=> x Hx. exact (proj2 (IHbody x Hx)).
  - move=> P psi u. split; apply Par_TyUnit; exact u.
  - move=> P psi u. split; apply Par_TmUnit; exact u.
  - move=> P psi u. split; apply Par_Bool; exact u.
  - move=> P psi u. split; apply Par_True; exact u.
  - move=> P psi u. split; apply Par_False; exact u.
  - move=> P psi a0 b0 b1 a1 b2 b3 g1 IH1 g2 IH2 g3 IH3.
    split.
    + apply Par_If; [exact (proj1 IH1)|exact (proj1 IH2)|exact (proj1 IH3)].
    + apply Par_If; [exact (proj2 IH1)|exact (proj2 IH2)|exact (proj2 IH3)].
  - move=> P psi a0 b0 b1 b2 b3 g1 IH1 g2 IH2 g3 IH3.
    split.
    + apply Par_If;
      [exact (proj1 IH1)|exact (proj1 IH2)|exact (proj1 IH3)].
    + exact (proj2 IH2).
  - move=> P psi a0 b0 b1 b3 b2 g1 IH1 g2 IH2 g3 IH3.
    split.
    + apply Par_If;
      [exact (proj1 IH1)|exact (proj1 IH2)|exact (proj1 IH3)].
    + exact (proj2 IH3).
  - move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle g IH.
    split.
    + apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact (proj1 IH)].
    + apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact (proj2 IH)].
  - move=> P psi psi0 a b lca lcb nle u.
    split.
    + apply CPar_Nleq; [exact lca|exact lca|exact nle|exact u].
    + apply CPar_Nleq; [exact lcb|exact lcb|exact nle|exact u].
Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_self : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CPar P psi psi0 a a /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  destruct H as [P0 psi1 psi1' a0 b0 Hle Hg | P0 psi1 psi1' a0 b0 lca lcb nle u].
  - split.
    + apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P0 psi1 a0 b0 Hg))].
    + apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact (proj2 (@GDefEq_self P0 psi1 a0 b0 Hg))].
  - split.
    + apply CPar_Nleq; [exact lca|exact lca|exact nle|exact u].
    + apply CPar_Nleq; [exact lcb|exact lcb|exact nle|exact u].
Qed.

Lemma open_close_self_rec : forall (t:tm) xx k,
  open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f xx) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx t) = t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros xx k; simpl; auto.
  - (* Pi *) rewrite (IHt1 xx k). rewrite (IHt2 xx (S k)). reflexivity.
  - (* Abs *) rewrite (IHt1 xx k). rewrite (IHt2 xx (S k)). reflexivity.
  - (* App *) rewrite (IHt1 xx k). rewrite (IHt2 xx k). reflexivity.
  - (* Var_b *) rename n into n.
    change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f xx)
              (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (a_Var_b n)) = a_Var_b n).
    exact (@oc_var_b xx xx k n).
  - (* Var_f *) destruct (@CoqEqDec.eq_dec MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom Metatheory.EnvImpl.EqDec_eq_of_X xx x) as [e|ne]; simpl.
    + subst x.
      change (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f xx) (a_Var_b k) = a_Var_f xx).
      rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_eq k xx). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* CEq *) rewrite (IHt1 xx k). rewrite (IHt2 xx k). rewrite (IHt3 xx k). reflexivity.
  - (* Transp *) rewrite (IHt1 xx k). rewrite (IHt2 xx k). reflexivity.
  - (* T *) rewrite (IHt xx k). reflexivity.
  - (* Box *) rewrite (IHt xx k). reflexivity.
  - (* Unbox *) rewrite (IHt xx k). reflexivity.
  - (* SSigma *) rewrite (IHt1 xx k). rewrite (IHt2 xx (S k)). reflexivity.
  - (* SPair *) rewrite (IHt1 xx k). rewrite (IHt2 xx k). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj1 *) rewrite (IHt xx k). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj2 *) rewrite (IHt xx k). reflexivity.
  - (* If *) rewrite (IHt1 xx k). rewrite (IHt2 xx k). rewrite (IHt3 xx k). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma co_var_b : forall xx k n,
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f xx) (a_Var_b n)) = a_Var_b n.
Proof.
  move=> xx k n.
  destruct (Compare_dec.lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt].
  - rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_lt n k xx Hlt).
    cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
    destruct (Compare_dec.lt_dec n k) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. lia.
  - subst n.
    rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_eq k xx).
    cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
    destruct (@CoqEqDec.eq_dec MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom Metatheory.EnvImpl.EqDec_eq_of_X xx xx) as [e|ne]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply ne. reflexivity.
  - destruct n as [|m]; [exfalso; lia|].
    have Hm : ~ (m < k)%nat by lia.
    rewrite (@open_rec_var_b_ge m k xx Hm).
    cbn [close_tm_wrt_tm_rec].
    destruct (Compare_dec.lt_dec m k) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + exfalso. lia.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma close_open_self_rec : forall (t:tm) xx k,
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t) ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f xx) t) = t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros xx k Hfv; simpl; auto.
  - (* Pi *)
    have Hf1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t1) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    have Hf2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t2) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    rewrite (IHt1 xx k Hf1) (IHt2 xx (S k) Hf2). reflexivity.
  - (* Abs *)
    have Hf1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t1) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    have Hf2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t2) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    rewrite (IHt1 xx k Hf1) (IHt2 xx (S k) Hf2). reflexivity.
  - (* App *)
    have Hf1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t1) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    have Hf2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t2) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    rewrite (IHt1 xx k Hf1) (IHt2 xx k Hf2). reflexivity.
  - (* Var_b *) rename n into n.
    change (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k xx
              (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f xx) (a_Var_b n)) = a_Var_b n).
    exact (@co_var_b xx k n).
  - (* Var_f *) simpl.
    destruct (@CoqEqDec.eq_dec MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom Metatheory.EnvImpl.EqDec_eq_of_X xx x) as [e|ne].
    + subst x. simpl. exfalso. apply Hfv.
      apply MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + destruct (@CoqEqDec.eq_dec MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom Metatheory.EnvImpl.EqDec_eq_of_X xx x) as [e|ne2]; [exfalso; exact (ne e)|reflexivity].
  - (* CEq *)
    have Hf1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t1) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t1)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3)) Hfv.
    have Hf23 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3)) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t1)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3)) Hfv.
    have Hf2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t2) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3) Hf23.
    have HfA : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t3) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3) Hf23.
    rewrite (IHt1 xx k Hf1) (IHt2 xx k Hf2) (IHt3 xx k HfA). reflexivity.
  - (* Transp *)
    have Hf1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t1) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    have Hf2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t2) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    rewrite (IHt1 xx k Hf1) (IHt2 xx k Hf2). reflexivity.
  - (* T *) rewrite (IHt xx k Hfv). reflexivity.
  - (* Box *) rewrite (IHt xx k Hfv). reflexivity.
  - (* Unbox *) rewrite (IHt xx k Hfv). reflexivity.
  - (* SSigma *)
    have Hf1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t1) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    have Hf2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t2) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    rewrite (IHt1 xx k Hf1) (IHt2 xx (S k) Hf2). reflexivity.
  - (* SPair *)
    have Hf1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t1) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    have Hf2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t2) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t1) (fv_tm t2) Hfv.
    rewrite (IHt1 xx k Hf1) (IHt2 xx k Hf2). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj1 *) rewrite (IHt xx k Hfv). reflexivity.
  - (* Proj2 *) rewrite (IHt xx k Hfv). reflexivity.
  - (* If *)
    have Hf1 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t1) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t1)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3)) Hfv.
    have Hf23 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3)) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t1)
        (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3)) Hfv.
    have Hf2 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t2) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 xx (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3) Hf23.
    have Hf3 : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In xx (fv_tm t3) :=
      @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 xx (fv_tm t2) (fv_tm t3) Hf23.
    rewrite (IHt1 xx k Hf1) (IHt2 xx k Hf2) (IHt3 xx k Hf3). reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma open_close_self : forall (u:tm) (x:tmvar),
  open_tm_wrt_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm x u) (a_Var_f x) = u.
Proof. move=> u x. exact (@open_close_self_rec u x 0). Qed.

Lemma close_open_self : forall (t:tm) (x:tmvar),
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm t) ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm x (open_tm_wrt_tm t (a_Var_f x)) = t.
Proof. move=> t x H. exact (@close_open_self_rec t x 0 H). Qed.

Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Multi-step congruence lifts                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma MultiPar_App_fun_leq : forall P psi psi0 b b' a,
  psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi a a ->
  MultiPar P psi b b' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_App b psi0 a) (a_App b' psi0 a).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 b b' a Hle Ha H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_App; [exact Hp|apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Ha]].
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + apply Par_App; [exact Hp|apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Ha]].
    + exact (IH Hle Ha).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_App_arg_leq : forall P psi psi0 b a a',
  psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_App b psi0 a) (a_App b psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 b a a' Hle Hb H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_App; [exact Hb|apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Hp]].
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + apply Par_App; [exact Hb|apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Hp]].
    + exact (IH Hle Hb).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_App_fun_nleq : forall P psi psi0 b b' a,
  ~ psi0 <= psi -> lc_tm a -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P ->
  MultiPar P psi b b' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_App b psi0 a) (a_App b' psi0 a).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 b b' a Hnle Hlca Hu H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_App; [exact Hp|exact (@CPar_Nleq PN psiN psi0 a a Hlca Hlca Hnle Hu)].
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + apply Par_App; [exact Hp|exact (@CPar_Nleq PN psiN psi0 a a Hlca Hlca Hnle Hu)].
    + exact (IH Hnle Hu).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_App_two_leq : forall P psi psi0 b0 dB a0 dA,
  psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi a0 a0 -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P ->
  MultiPar P psi b0 dB -> Par P psi dB dB ->
  MultiPar P psi a0 dA ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App dB psi0 dA).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 b0 dB a0 dA Hle Ha0 Hu Hb HdB Ha.
  have H1 : MultiPar P psi (a_App b0 psi0 a0) (a_App dB psi0 a0) :=
    @MultiPar_App_fun_leq P psi psi0 b0 dB a0 Hle Ha0 Hb.
  have H2 : MultiPar P psi (a_App dB psi0 a0) (a_App dB psi0 dA) :=
    @MultiPar_App_arg_leq P psi psi0 dB a0 dA Hle HdB Ha.
  exact (MultiPar_trans H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Transp_l : forall P psi a a' b,
  Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Transp a b) (a_Transp a' b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a a' b Hb H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_Transp; assumption.
  - eapply MP_Step; [apply Par_Transp; [exact Hp|exact Hb]|exact (IH Hb)].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Transp_r : forall P psi a b b',
  Par P psi a a ->
  MultiPar P psi b b' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Transp a b) (a_Transp a b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b b' Ha H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_Transp; assumption.
  - eapply MP_Step; [apply Par_Transp; [exact Ha|exact Hp]|exact (IH Ha)].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_end_self : forall P psi a b,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Par P psi b b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  exact (proj2 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b (@MultiPar_gdefeq P psi a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Transp_two : forall P psi a0 b0 dA dB,
  Par P psi a0 a0 -> Par P psi b0 b0 -> Par P psi dA dA ->
  MultiPar P psi a0 dA -> MultiPar P psi b0 dB ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp dA dB).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 b0 dA dB Ha0 Hb0 HdA Ha Hb.
  have H1 : MultiPar P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) (a_Transp dA b0) :=
    @MultiPar_Transp_l P psi a0 dA b0 Hb0 Ha.
  have H2 : MultiPar P psi (a_Transp dA b0) (a_Transp dA dB) :=
    @MultiPar_Transp_r P psi dA b0 dB HdA Hb.
  exact (MultiPar_trans H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_T : forall P psi psi0 A A',
  MultiPar P psi A A' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_T psi0 A) (a_T psi0 A').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A A' H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_T. exact Hp.
  - eapply MP_Step; [apply Par_T; exact Hp|exact IH].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Box_leq : forall P psi psi0 a a',
  psi0 <= psi ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' Hle H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_Box. apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Hp].
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + apply Par_Box. apply CPar_Leq; [exact Hle|exact Hp].
    + exact (IH Hle).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Box_cpar : forall P psi psi0 a a',
  CPar P psi psi0 a a' ->
  Par P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Box psi0 a) (a_Box psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' Hc Hp.
  apply MP_One. apply Par_Box. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Unbox_leq : forall P psi psi0 a a',
  psi0 <= psi ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) (a_Unbox psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' Hle H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. exact (@Par_Unbox PN psiN psi0 s t Hp Hle).
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@Par_Unbox PN psiN psi0 s m Hp Hle).
    + exact (IH Hle).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Proj1 : forall P psi psi0 a a',
  psi0 <= psi ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) (a_Proj1 psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' Hle H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. exact (@Par_Proj1Cong PN psiN psi0 s t Hp Hle).
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@Par_Proj1Cong PN psiN psi0 s m Hp Hle).
    + exact (IH Hle).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Proj2 : forall P psi psi0 a a',
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a) (a_Proj2 psi0 a').
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. apply Par_Proj2Cong. exact Hp.
  - eapply MP_Step; [apply Par_Proj2Cong; exact Hp|exact IH].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_CEq_l : forall P psi psi0 a a' b psi1 A,
  psi0 <= psi -> lc_tm A -> Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_CEq psi0 a b psi1 A) (a_CEq psi0 a' b psi1 A).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' b psi1 A Hle HlcA Hb H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_CEq PN psiN psi0 s b psi1 A t b A HlcA HlcA Hp Hb Hle).
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@Par_CEq PN psiN psi0 s b psi1 A m b A HlcA HlcA Hp Hb Hle).
    + exact (IH Hle Hb).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_CEq_r : forall P psi psi0 a b b' psi1 A,
  psi0 <= psi -> lc_tm A -> Par P psi a a ->
  MultiPar P psi b b' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_CEq psi0 a b psi1 A) (a_CEq psi0 a b' psi1 A).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b b' psi1 A Hle HlcA Ha H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_CEq PN psiN psi0 a s psi1 A a t A HlcA HlcA Ha Hp Hle).
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@Par_CEq PN psiN psi0 a s psi1 A a m A HlcA HlcA Ha Hp Hle).
    + exact (IH Hle Ha).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_SPair_fst_leq : forall P psi psi0 a a' b,
  psi0 <= psi -> Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SPair a' psi0 b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a a' b Hle Hb H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. exact (@Par_SPair PN psiN s psi0 b t b
      (@CPar_Leq PN psiN psi0 s t Hle Hp) Hb).
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@Par_SPair PN psiN s psi0 b m b
        (@CPar_Leq PN psiN psi0 s m Hle Hp) Hb).
    + exact (IH Hle Hb).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_SPair_snd_cpar : forall P psi a0 psi0 a1 b b',
  CPar P psi psi0 a0 a1 -> CPar P psi psi0 a1 a1 ->
  MultiPar P psi b b' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_SPair a0 psi0 b) (a_SPair a1 psi0 b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 psi0 a1 b b' Hc Hself H.
  revert a0 a1 Hc Hself.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> a0 a1 Hc Hself. apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_SPair PN psiN a0 psi0 s a1 t Hc Hp).
  - move=> a0 a1 Hc Hself.
    eapply MP_Step with (b := a_SPair a1 psi0 m).
    + exact (@Par_SPair PN psiN a0 psi0 s a1 m Hc Hp).
    + exact (IH a1 a1 Hself Hself).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_If_l : forall P psi a a' b c,
  Par P psi b b -> Par P psi c c ->
  MultiPar P psi a a' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_If a b c) (a_If a' b c).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a a' b c Hb Hc H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. exact (@Par_If PN psiN s b c t b c Hp Hb Hc).
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@Par_If PN psiN s b c m b c Hp Hb Hc).
    + exact (IH Hb Hc).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_If_m : forall P psi a b b' c,
  Par P psi a a -> Par P psi c c ->
  MultiPar P psi b b' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_If a b c) (a_If a b' c).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b b' c Ha Hc H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. exact (@Par_If PN psiN a s c a t c Ha Hp Hc).
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@Par_If PN psiN a s c a m c Ha Hp Hc).
    + exact (IH Ha Hc).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_If_r : forall P psi a b c c',
  Par P psi a a -> Par P psi b b ->
  MultiPar P psi c c' ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_If a b c) (a_If a b c').
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b c c' Ha Hb H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - apply MP_One. exact (@Par_If PN psiN a b s a b t Ha Hb Hp).
  - eapply MP_Step.
    + exact (@Par_If PN psiN a b s a b m Ha Hb Hp).
    + exact (IH Ha Hb).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_If_three : forall P psi a0 b0 c0 dA dB dC,
  Par P psi a0 a0 -> Par P psi b0 b0 -> Par P psi c0 c0 ->
  Par P psi dA dA -> Par P psi dB dB ->
  MultiPar P psi a0 dA -> MultiPar P psi b0 dB -> MultiPar P psi c0 dC ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_If a0 b0 c0) (a_If dA dB dC).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 b0 c0 dA dB dC Ha Hb Hc HdA HdB Ha' Hb' Hc'.
  have H1 : MultiPar P psi (a_If a0 b0 c0) (a_If dA b0 c0) :=
    @MultiPar_If_l P psi a0 dA b0 c0 Hb Hc Ha'.
  have H2 : MultiPar P psi (a_If dA b0 c0) (a_If dA dB c0) :=
    @MultiPar_If_m P psi dA b0 dB c0 HdA Hc Hb'.
  have H3 : MultiPar P psi (a_If dA dB c0) (a_If dA dB dC) :=
    @MultiPar_If_r P psi dA dB c0 dC HdA HdB Hc'.
  exact (MultiPar_trans (MultiPar_trans H1 H2) H3).
Qed.

(* Body chain under a binder, opened at a fixed lc argument when the
   grade condition fails. *)
Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_nleq_gen : forall P psi src d,
  MultiPar P psi src d ->
  forall psi0 A a A' a' b,
    src = a_Abs psi0 A a -> d = a_Abs psi0 A' a' ->
    ~ psi0 <= psi -> lc_tm b ->
    MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi src d H.
  induction H as [PN psiN s t Hp | PN psiN s t m Hp Htail IH].
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b Es Ed Hnle Hlcb. subst s. subst t.
    apply MP_One.
    apply (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A' a' b b Hp).
    + move=> Hle. exfalso. exact (Hnle Hle).
    + exact Hlcb.
    + exact Hlcb.
  - move=> psi0 A a A' a' b Es Ed Hnle Hlcb. subst s.
    destruct (@Par_Abs_inv PN psiN psi0 A a m Hp) as [L [A2 [a2 [Em [Hlc2 Hbody]]]]].
    subst m.
    have Hstep : Par PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b).
    { apply (@Par_Abs_arg_step PN psiN psi0 A a A2 a2 b b Hp).
      - move=> Hle. exfalso. exact (Hnle Hle).
      - exact Hlcb.
      - exact Hlcb. }
    have Htail' : MultiPar PN psiN (open_tm_wrt_tm a2 b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b).
    { apply (IH psi0 A2 a2 A' a' b eq_refl Ed Hnle Hlcb). }
    eapply MP_Step; [exact Hstep|exact Htail'].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Abs_arg_nleq : forall P psi psi0 A a A' a' b,
  ~ psi0 <= psi -> lc_tm b ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A' a') ->
  MultiPar P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm a b) (open_tm_wrt_tm a' b).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 A a A' a' b Hnle Hlcb H.
  exact (@MultiPar_Abs_arg_nleq_gen P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a)(a_Abs psi0 A' a') H
           psi0 A a A' a' b eq_refl eq_refl Hnle Hlcb).
Qed.
From Coq Require Import Lia.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Small helpers                                                 *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma GDefEq_uniq : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  exact (@Par_uniq P psi a a (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_uniq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  exact (@CPar_uniq P psi psi0 a a (proj1 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma GDefEq_par_l : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof. move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b H)). Qed.

Lemma GDefEq_par_r : forall P psi a b,
  GDefEq P psi a b -> Par P psi b b.
Proof. move=> P psi a b H. exact (proj2 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b H)). Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_cpar_l : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CPar P psi psi0 a a.
Proof. move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj1 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b H)). Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_cpar_r : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> CPar P psi psi0 b b.
Proof. move=> P psi psi0 a b H. exact (proj2 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b H)). Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_par_l_of_leq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle H.
  exact (@CPar_leq_inv P psi psi0 a a Hle (@CGDefEq_cpar_l P psi psi0 a b H)).
Qed.

Lemma CGDefEq_par_r_of_leq : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  psi0 <= psi -> CGDefEq P psi psi0 a b -> Par P psi b b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b Hle H.
  exact (@CPar_leq_inv P psi psi0 b b Hle (@CGDefEq_cpar_r P psi psi0 a b H)).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_start_self : forall P psi a b,
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  exact (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b (@MultiPar_gdefeq P psi a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma Joins_self : forall P psi a,
  Par P psi a a -> Joins P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a H.
  exact (@join P psi a a a (@MP_One P psi a a H) (@MP_One P psi a a H)).
Qed.

Lemma MP_One' : forall P psi a b,
  Par P psi a b -> MultiPar P psi a b.
Proof. move=> P psi a b H. exact (@MP_One P psi a b H). Qed.

Lemma Joins_inv : forall P psi a b,
  Joins P psi a b -> exists c, MultiPar P psi a c /\ MultiPar P psi b c.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  inversion H as [P0 psi0 a1 a2 b0 H1 H2]; subst.
  exists b0. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma CJoins_inv : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CJoins P psi psi0 a b ->
  ((psi0 <= psi) /\ Joins P psi a b) \/
  (lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b /\ ~ psi0 <= psi /\ Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq P).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  inversion H as [P0 psiN psiN0 a0 b0 Hle HJ | P0 psiN psiN0 a0 b0 lca lcb nle u];
    subst.
  - left. split; assumption.
  - right. split; [exact lca|split; [exact lcb|split; assumption]].
Qed.

Lemma Par_App_inv : forall P psi a psi0 b c,
  Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) c ->
  (exists a' b' A, c = open_tm_wrt_tm a' b' /\
     Par P psi a (a_Abs psi0 A a') /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b')
  \/ (exists a' b', c = a_App a' psi0 b' /\
     Par P psi a a' /\ CPar P psi psi0 b b').
Proof.
  move=> P psi a psi0 b c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists; eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
  - right. eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.


Lemma Par_Transp_inv : forall P psi a0 b0 c,
  Par P psi (a_Transp a0 b0) c ->
  (exists a1 b1, c = a_Transp a1 b1 /\ Par P psi a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b1)
  \/ (exists b1, c = b1 /\ Par P psi a0 a_Refl /\ Par P psi b0 b1).
Proof.
  move=> P psi a0 b0 c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists; eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
  - right. eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_Unbox_inv : forall P psi psi0 a c,
  Par P psi (a_Unbox psi0 a) c ->
  (exists b, c = a_Unbox psi0 b /\ Par P psi a b /\ psi0 <= psi)
  \/ (exists b, c = b /\ Par P psi a (a_Box psi0 b) /\ psi0 <= psi).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a c H. inversion H; subst.
  - left. eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
  - right. eexists. split; [reflexivity|split; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma Par_Proj1_inv : forall P psi psi0 a0 c,

  \/ (exists a1 a2, c = a1 /\ Par P psi a0 (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) /\ psi0 <= psi).
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a0 c H. inversion H; subst.

Lemma Par_Proj2_inv : forall P psi psi0 a0 c,

  \/ (exists a1 a2, c = a2 /\ Par P psi a0 (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2)).

Lemma Par_If_inv : forall P psi a0 b0 b1 c,
  Par P psi (a_If a0 b0 b1) c ->

     Par P psi a0 a1 /\ Par P psi b0 b2 /\ Par P psi b1 b3)
  \/ (exists b2 b3, c = b2 /\

  \/ (exists b2 b3, c = b3 /\

Proof.

Lemma MultiPar_under_abs_close : forall E psi u v,
  MultiPar E psi u v ->

    apply MP_One.
    exact (@Par_under_abs_close P psiN psi0 A x0 s t Hu HlcA Hp).

Scheme Typing_Ctx_mutind2 := Induction for Typing Sort Prop
  with Ctx_mutind3 := Induction for Ctx Sort Prop.
Lemma Typing_subst_tail : forall C psi a B, Typing C psi a B ->
  forall W x gx A u,
    C = W ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (gx,A)) ->
    Typing nil gx u A -> ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm A) ->
    Typing (subst_ctx u x W) psi (subst_tm u x a) (subst_tm u x B).
Proof.
  move=> C psi a B H.
  induction H using Typing_Ctx_mutind2
    with (P0 := fun C _ => forall W x gx A u,
      C = W ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,(gx,A)) ->
      Typing nil gx u A -> ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm A) ->
      Ctx (subst_ctx u x W)).
  all: try (intros; simpl;
    match goal with
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Type _) _ => eapply T_Type; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_App _ _ _) _ => eapply T_App; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Refl _ => eapply T_Refl; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_CEq _ _ _ _ _) _ => eapply T_CEq; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_T _ _) _ => eapply T_T; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Box _ _) _ => eapply T_Box; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Unbox _ _) _ => eapply T_Unbox; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_SPair _ _ _) _ => eapply T_SPair; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj1 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj1; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_Proj2 _ _) _ => eapply T_Proj2; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TyUnit _ => eapply T_TyUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_TmUnit _ => eapply T_TmUnit; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_Bool _ => eapply T_Bool; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_True _ => eapply T_True; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ a_False _ => eapply T_False; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ (a_If _ _ _) _ => eapply T_If; eauto
    | |- Typing _ _ _ _ => idtac
    | |- Ctx _ => idtac
    end).
  all: try solve [ eapply T_Var; eauto ].
  - (* Var *)
    destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x x0) as [Ex|Hne].
    + subst x0. simpl.
      have HuniqW : Metatheory.EnvImpl.uniq W := Ctx_uniq c.
      have Hself : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (gx, A0) W.
      { rewrite H. apply (@binds_one_self_gen (grade*tm) W0 x (gx,A0)). }
      have Hbeq := @Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_unique (grade*tm) x (psi0,A) (gx,A0) W b Hself HuniqW.
      injection Hbeq as Ep EA. subst psi0 A. simpl in *.
      have HCt := IHTyping W0 x gx A0 u H H0 H1.
      have Hincl : forall (y:MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom) (g:grade) (B:tm),
        Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y (g,B) nil -> Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y (g,B) (subst_ctx u x W0).
      { move=> y g B Hy. unfold Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds in Hy. destruct Hy. }
      have Huw : Typing (subst_ctx u x W0) gx u A0 := Typing_weaken_ctx H0 HCt Hincl.
      have Hmono := Typing_grade_mono i Huw.
      rewrite (@subst_tm_notin A0 u x H1). exact Hmono.
    + have HCt := IHTyping W0 x0 gx A0 u H H0 H1.
      have Hb : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (psi0, A) W0.
      { rewrite H in b. eapply (@binds_app_one_neq_gen (grade*tm) W0 x0 (gx,A0) x (psi0,A)); [exact b | exact Hne]. }
      have HbT : Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds x (psi0, subst_tm u x0 A) (subst_ctx u x0 W0).
      { exact (@Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds_map_2 (grade*tm) (grade*tm) (fun '(g,B) => (g, subst_tm u x0 B)) x (psi0,A) W0 Hb). }
      eapply T_Var; [exact HCt | exact i | exact HbT].
  - (* Pi *)
    eapply T_Pi with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)).
    + exact (IHTyping W0 x gx A0 u H1 H2 H3).
    + move=> z Hz.
      have HzL : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z L := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_1 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hzx : ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) := @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetNotin.notin_union_2 z L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x) Hz.
      have Hxz : x <> z.
      { move=> Exz. apply Hzx. rewrite -Exz. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton_2 x x eq_refl). }
      have E' : Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W =
        (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W0) ++ Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (gx,A0)).
      { rewrite H1. reflexivity. }
      have Hulc : lc_tm u := Typing_lc H2.
      have Hbz := H0 z HzL (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (z, (psi0,A)) ++ W0) x gx A0 u E' H2 H3.
      rewrite (@subst_open_var B u x z Hulc Hxz).
      exact Hbz.
    + exact r.
  - (* Abs *)
    eapply T_Abs with (L := MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.union L (MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.singleton x)).

Lemma Typing_subst_beta : forall x g A psi body B u,
  Typing (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (g,A))) psi body B ->
  Typing nil g u A ->
  ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x (fv_tm A) ->
  Typing nil psi (subst_tm u x body) (subst_tm u x B).
Proof.
  move=> x g A psi body B u H Hu HxA.
  exact (@Typing_subst_tail (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x,(g,A))) psi body B H nil x g A u eq_refl Hu HxA).
Qed.

Lemma DefEq_sym : forall P a b, DefEq P a b -> DefEq P b a.
Proof.
  move=> P a b H. induction H.
  - eapply E_One. apply GE_Sym. exact H.

Lemma DefEq_trans : forall P a b c, DefEq P a b -> DefEq P b c -> DefEq P a c.
Proof.
  move=> P a b c H1 H2. eapply E_Trans; [exact H1 | exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma Typing_App_inv_strong : forall W psi a psi0 b A,
  Typing W psi (a_App a psi0 b) A ->
  exists A0 B, Typing W psi a (a_Pi psi0 A0 B) /\
              Typing W psi0 b A0 /\
              (A = open_tm_wrt_tm B b \/ DefEq (labels W) A (open_tm_wrt_tm B b)).
Proof.
  move=> W psi a psi0 b A H.
  remember (a_App a psi0 b) as t eqn:E.
  revert a psi0 b E.
  induction H; intros aa pp bb E; try discriminate E.
  - (* T_App *) inversion E; subst. eauto 8.
  - (* T_Conv *)
    destruct (IHTyping1 aa pp bb E) as [A0 [B0 [h1 [h2 [EQ|DEQ]]]]].
    + exists A0, B0. split; [exact h1 | split; [exact h2 |]].
      right. subst. eapply DefEq_sym. exact H1.
    + exists A0, B0. split; [exact h1 | split; [exact h2 |]].
      right. eapply DefEq_trans; [eapply DefEq_sym; exact H1 | exact DEQ].
Qed.

Lemma Typing_Abs_inv_canon : forall W psi psi0 A body T,
  Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A body) T ->
  exists L B psi1 s,
    Typing W psi1 (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s) /\
    (forall x, ~ MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In x L ->
       Typing (Metatheory.EnvImpl.one (x, (psi0, A)) ++ W) psi
         (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) /\
    (T = a_Pi psi0 A B \/ DefEq (labels W) T (a_Pi psi0 A B)).
Proof.
  move=> W psi psi0 A body T H.
  remember (a_Abs psi0 A body) as t eqn:E.
  revert A body E.
  induction H; intros AA bb E; try discriminate E.
  - (* T_Abs *) inversion E; subst. eauto 10.
  - (* T_Conv *)
    destruct (IHTyping1 AA bb E) as [L [B0 [psi2 [s0 [hpi [hbody [EQ|DEQ]]]]]]].
    + exists L, B0, psi2, s0. split; [exact hpi | split; [exact hbody |]].
      right. subst. eapply DefEq_sym. exact H1.
    + exists L, B0, psi2, s0. split; [exact hpi | split; [exact hbody |]].
      right. eapply DefEq_trans; [eapply DefEq_sym; exact H1 | exact DEQ].
Qed.

Fixpoint econtext_remove (x:tmvar) (P:econtext) : econtext :=
  match P with
  | nil => nil
  | (y,g) :: P' => if eq_var y x then econtext_remove x P' else (y,g) :: econtext_remove x P'
  end.

Lemma dom_remove : forall (P:econtext) x z,
  MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P)) <->
  MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P) /\ z <> x.
Proof.
  move=> P.
  elim: P => [| [y h] P' IH].
  - move=> x z. simpl. split.
    + intro H. exfalso. exact (notin_empty z H).
    + intro H. destruct H as [H1 _]. exfalso. exact (notin_empty z H1).
  - move=> x z. simpl.
    destruct (eq_var y x) as [e|ne].
    + subst y. simpl. split.
      * intro H. destruct (proj1 (IH x z) H) as [H1 H2]. split.
        -- exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') x z H1).
        -- exact H2.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Hin H2]. apply (proj2 (IH x z)). split.
        -- refine (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') x z _ Hin).
           intro E. exact (H2 (eq_sym E)).
        -- exact H2.
    + split.
      * intro H. destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec z y) as [E|nE].
        -- subst z. split.
           ++ exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_1 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') y y eq_refl).
           ++ exact ne.
        -- have Hz : MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) :=
             @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) y z (fun E => nE (eq_sym E)) H.
           destruct (proj1 (IH x z) Hz) as [H1 H2]. split.
           ++ exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') y z H1).
           ++ exact H2.
      * intro H. destruct H as [Hin H2].
        destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec z y) as [E|nE].
        -- subst z. exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_1 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) y y eq_refl).
        -- have Hz : MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.In z (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') :=
             @MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_3 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom P') y z (fun E => nE (eq_sym E)) Hin.
           exact (@MetatheoryAtom.AtomSetImpl.add_2 (Metatheory.EnvImpl.dom (econtext_remove x P')) y z
                    (proj2 (IH x z) (conj Hz H2))).
Qed.

Lemma binds_remove_other : forall (P:econtext) x y g,
  y <> x ->
  (Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y g (econtext_remove x P) <->
   Metatheory.EnvImpl.binds y g P).
Proof.
  move=> P.
  elim: P => [| [z h] P' IH].
  - move=> x y g Hne. simpl. tauto.
  - move=> x y g Hne. simpl.
    destruct (eq_var z x) as [e|ne].

Qed.

From Qual Require Import Qualitative_ott.
From Qual Require Import Dev.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Local Open Scope order_scope.
Local Open Scope list_scope.

(* Endpoint self-parallel-reduction facts: a parallel step can be
   composed with itself at either endpoint. *)
Lemma Par_self_l : forall P psi a b,
  Par P psi a b -> Par P psi a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  exact (proj1 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b (@Par_gdefeq P psi a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma Par_self_r : forall P psi a b,
  Par P psi a b -> Par P psi b b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi a b H.
  exact (proj2 (@GDefEq_self P psi a b (@Par_gdefeq P psi a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma CPar_self_l : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CPar P psi psi0 a b -> CPar P psi psi0 a a.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  exact (proj1 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b (@CPar_cgdefeq P psi psi0 a b H))).
Qed.

Lemma CPar_self_r : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  CPar P psi psi0 a b -> CPar P psi psi0 b b.
Proof.
  move=> P psi psi0 a b H.
  exact (proj2 (@CGDefEq_self P psi psi0 a b (@CPar_cgdefeq P psi psi0 a b H))).
Qed.

(* A term that is parallel-self-reducible can simulate any one
   call-by-name reduction step as a parallel step, at the same grade
   and environment.  This is the key commutation property; note that
   no typing is needed, only self-parallel-reducibility. *)
Lemma Par_Red_self : forall a b, Red a b ->
  forall P psi, Par P psi a a -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  move=> a b Hred.
  induction Hred; intros P psi Hpar.
  - (* R_App *)
    destruct (@Par_App_inv P psi a0 psi0 b (a_App a0 psi0 b) Hpar)
      as [[a' [b' [A [E [Hf Hc]]]]] | [a' [b' [E [Hf Hc]]]]].
    + have Hself : Par P psi a0 a0 := Par_self_l Hf.
      have Hcb : CPar P psi psi0 b b := CPar_self_l Hc.
      exact (@Par_App P psi a0 psi0 b a1 b (IHRed P psi Hself) Hcb).
    + have Hself : Par P psi a0 a0 := Par_self_l Hf.
      have Hcb : CPar P psi psi0 b b := CPar_self_l Hc.
      exact (@Par_App P psi a0 psi0 b a1 b (IHRed P psi Hself) Hcb).
  - (* R_AppAbs *)
    destruct (@Par_App_inv P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) psi0 b
                (a_App (a_Abs psi0 A a) psi0 b) Hpar)
      as [[a' [b' [A' [E [Hf Hc]]]]] | [a' [b' [E [Hf Hc]]]]].
    + have Hself : Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) := Par_self_l Hf.
      have Hcb : CPar P psi psi0 b b := CPar_self_l Hc.
      exact (@Par_AppBeta P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) psi0 b a b A Hself Hcb).
    + have Hself : Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) (a_Abs psi0 A a) := Par_self_l Hf.
      have Hcb : CPar P psi psi0 b b := CPar_self_l Hc.
      exact (@Par_AppBeta P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) psi0 b a b A Hself Hcb).
  - (* R_Transp *)
    destruct (@Par_Transp_inv P psi a b (a_Transp a b) Hpar)
      as [[a1 [b1 [E [Ha Hb]]]] | [b1 [E [Ha Hb]]]].
    + have Hsa : Par P psi a a := Par_self_l Ha.
      have Hsb : Par P psi b b := Par_self_l Hb.
      exact (@Par_Transp P psi a b a0 b (IHRed P psi Hsa) Hsb).
    + have Hsa : Par P psi a a := Par_self_l Ha.
      have Hsb : Par P psi b b := Par_self_l Hb.
      exact (@Par_Transp P psi a b a0 b (IHRed P psi Hsa) Hsb).
  - (* R_TranspRefl *)
    destruct (@Par_Transp_inv P psi a_Refl a (a_Transp a_Refl a) Hpar)
      as [[a1 [b1 [E [Ha Hb]]]] | [b1 [E [Ha Hb]]]].
    + inversion E; subst.
